</details>


### [222] [Evolutionary Safety of Recursive Self-Improving AI: Taxonomy, Risk Discovery, and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31186)
*Chang Gong,Jingping Bi,Di Yao,Xinjian Liang,Chao Xiang,Ruijie Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"演化安全"（Evolutionary Safety）视角，研究AI在持续与递归自我改进（RSI）条件下安全性质如何变化、存续、累积与传播，并构建分类体系、评估方法与治理原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI能力快速提升，开始参与自身改进（模型训练、经验积累、智能体演化、自动化AI开发），递归自我改进前景日益现实。这带来根本性安全难题：当系统本身、其累积经验乃至产生后代的流程都在持续变化时，安全如何维持。既有安全研究多关注某一时刻的静态安全性，难以应对演化过程带来的动态风险。

Method: 1) 提出"演化安全"研究视角，关注安全性质的动态属性而非单点状态；2) 刻画反复出现的风险表现形式，包括意图漂移、错误累积、经验污染、安全属性侵蚀、评估器漂移与风险传播；3) 构建分类体系，涵盖持久智能体状态、模型状态、评估与环境反馈、计算基板及元级更新机制；4) 基于该分类体系，提出跨状态、更新、轨迹与谱系的风险发现与评估思路；5) 推导涵盖修改、选择、授权、溯源与恢复的治理原则。

Result: 给出演化安全的概念框架与风险清单，建立多层次分类体系，形成面向演化过程的评估维度（状态、更新、轨迹、谱系）与治理原则，并梳理在AI日益持久、自适应与递归自我改进条件下维持安全保证的开放问题；同时公开项目资源与拟议的评估系统。

Conclusion: 安全研究需从"某时刻是否安全"转向"安全性质如何在演化中存续与传播"。演化安全为RSI场景下的风险识别、评估与治理提供了统一视角与初步框架，但维持长期安全保证仍是未解难题。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly, with increasingly capable systems taking larger roles in reasoning, decision-making, scientific discovery, and autonomous development. As AI begins to participate in its own improvement, from model training and experience accumulation to agent evolution and automated AI development, the prospect of recursive self-improvement (RSI) is becoming increasingly relevant. This transition raises a fundamental safety question: how can safety be maintained when the system, its accumulated experience, and even the process producing its successors continue to change?
  We introduce Evolutionary Safety as a perspective for studying safety under persistent and recursive self-improvement. It concerns not only whether an AI system is safe at a particular moment, but how safety properties change, persist, accumulate, and propagate throughout evolution. We characterize recurring manifestations, including intent drift, error accumulation, experience contamination, safety-property erosion, evaluator drift, and risk propagation. We then develop a taxonomy spanning persistent agent state, model state, evaluation and environmental feedback, computational substrate, and meta-level update mechanisms. Building on this taxonomy, we examine how evolutionary risks can be discovered and evaluated across states, updates, trajectories, and lineages, and derive governance principles for modification, selection, authorization, provenance, and recovery. Finally, we outline open problems toward maintaining safety guarantees as AI systems become increasingly persistent, adaptive, and recursively self-improving. Project resources and proposed evaluation systems are available at https://chaunceykung.github.io/evolutionary-safety-rsi.

</details>


### [223] [Samples, Sources, Space: Decomposing Data Scale in Spatially Structured Representation Learning of Human Brain Microarchitecture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31201)
*Christian Schiffer,Mathis Bode,Thomas Lippert,Katrin Amunts,Timo Dickscheid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将数据缩放重新定义为"分配问题"，分解为唯一样本数、来源多样性与空间覆盖三个轴，并在全脑组织学对比预训练中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统缩放研究仅用单一"样本数量"刻画训练数据。但对于具有层级与空间结构的数据，相同样本数可能来自少数或众多来源，且在下游域上的分布也不同，因此单一样本计数无法揭示数据构成对表征学习的影响。

Method: 以显微全脑组织学为场景：来源为个体大脑，样本为特定空间位置的图像块。使用以空间邻近性作为监督信号的对比模型，基于21个人脑、1160万个空间锚定图像块，开展了93次受控预训练实验，系统变化数据分配、计算量与模型容量。

Result: 性能随唯一样本数增加、空间覆盖扩大、计算量提升与模型容量增大而改善。在固定样本数下，将样本分散到1至18个受试者未带来可检测的提升；尽管表征对预训练中遇到的受试者泛化显著更好。说明受试者间差异强烈影响泛化，但固定样本预算下增加来源数量并无收益。

Conclusion: 样本数、来源多样性与空间覆盖是空间结构表征学习中相互独立的数据缩放轴，为结构化数据的训练数据分配提供了新的分析框架。

Abstract: Scaling studies typically represent training data by a single count of samples. For hierarchically and spatially structured data, however, the same number of samples can be drawn from few or many sources and distributed differently across the underlying domain. We therefore study data scaling as an allocation problem, separating unique sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage. We study this decomposition in microscopic whole-brain histology, where a source is an individual brain, and a sample is an image patch at a specific spatial location. Across 93 controlled pretraining runs of a contrastive model that uses spatial proximity for supervision, we vary data allocation, compute, and model capacity over 11.6 million spatially anchored image patches from 21 human brains. Performance improves with more unique samples, broader spatial coverage, additional compute, and larger model capacity. At fixed sample count, distributing samples across one to 18 subjects produces no detectable improvement, even though representations generalize substantially better to subjects encountered during pretraining. Inter-subject variation therefore strongly affects generalization, but additional subjects provide no benefit when a fixed sample budget is distributed across more sources. These results establish sample count, source diversity, and spatial coverage as distinct axes of data scaling in spatially structured representation learning.

</details>


### [224] [MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31281)
*Guowei Zou,Haitao Wang,Guoxin Wang,Beiwen Zhang,Zhiquan Chen,Guojie Wang,Hejun Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MA-WAM，一种面向多智能体流策略的测试时世界模型规划器，通过建模跨智能体动作依赖来预测联合动作的团队回报，在 30 个离线 MARL 设置上平均相对提升 22.0%（对比直接执行）和 25.6%（对比均匀动作选择），仅增加 12.1 ms 开销（约占生成与评分时间的 2.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作任务要求各智能体同时执行联合动作，且每个智能体的动作会同时影响其他智能体的观测与响应，因此需要一个世界模型来预测全体智能体联合动作带来的团队回报。简单地将单智能体世界模型逐智能体、逐步地扩展到多智能体场景，无法刻画多个智能体同时动作之间的依赖关系，导致预测不准确。

Method: 提出多智能体世界-动作模型（MA-WAM）：一个测试时规划框架，使冻结的多智能体流策略（multi-agent flow policy）能够评估候选联合动作的未来。MA-WAM 依据跨智能体依赖关系预测每个联合动作的后果，并对候选动作进行高效评分。据作者所知，MA-WAM 是首个面向多智能体流策略的测试时世界模型规划器。

Result: 在 MAMuJoCo、SMAC 和 MPE 上的 30 个离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）设置中，MA-WAM 相对直接执行平均提升 22.0%，相对于均匀动作选择平均提升 25.6%。在 A100 GPU 上的标准评测协议下，MA-WAM 仅增加 12.1 ms，占所测生成与评分时间的 2.5%。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模跨智能体的动作依赖，MA-WAM 以极低的测试时开销显著提升了冻结多智能体流策略的决策质量，验证了测试时世界模型规划在多智能体协作任务中的有效性，并为多智能体流策略的规划提供了首个可行框架。

Abstract: Multi-agent cooperative tasks require different agents to execute a joint action simultaneously, and each agent's action affects both the observations and responses of the other agents. Hence, a world model is needed to predict the team return resulting from the joint actions of all agents. A naive extension directly applies a single-agent world model to each agent's action when predicting the team return step by step. However, such an extension fails to capture the dependencies among the simultaneous actions of multiple agents. We propose Multi-Agent World-Action Model (MA-WAM), a test-time planning framework that enables a frozen multi-agent flow policy to evaluate futures of candidate joint actions. To our knowledge, MA-WAM is the first test-time world-model planner for multi-agent flow policies. MA-WAM predicts the consequences of each joint action according to cross-agent dependencies and enables efficient candidate scoring. Across 30 offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings on MAMuJoCo, SMAC, and MPE, MA-WAM achieves mean relative gains of 22.0% over direct execution and 25.6% over uniform action selection. Under the standard evaluation protocol on an A100 GPU, MA-WAM adds 12.1 ms, accounting for 2.5% of the measured generation-and-scoring time.

</details>


### [225] [G2MAF: Test-Time Gradient Guidance for Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31286)
*Guowei Zou,Haitao Wang,Guoxin Wang,Zhiquan Chen,Beiwen Zhang,Guojie Wang,Hejun Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: G2MAF是一个离线多智能体强化学习的测试时联合策略优化框架，通过全局归一化的投影评论家梯度引导所有智能体协同修正动作，在保持可行且接近冻结策略建议的前提下提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线MARL从固定数据集学习协作策略且部署时策略被冻结，冻结策略通常只提出单一联合动作并直接执行，这种一次性部署常会锁定次优建议——即使行为数据中仍存在更好的邻近替代动作。因此需要一种在测试时对联合策略进行优化的精炼方法。

Method: 提出Gradient Guided Multi Agent Flow (G2MAF)精炼框架，在测试时优化联合策略：施加一个全局归一化的投影评论家梯度(projected critic gradient)，用于引导并协调所有智能体的修正，同时保持动作既可行又接近冻结策略提出的建议。

Result: 在24个MPE和SMAC设置中，其规范变体改进了20个冻结设置，MPE平均相对增益9.2%，SMAC为8.9%，模型推理延迟仅增加约6%。

Conclusion: G2MAF能有效缓解离线MARL一次性部署锁定次优联合动作的问题，在几乎不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升多种多智能体任务的性能。

Abstract: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) learns cooperative policies from fixed datasets without further environment interaction and a learned policy is frozen at deployment. Such a frozen policy typically proposes a single joint action and executes it directly at deployment time. However, this one-shot deployment often commits to a suboptimal proposal, even when better nearby alternatives remain consistent with the behavior data. To address this issue, we propose Gradient Guided Multi Agent Flow (G2MAF), a refinement framework for optimizing joint policies at test-time. G2MAF applies one globally normalized, projected critic gradient to guide and coordinate all agents' corrections while keeping the action both feasible and close to the frozen policy proposal. Across 24 MPE and SMAC settings, its canonical variant improves 20 frozen settings, with mean relative gains of 9.2% on MPE and 8.9% on SMAC, with model inference latency increased by about 6% only.

</details>


### [226] [Mutable Transcripts: Mitigating Context Pollution through Editable Conversation State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31354)
*Dan Barry,Andrew Hines*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"可变对话记录"（mutable transcripts）交互范式，允许用户以自然语言编辑请求修改历史对话轮次，将对话记录从被动日志转变为可编辑的对话状态表示，并通过原型系统与用户研究验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM聊天系统将对话历史视为不可变的轮次序列，并以此定义模型的工作上下文。但真实交互中用户意图是动态演化的，会通过纠错、细化和约束变更不断调整。这种"动态意图"与"静态记录"之间的失配导致上下文污染：过时或无关信息持续残留并影响后续回复，用户往往被迫重启对话。

Method: 提出mutable transcripts范式，支持用户通过自然语言编辑请求修订先前的对话轮次，使历史记录可被更新而非仅追加。作者实现了一个将记录级修订功能集成到标准聊天界面的可运行原型（ReChat），并通过受控用户研究（n=17）与代表性交互场景的记录分析来评估其可行性。

Result: 在清晰度、信心和使用便捷性等指标上，参与者显著更偏好可变对话记录而非标准聊天，且重启对话的意愿降低。对用户研究中代表性对话记录的文本分析显示，可变记录能够缩短对话长度并消除已过时的残留上下文。

Conclusion: 初步证据表明，由用户驱动的对话历史修订可以提升交互质量，并有助于维持对用户意图更及时、更准确的表示。

Abstract: Contemporary large language model (LLM) chat systems treat conversation history as an immutable sequence of turns that defines the model's working context. However, user intent in real interactions is not static: it evolves through correction, refinement, and shifting constraints. This mismatch between dynamic intent and static transcripts can result in context pollution, where outdated or irrelevant information persists and continues to influence subsequent responses. We introduce mutable transcripts, a new interaction paradigm that enables users to revise prior turns through natural language edit requests, allowing the conversation history itself to be updated rather than appended. This reframes the transcript from a passive record into an editable representation of conversational state. We present a working prototype that integrates transcript-level revision into a standard chat interface and evaluate its feasibility through a controlled user study (n=17) and an illustrative transcript analysis of representative interaction scenarios. Participants significantly preferred mutable transcripts over standard chat across measures of clarity, confidence, and ease of use, with reduced intent to restart conversations. Transcript analysis of representative user study conversations shows that mutable transcripts can reduce conversation length and eliminate obsolete retained context. These findings provide initial evidence that user-driven revision of conversational history can improve interaction quality and help maintain a more current representation of user intent. The source code and prototype can be accessed at https://github.com/QxLabIreland/ReChat

</details>


### [227] [Programs-of-Layers in LLMs through the Lens of Cortical Areas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31360)
*Justus Westerhoff,Stephan Olbrich,Hatem Oraby,Matthew Evan Larkum,Felix Alexander Gers*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文复现并深挖了Li等人(2026)提出的program-of-layers (PoLar)——将Transformer层视为可函数库并动态路由。跨5个模型复现了跳跃优于标准前向、重复优于跳跃、二者结合最优等结论，但未能复现其学习路由器在单次推理中的核心主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统LLM推理对所有输入均采用固定深度、固定顺序的逐层前向，忽视输入难度差异；而人脑以丘脑为枢纽按需灵活路由皮层信息。作者希望借鉴这一机制，检验层可被当作函数库、按需路由的Transformer是否可行，并对PoLar进行更细致、更大范围的复现与诊断。

Method: 以比原论文更细致的方式重建PoLar的诊断性MCTS，并在5个模型上运行。动态地将每个输入路由经过由跳过的或重复的连续层块组成的自适应序列，分析所生成程序（program）的结构、长度与鲁棒性，并检验其学习路由器在单次推理下的表现。

Result: 复现了多项结论：跳跃优于标准前向，重复优于跳跃，二者结合优于任一单独方式；更简单的问题可用更短程序解决，更难的问题需要更多层重复。但未能复现其学习路由器在单次推理中的核心主张：其排名第一的预测始终退化为标准前向，尽管其top-k预测程序合起来确有实际精度提升。此外发现少量通用程序足以解决大多数问题，且纠错类程序高度脆弱——程序内部即便撤销一处改动，通常也会破坏该纠错效果。

Conclusion: PoLar的层路由思路在人脑丘脑-皮层协调机制上具有类比意义，反映了类皮层区域Transformer层间的协调原则；但原论文关于学习路由器单次推理的核心结论不稳定，且纠错程序脆弱性突出。作者公开了代码以便进一步验证。

Abstract: Inference in LLMs is conventionally a fixed-depth, fixed-order forward pass through every layer, regardless of how difficult the input is. The human brain does not work this way: using the thalamus as a central hub, it routes information flexibly to all regions of the cortex according to demand. Li et al. (2026) recently showed, with a system they call program-of-layers (PoLar), that transformers can be given an analogous flexibility if their layers are treated as a library of functions rather than a fixed sequence. Performance improves over the standard forward pass when each input is dynamically routed through an adaptive sequence of skipped or repeated contiguous layer blocks. We reconstructed PoLar's diagnostic MCTS in more detail than the original paper and applied it across 5 models. We reproduced several of PoLar's findings: skipping outperformed the standard pass, repeating outperformed skipping, and combining both outperformed either alone. Shorter programs sufficed for easier questions, while harder questions required more layer repeats. However, we failed to replicate the main claim regarding their learned router for single-shot inference: its top-ranked prediction consistently collapsed back to the standard pass, even though its top-k predicted programs, taken together, did show a real accuracy gain. Beyond reproduction, we find that a small number of generic programs are enough to solve most of the questions. We also provide a much deeper analysis of these programs' structure and robustness: for example, we found that programs that correct errors are highly brittle: undoing even a single edit inside a program typically breaks the correction. Connecting this to the brain's routing mechanisms, PoLar mirrors principles of thalamo-cortical coordination between cortical-area-like transformer layers. We publicly release the code at https://datexis.github.io/RE-PoLar/

</details>


### [228] [Completed Pairs Hide Capped Failures: A ReVerPi Case Study of Selective Context Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31381)
*Guangzhe Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以 ReVerPi（Pi 扩展）为对象，研究"上下文投影"用紧凑可寻址摘要替代旧工具观测的权衡。在 86 次运行、641 次模型请求的记录中，15 组配对显示两臂成功率相同（各 12/15）；联合正确配对中，投影使逻辑 token 总量降 25%，但配对中位数 token 增 29%，后缀请求从 35 增至 55。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 上下文投影能减少重复输入，但可能引入额外的证据检索轮次；作者希望用配对（full/projected）实验量化这一权衡，并借此暴露评测方法上的问题——如停止规则、未执行对照臂与资源聚合方式对结论的影响。

Method: 构建 ReVerPi：保留归档观测，并配对 full/projected 续写。开展 86 次源阅读运行（641 次模型请求），完成 15 组配对；对失败的 12 组边界运行做规则补充（首臂失败即抑制对照臂），并恢复全部 27 组边界运行以给出成功率差的界限。区分拟合与评测，比较选择器在拟合对之外的表现。统计逻辑 token、后缀请求、成功层内的 token 变化。

Result: 15 组完成配对两臂成功一致（各 12/15）。12 组边界运行中因首臂未完成而抑制对照；恢复 27 组边界后，投影减全量成功率差落在 −9 到 +1 个任务之间。一例被选择器挑中但省略的投影续写成功检索归档文本却耗尽 12 次请求，其全量对照仅用 3 次。11 组联合正确配对内，投影使聚合逻辑 token 降 25%，但配对中位数 token 升 29%、后缀请求由 35 升至 55。拟合外 13 次可比运行中，选择器多 1 次失败、逻辑 token 多 8.6%。

Conclusion: 该方法是连接停止规则、已知有界失败、未执行对照臂与资源聚合的案例研究；结论仅适用于所记录的活动，不代表对无限制 Pi 的总体非劣性或优效性。评测应保留每个干预边界、使两臂独立于首臂完成情况执行，并同时报告完成率、交互与 token 开销。

Abstract: Context projection replaces older tool observations with compact, addressable excerpts, reducing repeated input while potentially adding evidence-retrieval turns. We study this trade-off in ReVerPi, a Pi extension with archived observations and matched full/projected continuations. In an 86-run source-reading campaign with 641 model requests, the 15 completed pairs show identical success: 12/15 per arm. Twelve further boundary runs stop, with the runner suppressing the companion whenever the first arm fails to complete. Restoring all 27 boundary runs bounds projected-minus-full success between $-$9 and +1 tasks. One omitted, selector-chosen projected continuation successfully retrieves archive text yet exhausts twelve requests; its full counterpart answers in three. The eleven jointly correct pairs form a fully observed success stratum within this recorded frame: projection reduces aggregate logical tokens by 25%, while increasing the median pair's tokens by 29% and total suffix requests from 35 to 55. Separating fitting from evaluation changes the selector's apparent tie: outside its four fitting pairs, it incurs one extra failure and 8.6% more logical tokens over thirteen comparable runs. This methodological case study connects stopping rules, known bounded failures, unexecuted companions, and resource aggregation. Its findings concern the recorded campaign, rather than population noninferiority or superiority over unrestricted Pi. Evaluations should retain every intervention boundary, execute both allocated arms independently of the first arm's completion, and report completion alongside interaction and token expenditure.

</details>


### [229] [Compress What You See, Not What You Say: Anchored Context Distillation for Latent-Observation Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31430)
*Zhensheng Zou,Guoqing Wang,Dan Hao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LOHA（潜在观测+硬动作上下文布局）与ACD（锚定上下文蒸馏）训练方法，在压缩软件工程智能体上下文的同时保留动作关键信息与原始行为，实现43%–57%的上下文缩减并在部分设置下保持甚至提升任务解决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具观测占据软件工程智能体上下文的绝大部分，导致长交互历史维护成本高昂。现有上下文压缩方法可能丢弃后续动作所需信息，而将智能体适配到软token表示又会损害其原始行为。因此需要在压缩上下文的同时，既保留动作关键信息，又保持智能体行为不变。

Method: 方法由两部分组成：1）LOHA（Latent Observations, Hard Actions）上下文布局，将较早的工具观测压缩为软token，同时以文本形式保留智能体自身对话轮次和最近K条观测，从而兼顾历史信息的紧凑访问与近期内容的精确访问；2）ACD（Anchored Context Distillation）训练方法，将基座模型在全文输入下的预测蒸馏到潜在表示视图中，同时在纯文本输入上以同一基座模型锚定行为，使智能体能够读取潜在表示并约束行为漂移。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，K=3使Qwen3-4B每次调用上下文减少43%、SWE-Master-4B-RL减少57%，解决率分别为12.1%和21.8%，而未压缩基座分别为14.5%和27.5%。单次运行的近因窗口扫描在K=8时达到14.4%和23.0%，较大的窗口通常更有利于任务性能而非压缩率。在32K token限制下，Qwen3在K=3时于199个实例子集上解决率为21.1%，而同一适配智能体使用全文时为11.1%；在并发单GPU服务中，其实例吞吐量达到全文智能体的1.9倍。

Conclusion: LOHA与ACD可在显著压缩软件工程智能体上下文的同时，基本保持甚至在某些受限预算场景下提升任务解决率与吞吐量，表明分离压缩历史与精确引用并结合锚定蒸馏，是兼顾上下文效率与行为保真的有效途径。

Abstract: Tool observations dominate the context of software-engineering agents, making long interaction histories costly to maintain. Existing context compression methods can discard information needed by later actions, while adapting agents to soft-token representations can compromise their original behavior. To reduce context while preserving action-critical information and agent behavior, we combine Latent Observations, Hard Actions (LOHA), a context layout that separates compressed history from text needed for exact reference, with Anchored Context Distillation (ACD), a training method that enables latent reading while constraining behavioral drift. LOHA compresses older tool observations into soft tokens while retaining the agent's own turns and the last K observations in text, providing compact access to historical information and exact access to recent content. To enable the agent to use this representation, ACD distills the base model's full-text predictions into the latent view while anchoring its behavior on plain-text inputs to the same base model. On SWE-bench Verified, K=3 reduces context per call by 43% for Qwen3-4B and 57% for SWE-Master-4B-RL, with resolve rates of 12.1% and 21.8% versus 14.5% and 27.5% for their uncompressed bases. A single-run recency sweep reaches 14.4% and 23.0% at K=8, with larger windows generally favoring task performance over compression. Under a 32K-token limit, Qwen3 with K=3 resolves 21.1% of a 199-instance subset versus 11.1% for the same adapted agent using full text. In concurrent single-GPU serving, it achieves 1.9 times that full-text agent's instance throughput.

</details>


### [230] [Segment-Level Agentic Topic Modeling for Improved Data Exploration and Resource Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31460)
*Myeongjun Erik Jang,Antonios Georgiadis,Sae Young Moon,Fran Silavong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SeLATM框架，通过"片段级主题生成"与"智能体反馈循环的主题精炼"，解决LLM主题模型在主题分配过程中的固有缺陷，在显著降低LLM资源消耗的同时保持优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统主题建模算法生成的主题可读性差，而新兴的基于LLM的主题模型虽能生成更自然、人类可读的主题，但因其依赖"先让LLM生成主题、再将主题分配给文档"的分配式流程，导致若干缺陷：无法产出文档层面的主题分布、主题过宽或过窄、资源消耗高且随文档数量与长度增长。这些问题对需要高质量深度分析并处理海量文档的工业应用尤为关键。

Method: 提出SeLATM框架：采用片段级（segment-level）主题生成，替代文档级主题分配；并通过智能体反馈循环（agentic feedback loops）对生成的主题进行迭代精炼。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，与基于主题分配流程的方法相比，SeLATM显著减少了LLM资源消耗，同时保持更优的性能表现。

Conclusion: SeLATM通过片段级主题生成与智能体反馈精炼，有效缓解了LLM主题模型在主题质量、文档主题分布缺失及资源消耗方面的不足，兼顾高效性与性能，适合工业级大规模文档分析场景。

Abstract: Topic modeling is an effective technique for discovering hidden themes within documents and is widely used in text mining and data analysis across a variety of industry sectors. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based topic models have been emerged that prompt LLMs to generate topics then assign the topics to documents, producing more natural and human-readable topics than conventional topic modeling algorithms. However, the nature of topic assignment process causes certain drawbacks, such as the incapability to produce topic distributions over a document, too broad or narrow topics, and high resource consumption, which increases with the number and length of of documents being assigned topics. These issues are particularly critical for industrial applications, which require high-quality, in-depth analysis and the processing of large volumes of documents. In this context, this paper introduces a framework called SeLATM, which addresses these concerns by employing segment-level topic generation and topic refinement through agentic feedback loops. Experimental results on various datasets demonstrate that SeLATM significantly reduces the LLM resources compared to methods based on topic assignment process, while maintaining superior performance.

</details>


### [231] [Game Arena: Strategic LLM Evaluation in Competitive Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31473)
*Bovard Doerschuk-Tiberi,Yao Yan,Justin Chiu,Hann Wang,Timothy Chung,Martyna Plomecka,John Schultz,Jon Lipovetz,Clayton Drazner,Yuchen Zhuang,Jaimie Hwang,Nate Keating,Riley Jones,Andrew Lee,Oran Kelly,Ian Gemp,Michael Aaron,Laurel Prince,Kate Larson,Jeff Moser,Harrison Jobe,Chad Woodford,Siqi Liu,Andrew Wang,Bo Chang,Christopher D'Mello,Diane Chaleff,Addison Howard,Johnny Yip,Chuck Sugnet,Antonio Gulli,Meghan O'Connell,Will Cukierski,Nenad Tomasev,Dima Yeroshenko,Kinjal Parekh,Roxanne Daniel,Marc Lanctot,Domino Weir,Elsa Dong,Daniel Hennes,Melissa Nalubwama,Robert Fraser,Ryan Trostle,Jun Peng,Tom Mason,Lloyd Hightower,Chiamaka Chukwuka,Yuexiang Zhai,Phoebe Kirk,Yi Su,Yuting Han,Jie Ren,Chris Prichard,Sahand Sharifzadeh,Karim Hakimzadeh,DJ Sterling,Meg Risdal,Kate Olszewska,Ya Xu,Orhan Firat,Minmin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出Kaggle Game Arena，一个通过竞争性游戏评估大语言模型的开放平台，并介绍了国际象棋、扑克和狼人杀三个试点环境的架构、评测指标与竞赛结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态基准容易随模型能力提升而饱和，无法持续有效地区分和评估LLM能力；游戏对抗环境能随模型进化自然提升难度，避免性能饱和，并可系统研究模型在不确定条件下的策略规划、适应与鲁棒性。

Method: 构建开放且可扩展的Game Arena平台及其底层基础设施，使模型在结构化环境中进行一对一对抗；选择国际象棋（完全信息）、扑克（不完全信息）和狼人杀（多人博弈）三类游戏作为试点环境，为每个游戏定义环境描述、评测指标，并通过大规模真值评估开展完整模型竞赛。

Result: 给出了三个试点游戏的详细环境说明、评测指标以及跨模型完整竞赛的运行结果，覆盖完全信息、不完全信息与多人设置。

Conclusion: 稳健的基础设施与大规模基于真值的评估保证了可复现性、透明度，并具备向新游戏及变体扩展的通用性。

Abstract: We introduce Kaggle Game Arena, an open and ever-expanding platform to evaluate large language models (LLMs) through competitive games. Different from static benchmarks, game arena enables models to play head-to-head matchups in structured environments where the gameplay strength naturally increases as models evolve, preventing performance saturation. This technical report details the infrastructure behind Game Arena and describes the three pilot game environments: Chess, Poker, and Werewolf. These environments span perfect information, imperfect information, and multiplayer game settings, enabling a systematic study of models' strategic planning, adaptation, and robustness under uncertainty. For each game, we provide a detailed description of the environment, evaluation metrics, and results from running full competitions across models. Through robust infrastructure and large-scale ground-truth based evaluation, Game Arena ensures reproducibility, transparency and generalizability to new games and variants over time.

</details>


### [232] ["AI is (not) the new...": A Diagnostic Analogy Framework for Generative AI's Cultural Impacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31482)
*Rida Qadri,Vinodkumar Prabhakaran,Remi Denton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个诊断性框架，用于分析生成式AI如何重塑认知与文化实践，取代以往含糊的历史类比，并区分结构性文化后果与偶然性后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学者与政策制定者常以印刷术、蒸汽动力或电力等历史技术类比生成式AI，但这些类比往往未明确技术中哪一属性承载比较，导致针对错误属性设计干预，产生不精确的治理。

Method: 将每项干预分解为三个坐标：技术作用的认知场所（epistemic site）、组织其对象的治理逻辑（governing logic）、以及使该逻辑得以实例化的技术机制（technical mechanism）。据此区分源于机制本身的结构性文化后果与仍开放于设计和制度选择的偶然性后果。应用于信息发现与知识综合，分析从索引性到推断、从编辑权威到统计共识的转变。

Result: 该框架揭示出上述转变产生具体且可追溯的文化效应，并暴露出被格式塔式类比所掩盖的治理杠杆。

Conclusion: 以三坐标诊断框架替代含糊的历史类比，可更精确地定位生成式AI的文化影响与治理介入点，区分结构性约束与可设计选择。

Abstract: Generative AI is reshaping the cultural infrastructures through which knowledge is found, synthesized, and held accountable. To make sense of this shift, scholars and policymakers reach for historical analogies of technologies such as the printing press, steam power or electricity. But these comparisons are typically imprecise about which property of the technology carries the comparison, and imprecise analogies produce imprecise governance by designing interventions against the wrong property of the system. This paper offers a diagnostic framework for analyzing how generative AI can transform epistemic and cultural practice. This paper offers a diagnostic framework for analyzing how generative AI can transform epistemic and cultural practice. We decompose each intervention into three coordinates: the epistemic site at which a technology acts, the governing logic by which it organizes its object, and the technical mechanism through which the logic is instantiated. This framework allows us to distinguish between structural cultural consequences, which follow from the mechanism itself, from contingent ones, which remain open to design and institutional choice. Applying the framework to information discovery and knowledge synthesis, we show how the shift from indexicality to inference and from editorial authority to statistical consensus produces specific, traceable cultural effects and reveals governance levers that gestalt analogy obscures.

</details>


### [233] [UQ-LOB: Uncertainty-Aware Limit Order Book Mid-Price Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31491)
*Derrick Gilchrist Edward Manoharan,Eljas Linna,Kestutis Baltakys,Hao Dong,Juho Kanniainen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UQ-LOB——一个轻量、编码器无关的不确定性量化模块，可附加到任意预训练的LOB编码器上，为限价订单簿短周期中间价预测提供校准的置信度，支持选择性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度LOB预测器多为点预测，只输出方向或位移，无法告知哪些预测可信，缺乏不确定性量化。

Method: 受attentive neural processes启发，UQ-LOB以近期已完成窗口的上下文集合为条件进行预测；UQ-regression输出经校准的高斯分布（未来tick位移），UQ-classification输出down/up/stationary的类别分布，二者均给出标量置信度（预测信噪比或类别概率）以支持选择性预测。

Result: 在七种加密资产、52亿条LOB事件、5/10/15秒周期上，UQ-regression达到近名义的68%区间覆盖率；仅保留置信度最高的10%预测时，方向macro F1在UQ-regression提升0.11–0.15、UQ-classification提升0.05–0.11；在5秒周期的大幅经济性变动上，最高置信层级的方向F1达0.88（下跌）与0.83（上涨）。

Conclusion: UQ-LOB可即插即用地为任意LOB编码器提供校准、可靠的不确定性估计，通过选择性预测显著提升预测质量，具有实际交易价值。

Abstract: Forecasting short-horizon mid-price movements from limit order book (LOB) data is central to algorithmic trading, yet most deep LOB forecasters are point predictors: they output a direction or a displacement, but never indicate which of their forecasts can be trusted. We introduce UQ-LOB, a lightweight, encoder-agnostic uncertainty quantification module that attaches to any pretrained LOB encoder and, in the spirit of attentive neural processes, conditions each forecast on a context set of recently completed windows whose outcomes are already realised. The UQ-regression variant outputs a calibrated Gaussian over the future tick displacement, while the UQ-classification variant outputs a categorical distribution over down/up/stationary. Both expose a scalar confidence (predicted signal-to-noise ratio or class probability) that supports selective prediction. On 5.2 billion LOB events across seven cryptocurrency assets and horizons of 5, 10 and 15 seconds, UQ-regression attains near-nominal 68% interval coverage, and restricting to the most confident 10% of predictions raises directional macro F1 by 0.11-0.15 for UQ-regression and 0.05-0.11 for UQ-classification, at every horizon. On large, economically meaningful moves, the tightest confidence tier reaches a directional F1 of 0.88 (down) and 0.83 (up) at the 5-second horizon.

</details>


### [234] [Prompt Minimization: Reducing Input Redundancy Without Sacrificing Output Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31505)
*Marius F. R. Juston,Kevin A. Karim,Jonathan Gao,Kevin C. Li,Rudhi Bashambu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出"提示最小化"（prompt minimization），即在保持输出保真度的前提下将提示压缩至最小、信息密度最高的形式，并提出三种框架识别与评估最小提示，证明最小提示的输出常可与更长提示相媲美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的提示设计仍主要依赖启发式与临时性方法，缺乏系统性。理论上，多个提示可产生等价输出，说明输入空间存在高度冗余，引发了对"哪些信息对激发特定模型行为是必要的"这一根本问题的思考。实践上，过长提示会带来计算开销与推理延迟，并可能损害LLM的推理与准确率。

Method: 提出三种变体框架（three variant frameworks），用于识别和评估最小提示（minimal prompts）。

Result: 实验表明，最小提示往往能产生与其更长对应版本相当（comparable）的输出。

Conclusion: 研究为高效提示工程提供了新方向，并加深了对LLM中输入压缩（input compression）机制的理解。

Abstract: Despite the growing capabilities of large language models (LLMs), prompt design remains largely heuristic and ad hoc. This project will explore $\textit{prompt minimization}$, the process of reducing prompts to their smallest, most information-dense form while preserving output fidelity. Practically, shorter prompts reduce computational overhead and inference latency, especially when large contexts, such as entire documents or codebases, are included unnecessarily. Further, longer prompts can damage LLM reasoning and accuracy. Theoretically, the existence of multiple prompts yielding equivalent outputs suggests a high degree of redundancy in the input space, raising fundamental questions about what information is essential to elicit specific model behaviors. We propose three variant frameworks to identify and evaluate minimal prompts and demonstrate that minimal prompts often produce outputs comparable to those of their longer counterparts. These findings suggest new directions for efficient prompt engineering and deepen our understanding of input compression in LLMs.

</details>


### [235] [Multi-agent Scaling Across Disjunctive and Compensatory Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31563)
*Carolina Fortuna,Blaz Bertalanic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将群体任务分类学引入多智能体LLM扩展性分析，发现任务结构与输出聚合机制共同决定团队规模收益：析取型任务中团队扩大可提升"至少一个正确"的概率5-20点，但多数投票几乎无法兑现该潜力；补偿型（费米估计）任务中扩展收益极小，模型内偏置解释了约87%的平方误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统常被默认"团队越大越好"，但作者认为扩展行为可能依赖任务结构，缺乏统一的分类框架来区分不同类型任务上的扩展规律，因此需要以群体任务分类学来系统刻画这一问题。

Method: 引入Steiner群体任务分类学作为分析框架，聚焦析取型与补偿型任务；将独立采样智能体建模为在给定条目下条件独立，推导大团队极限（多数投票收敛于模型众数答案，平均收敛于条目级偏置）；在若干代表性基准、13个开放权重模型、最多30个智能体的团队上进行实验，涵盖直接作答、多数投票、多轮修订、跨模型族组合等机制。

Result: 析取型任务上"至少一个正确"的概率随团队规模增长5-20点，但多数投票几乎无法兑现该潜力（平均仅达模型预测值0.5点以内）；多轮修订显著提升准确率，但1个同伴与29个同伴的增益几乎相同；费米估计上扩展几乎无收益，条目级偏置解释约87%的平方误差，平均仅降低约6%误差；跨模型族组合在费米估计上有效，但在析取型任务上不超过最强单体。

Conclusion: 任务结构与成员输出的组合机制是决定多智能体团队扩展效果的根本因素，单纯扩大团队规模并非普遍有效的提升途径，需根据任务类型匹配相应的聚合与协作机制。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are often expected to improve as team size increases, yet the scaling behavior may depend on task structure. Our central contribution is to introduce Steiner's taxonomy of group tasks as a framework for analyzing multi-agent LLM scaling and focusing the analysis on disjunctive and compensatory tasks. We model independently sampled agents as conditionally independent given the item, which yields their large-team limits: plurality voting converges to the model's modal answer, and averaging converges to the model's item-level bias. Across selected representative benchmarks, 13 open-weight models, and teams of up to 30 agents, we find qualitatively different scaling behavior. On disjunctive tasks, the probability that at least one agent is correct grows by 5-20 points with team size, but plurality voting over agents that answer directly realises almost none of this potential, as the model predicts to within 0.5 points on average. Multi-round revision raises accuracy considerably, yet the gain is nearly the same with one peer as with 29. In contrast, scaling provides little benefit on Fermi estimation, despite its natural suitability for aggregation: item-level biases shared across the samples of a model account for about 87% of the squared error, so averaging reduces error by only about 6%. Combining model families helps on Fermi estimation but does not surpass the strongest member on disjunctive tasks. These results show that task structure, together with the mechanism combining member outputs, is a fundamental determinant of team scaling.

</details>


### [236] [DeepEdu-v1: Efficient and Scalable Agentic LLMs for Vietnamese Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31568)
*Quang Nguyen,Hieu Nguyen,Hien Hoang,Toan Pham,Cong Tran,Nam Vu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DeepEdu-v1，一个面向越南教育的 AI 辅导系统，基于 SCALE 框架，通过长上下文推理引擎与自改进智能体层，在消费级 GPU 本地部署下实现约 x2 的 TTFT 加速，并将复杂任务的智能体准确率从 70.0% 提升至 79.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发展中地区（如越南）的 AI 辅导可显著改善学习效果，但现有两条路径均存在不足：云端助手（如 ChatGPT）会将敏感学生数据传至境外服务器，违反越南第 53 号法令等数据主权法规，且因预训练语料以西方为中心，未围绕本国教材课程组织，本地知识不成体系、易产生幻觉；自托管开源模型虽可保证数据本地化，却面临双重瓶颈——训练后量化虽能压缩静态权重占用，但长辅导上下文的动态 KV 缓存与预填充延迟仍导致消费级 GPU 上内存溢出和响应缓慢，同时模型对区域特定材料仍持续幻觉。

Method: 提出 DeepEdu-v1 系统，构建于 SCALE（Self-improving Context-Aware Learning Engine）框架，包含两项创新：其一为长上下文推理引擎，将 token 选择从每个子块粒度摊销到每个簇粒度；其二为自改进智能体层，从历史交互中持续整理经过验证的 playbook，而非进行微调，以随可信本地知识积累逐步降低对主导语言先验的依赖。

Result: 在长上下文检索上，检索调用次数比最先进的选择性注意力基线少 x7.7，预填充延迟（TTFT）降低约 35%，同时任务准确率持平或更优。在部署配置下，DeepEdu 相比标准 vLLM 服务实现近 x2 的 TTFT 加速，并将复杂任务的智能体准确率从 70.0% 提升至 79.5%，在金融推理与交互式智能体基准上取得最强分项提升。

Conclusion: DeepEdu-v1 在满足数据主权与本地部署约束的前提下，有效缓解长上下文推理的延迟与内存瓶颈，并通过自改进机制持续提升本地化任务的可靠性，为发展中地区的课程对齐 AI 辅导提供了可行路径。

Abstract: AI tutoring could markedly improve learning outcomes for students in developing regions such as Vietnam, yet the two obvious paths both fall short. Cloud assistants such as ChatGPT route sensitive student data to foreign servers---violating data-sovereignty laws such as Vietnam's Decree 53---and, pre-trained on Western-centric corpora, are not organized around the national textbook curriculum, so their knowledge of local content is unsystematic and frequently hallucinated. Self-hosting an open model keeps data on-premise but hits a two-fold wall: post-training quantization (AWQ, GPTQ) tames the static weight footprint, yet the dynamic KV cache and prefill latency of long tutoring contexts still cause out-of-memory failures and slow responses on consumer GPUs, while the model keeps hallucinating on region-specific material. We present DeepEdu-v1, an AI-tutoring system for Vietnamese education built on SCALE (Self-improving Context-Aware Learning Engine), a framework with two innovations. First, a long-context inference engine amortizes token selection from per-sub-chunk to per-cluster granularity; on long-context retrieval it issues x7.7 fewer retrieval calls than a state-of-the-art selective-attention baseline, cutting prefill latency (TTFT) by roughly 35% while matching or improving task accuracy. Second, a self-improving agentic layer continuously curates a verified playbook from past interactions instead of fine-tuning, a design intended to progressively reduce reliance on dominant-language priors as trustworthy local knowledge accumulates. In its deployed configuration, DeepEdu achieves a nearly x2 TTFT speedup over standard vLLM serving and lifts agentic accuracy from 70.0% to 79.5% on complex tasks, with the strongest per-track gains across financial-reasoning and interactive-agent benchmarks.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [237] [Nearest but Not Dearest: Shared Curator-Feedback Infrastructure for Content-Only Search and Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30568)
*Matt Sandler*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在无终端用户行为信号的B2B音乐发现平台上，策展人拒绝案例可清晰划分为"音质失败"（55%）与"语境失败"（37%），分别路由至嵌入重加权与约束过滤层，使拒绝率由38.17%降至28.83%（相对下降24.5%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该部署平台同时提供查询驱动检索与种子驱动推荐，但两条路径均不消费终端用户行为信号，唯一主要反馈来源是策展人判断。然而离线余弦相似度对 curated 判断预测能力差（最近邻中被拒比例达38%），因此需要一种能够在内容受限条件下有效利用策展反馈的机制。

Method: 提出"音质失败 vs 语境失败"分解作为反馈基础设施：将语境失败（语言、节日、宗教内容、版权与歌词标记等）路由至候选生成阶段的约束过滤器；将音质失败（风格、节奏、情绪不匹配）路由至表示层的嵌入重加权头。两者均位于检索/推荐分支之下，因此单一策展人循环可同时维护两种体验。

Result: 在两个生产轮次（相隔一个月）收集的1,200条策展判断上，联合干预使拒绝率从38.17%降至28.83%，相对下降24.5%（McNemar χ²=22.4，p=2.2e-6）。归因分解显示过滤器可覆盖类别贡献4.08个百分点，其余类别贡献5.25个百分点；因部署未设盲且为复合干预，该结果仅为生产归因上界，非因果估计。

Conclusion: 本文作为工业案例研究而非已验证的通用方法，提出内容受限发现的关键经验：失败划分与范式划分相互正交，而纠正措施落在两种范式共享的层上。

Abstract: A deployed B2B music-discovery platform serves both query-driven search (text prompts, vibe tags) and seed-driven recommendation (seed-track and artist stations) over one licensed catalog, one LAION-CLAP joint audio-text embedding space, one candidate-generation filter, and one ranking head -- and neither path consumes end-listener behavioral signal. In this content-only regime, curator judgment is the principal feedback signal available, and offline cosine similarity predicts it poorly: 38% of cosine-nearest neighbors are rejected by curators. The rejections reveal a clean partition: a majority (55%) are sound failures the encoder could address (style, tempo, mood mismatch), and a substantial minority (37%) are context failures orthogonal to the waveform (wrong language, holiday content, devotional content, rights and lyric flags). We deploy this sound-vs-context decomposition as feedback infrastructure, routing each failure mode to the layer that can absorb it: context failures to a constraint filter at candidate generation, sound failures to an embedding reweighting head at the representation layer -- both below the search/recommendation split, so a single curator loop maintains both experiences. On 1,200 curator judgments collected over two production rounds one month apart, the combined intervention reduces rejection rate from 38.17% to 28.83% (-24.5% relative, McNemar chi-squared = 22.4, p = 2.2e-6). An accounting decomposition attributes 4.08 pp of the drop to filter-eligible categories and 5.25 pp to the rest; the deployment was unblinded and compound, so this is a production accounting bound, not a causal estimate. We present this as an industrial case study rather than a validated general method, and close with lessons for content-only discovery: the failure partition is orthogonal to the paradigm partition, and corrections land in layers shared by both paradigms.

</details>


### [238] [Embedding Subspace Partitioning for Dynamic Multi-Objective Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30601)
*Shaobo Zhang,Alice Leung,Yunxiang Ren,Ping Liu,Yuchin Juan,Qianqi Shen,Benjamin Le,Jianqiang Shen,Chengming Jiang,Ko-Cheng Wang,Vidya Krishnamurthy,Caleb Johnson,Fedor Borisyuk,Luke Simon,Jingwei Wu,Wenjing Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出Embedding Subspace Partitioning (ESP)，将检索嵌入分解为任务感知子空间，用子空间相似度的可调权重和替代单一内积，实现服务时可动态调整多目标优先级，兼具单索引kNN效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统需平衡语义相关性与互动、收入等业务指标。双编码器虽高效，但将异质信号压缩进单一静态嵌入空间，训练后无法在不重训的情况下适应服务时变化的目标优先级；多目标联合优化还易产生目标间干扰，导致次优权衡。

Method: ESP将嵌入分解为任务感知子空间，以各子空间相似度的加权和替代单一点积，权重可在服务时调节。对Transformer双编码器，利用原生EOS token作为分段定界符，配合分段感知注意力掩码与位置编码重置，在单次前向传播中保证子空间隔离。服务阶段在拼接后的单一索引上做GPU加速的穷举kNN，无需多头部方法所需的按目标ANN基础设施。

Result: 在基于MS MARCO构建的开源基准上，单个ESP模型可描绘出较宽的帕累托前沿，在多个工作点上持续优于强多任务基线。在LinkedIn职位匹配平台（周活超7000万）中，ESP支持动态检索重配置并带来关键业务指标的显著提升。

Conclusion: ESP以子空间分解与可调权重实现服务时可配置的多目标检索，缓解目标干扰，并在保持单索引高效服务的同时优于多任务基线，已在工业级平台验证其实用价值。

Abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems must optimize across competing objectives, balancing semantic relevance with business metrics such as engagement and revenue. While bi-encoders dominate large-scale retrieval due to their efficiency, they collapse these heterogeneous signals into a single static embedding space. This design creates a fundamental limitation: once trained, the retriever cannot adapt to shifting objective priorities at serving time without retraining. Moreover, joint optimization with multi-objective losses often induces interference between objectives, leading to suboptimal trade-offs. We propose Embedding Subspace Partitioning (ESP), a retrieval framework that decomposes the embedding into task-aware subspaces and replaces the single dot product with a weighted sum of per-subspace similarities, whose weights are tunable at serving time. For Transformer bi-encoders, ESP uses the model's native end-of-sequence token as a segment delimiter, with segment-aware attention masking and position encoding resets to guarantee subspace isolation in a single forward pass. Serving is performed via GPU-accelerated exhaustive kNN over one concatenated index, eliminating the need for per-objective Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) infrastructure required by multi-head approaches. We evaluate ESP on an open-source benchmark built from MS MARCO. A single ESP model traces a broad Pareto frontier, consistently outperforming strong multi-task baselines across diverse operating points. In LinkedIn's job matching platform (70M+ weekly users), ESP enabled dynamic retrieval reconfiguration and delivered significant key business metric lifts.

</details>


### [239] [Component Benchmark: Hierarchical Model Profiling for Large-scale Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30656)
*Dharak Kharod,Yuzhen Huang,Zhou Wang,Jackie Xu,Fuzail Khan,Jacky Zhou,Hao Yan,Lidong Zhao,Xizhou Feng,Yvonne Liu,Karthik Jayaraman,Praveen Ramachandran,Vishwa Karia,Yashasvi Makin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Component Benchmark (CB)，一种面向大规模推荐模型的层级化性能分析系统，通过对每个子模块独立基准测试，提供树状交互式可视化，弥补标准分析工具无法归因到子模块的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推荐模型架构高度异构，混合了内存带宽受限操作、小型计算受限密集层、由不规则类别特征导致的动态形状以及低算术强度操作。这些模型演化迅速，工程师在缺乏硬件执行可见性的情况下进行组合实验。现有标准分析工具只能提供端到端吞吐或算子级跟踪，无法将性能归因到工程师实际关心的子模块上，因此亟需新的分析手段。

Method: CB 提供一个简单且可扩展的、基于子模块的基准测试框架，采用插件架构，支持以层级方式对每个子模块独立进行性能刻画。系统生成树状结构的交互式可视化，将性能信息清晰呈现给机器学习工程师。

Result: 作者在常见开源模型上验证了 CB 的有效性，并说明 CB 已被用于加速现代推荐模型的性能分析与优化工作。

Conclusion: CB 弥补了现有分析工具在异构推荐模型子模块性能归因上的空白，其可扩展的插件化框架与层级可视化能有效支撑 TB 级、运行于数千 GPU、每日处理千亿样本的大规模推荐模型的性能分析与优化。

Abstract: Large-scale recommendation models pose distinct, under-explored profiling challenges. Most recommendation model architectures are structurally heterogeneous, intermixing memory-bandwidth-bound operations, small compute-bound dense layers, dynamic shapes from jagged categorical features, and low-arithmetic-intensity operations. Recommendation models evolve rapidly as modeling engineers experiment with compositions, often written without visibility into hardware execution characteristics. Standard profiling tools offer either end-to-end throughput or operator-level traces, but cannot attribute performance to the submodules that practitioners reason about. We present Component Benchmark (CB), a profiling system that independently characterizes each submodule performance in a hierarchical manner, providing a tree-structured, interactive visualization that brings performance clarity to ML practitioners. At its core, CB provides a simple yet extensible, submodule-based benchmarking framework with a plugin architecture that enables hierarchical performance analysis. These large-scale recommendation models are TB-scale, run on thousands of GPUs and ingest 100B examples per day. We demonstrate CB's effectiveness on common open sourced models and discuss how CB has been leveraged to accelerate modern recommendation model performance analysis and optimization.

</details>


### [240] [Recommendation World Models for Future-State Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30711)
*Jinfeng Xu,Zheyu Chen,Ziyue Peng,Jianheng Tang,Zheng Lin,Jing Yang,Puzhen Wu,Zheng Xing,Victor C. M. Leung*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出UA-TWM（效用锚定的世界模型接口），在已训练序列推荐排序器之上建模候选列表的局部未来后果，实现目标感知的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列推荐通常只优化当前排序，但每次展示的列表还会塑造后续反馈与用户状态，因此需要让已训练排序器支持对未来后果的决策。

Method: UA-TWM构造邻近列表动作、估计其目标相关后果，并在效用约束下选择替代项，原始参考列表作为无合格替代时的回退。两种实例化：日志回放式结合效用与目标增益估计及校准的失败风险预测；闭环式使用单步状态-动作预测，并依据观测反馈更新决策。

Result: 在MovieLens-25M与KuaiRand-Pure上跨十二个序列骨干评估迁移，在KuaiSim上进行重复目标导向交互。接入该接口后，每个匹配的日志回放骨干的Recall@20、NDCG@20及未来状态对齐均提升。选择消融揭示激进追求目标的效用与风险代价，闭环诊断分离动作条件预测的贡献。

Conclusion: 局部后果建模可在已训练序列排序器周围实现目标感知的列表选择。

Abstract: Sequential recommendation optimizes which items to rank, while each displayed slate also shapes subsequent feedback and user state. We study how a trained ranker can support decisions about these future consequences. We introduce UA-TWM, a utility-anchored world-model interface that constructs nearby slate actions, estimates their target-relevant consequences, and selects an alternative subject to utility constraints. The reference slate serves as a fallback when no alternative qualifies. A logged-replay instantiation combines utility and target-gain estimates with calibrated failure-risk prediction; a closed-loop instantiation uses one-step state-action prediction and updates its decisions after observed feedback. We evaluate transfer across twelve sequential backbones on MovieLens-25M and KuaiRand-Pure, and repeated target-directed interaction in KuaiSim. Attaching the interface improves Recall@20, NDCG@20, and future-state alignment for every matched logged backbone. Selection ablations reveal the utility and risk costs of aggressive target pursuit, while closed-loop diagnostics isolate the contribution of action-conditioned prediction. Local consequence modeling thus enables target-aware selection around a trained sequential ranker.

</details>


### [241] [RecToolBench: Benchmarking Recommendation-Specific Tool Orchestration under Fuzzy User Intent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30717)
*Xiao Chen,Yicheng Zhao,Yingying Wu,Zhendong Chu,Changyi Ma,Qingsong Wen,Xuan Song*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出 RecToolBench——一个基于 MCP 的推荐智能体工具使用基准，覆盖模糊指令下的多维工具编排，揭示工具编排能力是当前智能体推荐系统的主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究正将推荐系统从被动过滤引擎转变为调用外部工具的指令跟随智能体，但已有基准普遍假设用户意图明确、工具环境简化或仅涉及孤立函数调用，缺乏对真实场景中工具编排能力的考察。

Method: 构建 RecToolBench：基于 Model Context Protocol，包含 3 个推荐域、13 个 MCP 服务器、32 个工具、1200+ 可执行任务，覆盖单工具调用、并行调用、顺序工具链与混合编排；采用 synthesize–fuzzify–judge 流水线生成可执行的模糊推荐任务，并以规则化执行检查与 rubric 式 LLM 评估对智能体轨迹打分。

Result: 对代表性大模型的实验显示，语法正确的工具调用并不保证推荐成功；模型在语义参数落地、多步证据整合与有依据的最终推荐上表现不佳，且随编排复杂度上升而显著恶化。

Conclusion: 模糊用户意图下的工具编排是智能体推荐系统的关键瓶颈，RecToolBench 为相关评测提供了标准化基准，数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic recommender systems are shifting recommender systems from passive filtering engines to instruction-following agents that use external tools to resolve user intent. However, existing benchmarks often assume explicit user intent, simplified tool environments, or isolated function calls, leaving realistic tool orchestration for recommendation underexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose RecToolBench, a Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based benchmark for evaluating tool-using recommender agents under fuzzy user instructions. RecToolBench contains more than 1,200 executable tasks across three recommendation domains, 13 MCP servers, and 32 tools, spanning single-tool calls, parallel tool calls, sequential tool chains, and hybrid tool orchestration. We construct RecToolBench with a scalable synthesize--fuzzify--judge pipeline that generates executable fuzzy recommendation tasks, and evaluates agent trajectories using rule-based execution checks and rubric-based LLM evaluation. Experiments on representative LLMs show that syntactically valid tool calls do not guarantee successful recommendations. Models struggle with semantic parameter grounding, multi-step evidence integration, and grounded final recommendations, especially as orchestration complexity increases. Our results identify tool orchestration under fuzzy user intent as a major bottleneck for agentic recommender systems. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/ShawnChenn/RecToolBench.

</details>


### [242] [QReason: Query-Focused Decoupled Chain-of-Thought for Efficient Passage Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30904)
*Yang Zhang,Wenhan Liu,Qiannan Zhu,Mingming Li,Yuanfei Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出QReason框架，将查询聚焦的推理与窗口级段落相关性评估解耦，通过一次性生成并复用排序导向的推理查询，显著降低推理冗余与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于思维链（CoT）的listwise LLM重排器虽能有效处理复杂查询，但采用滑动窗口策略会导致大量冗余推理（反复生成高度相似的CoT）和高延迟。

Method: QReason引入专用重写器（rewriter），一次性生成排序导向的推理查询，捕捉查询核心意图并避免冗余推理，随后以非推理重排器在所有窗口复用该查询。重写器采用两阶段训练：第一阶段通过语义证据的相关段落引导进行监督微调，生成深度接地的查询聚焦CoT；第二阶段应用强化学习，使CoT生成与推理时设置及重排目标对齐，优化listwise指标与段落级判别能力，产出可复用的推理链。

Result: 在BRIGHT基准上，QReason显著减少冗余推理，排名性能与强推理重排器相当或更优，并优于现有查询重写模型。

Conclusion: 将查询推理与窗口级相关性评估解耦并复用推理链，可在不损失重排效果的前提下有效解决CoT重排的冗余与高延迟问题。

Abstract: Passage reranking plays a crucial role in information retrieval by refining the ordering of candidate passages to better reflect relevance. Existing listwise LLM rerankers with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning can handle complex queries effectively, but they suffer from substantial redundancy and high latency due to sliding-window strategies, which repeatedly generate highly similar CoTs. To address this, we propose QReason, a decoupled framework that separates query-focused reasoning from window-specific passage relevance assessment. Specifically, QReason introduces a dedicated rewriter that generates a ranking-oriented reasoning query once, capturing the query's core intent while avoiding redundant reasoning, and then reuses it across all windows with a non-reasoning reranker. The rewriter is trained via a two-stage process that first uses supervised fine-tuning with relevant-passage guidance through semantic evidence to produce deeply grounded, query-focused CoTs. It then applies reinforcement learning to align CoT generation with both the inference-time setting and the reranking objective, optimizing listwise metrics and passage-level discrimination to produce reusable reasoning chains for reranking. Experiments on the BRIGHT benchmark demonstrate that QReason significantly reduces redundant reasoning, achieves ranking performance comparable to or better than strong reasoning-based rerankers, and outperforms existing query rewriting models.

</details>


### [243] [KuaFu: Compressing Long User Behavior into Understanding at Billion Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31045)
*Jiahao Hui,Lin Zhu,Yishen Hu,Jingdong Shu,Zetai Jiang,Xining Ran,Ben Tan,Yeshou Cai,Gong Chen,Haijie Gu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: KuaFu：以单个行为为最小单元的统一行为压缩层，用两轴投影将每条行为压到2-4个token，在四项生产画像任务上匹配或超越未压缩模型，提升吞吐37%-350%，节省190块GPU，并在腾讯广告推荐平台上线10个月，GMV提升1.37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业界普遍采用"任务专用"范式：针对每个任务从全量历史中抽取相关子序列并训练专用模型，但这在生产环境遇到两个瓶颈。其一，单任务序列即便经过过滤仍然极长（如内容兴趣摘要需读取每用户数百条item，序列化为prompt可达数万token），推理开销巨大。其二，画像需高频刷新（每周十亿用户、总聚合约100K QPM），在固定GPU预算下形成硬性吞吐下限，压缩成为必需。然而截断或粗粒度压缩会悄然扭曲画像，引入四类幻觉（虚构、遗漏、日期错配、逻辑断裂），且由于无法评估压缩表示本身，问题只能以难以归因的下游指标弥散式退化形式暴露。

Method: 提出KuaFu，一个统一的行为压缩层，最小压缩单元为单条行为item。核心组件是两轴投影器（two-axis projector），将每个item压缩为2-4个、宽度128-256的token（token轴约10倍、宽度轴约20倍压缩，单item缓存从10KB降至0.5KB）。训练采用面向保真度的四阶段流程，并配合分层的中间评估机制（layered intermediate evaluation），以在压缩表示层面直接评估保真度、抑制上述四类幻觉，而非仅依赖下游指标。整个压缩层可跨任务统一复用，替代任务专用序列抽取与建模。

Result: 在四项生产画像任务上，KuaFu在所有五项核心指标上均匹配或超越未压缩的单任务生产模型，单GPU吞吐提升37%-350%，共节省190块GPU。在公开基准上，同等压缩比下几乎全面优于既有压缩器（域外MRQA上最高+17.7 EM）；在RecBench上，4B规模模型比其8B对照模型高1.90分。系统已在腾讯广告与推荐平台稳定运行十个月，带动整体GMV提升1.37%。

Conclusion: KuaFu表明：以单条行为为最小单元的统一压缩层，可以在显著压缩token数与缓存体积的同时保持甚至提升画像保真度，从而同时缓解长序列推理瓶颈与高频刷新吞吐瓶颈。其分层中间评估有效解决了"压缩表示本身不可评估"的关键难题。该方案具备跨任务通用性与工业可落地性，已在真实大规模广告推荐系统中长期验证并带来可测量的业务收益，为画像压缩提供了一条可复用的新范式。

Abstract: Conversational agents, generative recommenders, and personalized advertising all rest on one capability: understanding each user from raw behavior. Prevailing industrial practice is task-specific: for each task, a relevant subsequence is extracted from the full history and a dedicated model trained on it. In production it hits two bottlenecks. First, even after filtering, a single-task sequence stays extremely long: content-interest summarization reads several hundred items per user, tens of thousands of tokens once serialized as prompt text. Second, profiles are refreshed routinely: a billion users weekly, roughly 100K QPM in aggregate, which under a fixed GPU budget sets a hard throughput floor. Compression is therefore mandatory, yet truncation or coarse compression can silently distort the profile, introducing four hallucination types (fabrication, omission, date misattribution, broken logic) that, with no way to evaluate the compressed representation itself, surface only as diffuse degradation in downstream metrics. We present KuaFu, a unified behavior-compression layer whose minimal unit is one behavior item. A two-axis projector compresses each item into 2-4 tokens of width 128-256 (about 10x along the token axis, 20x along width; per-item cache 10 KB to 0.5 KB), with fidelity-oriented four-stage training and layered intermediate evaluation. Across four production profiling tasks it matches or exceeds uncompressed single-task production models on all five headline metrics, raises per-GPU throughput by 37%-350%, and saves 190 GPUs. On public benchmarks it nearly always beats prior compressors at the same compression ratio (up to +17.7 EM on out-of-domain MRQA); on RecBench, a 4B model surpasses its 8B counterpart by 1.90 points. KuaFu has run on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months, lifting overall GMV by 1.37%.

</details>


### [244] [SPADE: Escaping the Popularity-Similarity Frontier to Measure Serendipitous Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31164)
*Tobias Vente,Maarten Peirsman,Noah Daniëls,Hannu Toivonen,Bart Goethals*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出SPADE（Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation），一种新的离线意外性（serendipity）评估指标，通过用户特定的帕累托前沿综合考虑相似度、流行度与真实相关性，避免现有指标孤立看待相似性或流行度的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线超越准确率（beyond-accuracy）指标往往要么孤立地衡量历史相似性，要么孤立地衡量全局流行度，无法同时兼顾相似度、流行度与用户真实相关性，导致算法可能通过无关或非个性化推荐来"刷分"。

Method: SPADE将所有物品映射到二维空间，直接计算用户特定的帕累托前沿——即最大流行度与历史相似度的边界；随后仅对正确推荐到测试集中的物品，计算其到该边界的欧氏距离，并取平均作为最终的意外性得分。

Result: 在五个数据集和五种基线算法上进行评估，结果证实SPADE的有效性：该指标能成功阻止算法用无关或非个性化推荐来利用超越准确率指标，可靠地隔离出真正的意外性发现。

Conclusion: SPADE通过帕累托前沿的方式集成相似度、流行度与真实相关性，提供了一种更难被投机推荐策略操纵的离线意外性评估方法，为推荐系统超越准确率的评测提供了可靠工具。

Abstract: Recommender systems engineer serendipity to foster active exploration and break predictable consumption cycles. The problem with existing offline beyond-accuracy metrics is that they often either isolate historical similarity or global popularity. We aim to design an evaluation metric that examines similarity, popularity, and actual user relevance. To achieve this, we introduce SPADE (Serendipitous Pareto Distance Evaluation). SPADE maps all items into a two-dimensional space to directly calculate a user-specific Pareto frontier of maximally popular and historically similar items. The final serendipity score is then computed by averaging the minimum Euclidean distance from this boundary strictly for the correctly recommended test-set items. Evaluating SPADE across five datasets and five baseline algorithms confirms its effectiveness; our results show that the metric successfully prevents algorithms from exploiting beyond-accuracy measures with irrelevant or non-personalized recommendations, reliably isolating serendipitous discoveries.

</details>


### [245] [AgentRecommender: LLM Agents Enable Customizable Recommender Systems on the User Side](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31166)
*Ryoma Sato*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentRecommender，利用LLM智能体的调查能力与内部知识，在无需额外数据的情况下灵活构建用户侧推荐系统，让用户轻松创建符合自身偏好的推荐系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统面向平台开发，导致点击诱饵、信息茧房、假新闻传播等问题，这些现象利于平台锁定用户却困扰用户。用户侧推荐系统作为新范式可让用户摆脱平台利益操控，但为其进行个性化定制需要额外数据，构建并不容易。

Method: 提出AgentRecommender方法，利用LLM智能体的调查能力（investigation capability）与内部知识（internal knowledge），在无需额外数据的前提下灵活构建用户侧推荐系统。

Result: 该方法使AgentRecommender能够支持用户便捷地创建针对自身偏好定制的推荐系统，且不依赖额外数据。

Conclusion: AgentRecommender为构建用户侧推荐系统提供了一条无需额外数据的可行路径，使用户能够自主掌控推荐逻辑，摆脱平台导向的推荐弊端。

Abstract: Recommender systems have traditionally been developed for platforms. However, this has given rise to many phenomena that may be advantageous for platform lock-in but are a nuisance to users, such as clickbait, filter bubbles, and the spread of fake news. Recently, user-side recommender systems have been proposed as a new paradigm for solving this problem. If users deploy their own recommender systems, they are no longer at the mercy of the platform's interests. However, building a user-side recommender system is not trivial; in particular, customizing one for oneself requires additional data. We propose AgentRecommender, a method that leverages the investigation capability and internal knowledge of LLM agents to flexibly build user-side recommender systems without additional data. AgentRecommender allows users to easily create recommender systems tailored to their own preferences.

</details>


### [246] [Enriching Sequential Recommendation with Graph Laplacian Positional Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31253)
*Ekaterina Trushkova,Artur Gimranov,Anton Lysenko*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文提出用基于物品共现图的拉普拉斯位置嵌入替换SASRec中学到的序数位置嵌入，在四个公开序列推荐基准上提升了多数排序指标，表明物品图结构信号可有效替代传统序数位置编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列推荐通常依赖可学习的序数位置嵌入来编码用户交互顺序，作者想要探究这种序数信号能否被从物品空间导出的结构化信号所取代。

Method: 从训练交互构建物品共现图，计算其对称归一化拉普拉斯的特征向量，并将其作为冻结的图导出位置嵌入用于SASRec；骨干架构与训练目标保持不变。

Result: 在四个公开序列推荐基准上的实验显示，这一简单替换在多数排序指标上提升了SASRec性能，并与强位置/时间编码基线保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 物品-物品图结构可作为序列推荐中标准序数位置嵌入的有效替代。

Abstract: Sequential recommenders typically rely on learnable positional embeddings to encode the order of user interactions. In this work, we ask whether this ordinal signal can be replaced by a structural one derived from the item space. We propose to use Laplacian positional embeddings in SASRec: we build an item co-occurrence graph from training interactions, compute eigenvectors of its symmetric normalized Laplacian, and use them as frozen graph-derived positional embeddings. The backbone architecture and training objective remain unchanged. Experiments on four public sequential-recommendation benchmarks show that this simple replacement improves SASRec performance on most ranking metrics and remains competitive with strong positional and temporal encoding baselines. These findings indicate that item-item graph structure can be an effective substitute for standard ordinal positional embeddings in sequential recommendation.

</details>


### [247] [Retail Product Search: A Practical Approach at Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31498)
*Darshan Sonagara,Qujiaheng Zhang,Ankit Singh,Alex Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Target提出并部署了一套融合词法检索与向量检索的混合搜索系统，通过嵌入训练、精度控制、多通道结果融合（加权交错）及性能优化，在离线指标和在线A/B测试中均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索是电商驱动用户参与和业务增长的核心功能，需同时返回相关且用户想要的结果。但零售搜索面临独特挑战：用户意图从精确匹配到开放式探索不等；系统需在相关性、收入和利润等多目标间权衡，同时保持低延迟。传统关键词方法难以处理自然语言或语义查询，纯向量搜索又可能丢失关键意图信号或返回低精度结果。

Method: 设计了一套结合词法检索与向量检索的混合搜索系统，涵盖数据处理、嵌入（embedding）训练、最终结果集的精度控制、多通道结果融合（对比多种融合策略后采用加权交错 weighted interleaving），以及为保障生产部署低延迟而采用的性能优化手段。

Result: 离线评估指标得到提升；在线A/B测试中，相较纯词法搜索，点击率提升0.97%、订单转化率提升0.98%、每位访客需求（demand per visitor）提升1.10%，同时零结果搜索大致减半。

Conclusion: 该混合搜索系统已实现规模化部署，每日服务数百万用户，验证了词法与向量检索融合在零售搜索场景中的有效性与可落地性。

Abstract: Search is one of the most important features in e-commerce, directly driving customer engagement and business growth. A good product search system must show both relevant and desirable results. However, retail search presents unique challenges. User intent can range from exact matches to open-ended discovery. Search systems must also balance multiple goals, such as relevance, revenue, and profit, while keeping response times low. Traditional keyword-based methods often fall short in handling natural language or semantic queries. Vector search helps alleviate these issues, but it can miss key intent signals or return low-precision results. In this paper, we present the design of a hybrid search system at Target that combines lexical and vector search. We describe our approach to data processing, embedding training, precision control for the final result set, multi-channel result fusion (where we compared fusion strategies and adopted weighted interleaving), and the performance optimizations used to maintain low latency for production deployment. Our method improves offline evaluation metrics, and in online A/B testing it raised click-through rate by 0.97%, order conversion by 0.98%, and demand per visitor by 1.10% over lexical-only search, while roughly halving zero-result searches. The resulting system is deployed at scale and serves millions of guests daily.

</details>

### [248] [QSV: Quat-Sphere-Vision for Coupled Quaternion Attention on Spherical Lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30592)
*Nicholas Foley,Devin Marinelli,Donny Moore,Diego Enriquez,Amanda Fernandez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QSV用单个单位四元数替代标准注意力中的Q/K/V三投影，其学习到的成对计算几乎全部来自特征传输通道而非注意力权重，且参数量匹配的对照实验表明几何结构本身并未带来增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究稀疏球面视觉模型QSV中注意力与特征传输这两个角色的作用是否对称，并检验其几何结构（四元数相对旋转与球面流形）是否真正带来性能增益。

Method: QSV以每个token的单个可学习单位四元数替代W_Q/W_K/W_V，相对四元数r_ij = q_i* ⊗ q_j同时给出注意力logit Re(r_ij)与三明治积特征传输x ↦ r_ij ⊗ x ⊗ r_ij*，消息在同心Fibonacci球面上的稀疏kNN图上传递。通过只改动目标组件的消融实验、参数量匹配对照（同一图上的标准注意力）以及平坦2D格点对照进行验证。

Result: 去除传输使CIFAR-10与CIFAR-100测试精度下降约4个百分点（CIFAR-100各变体为单次运行）；将学习到的注意力权重替换为均匀平均则精度基本不变。参数量匹配对照中，同一图上的标准注意力超过QSV（均值87.3% vs. 85.9%），同一模型在平坦2D格点上达到91.1%，与同流程训练的ResNet-20相差2.1个百分点（单次运行）。

Conclusion: 在QSV的耦合核中，两个角色高度不对称：几乎全部学习到的成对计算位于传输通道，注意力权重贡献甚微；且四元数-球面几何本身未显示出优势，标准注意力在同构图上反而更优，提示性能主要源自消息传输机制与图结构而非球面/四元数几何。

Abstract: In standard attention, three separately learned projections decide how strongly a token attends to each neighbor ($W_Q$, $W_K$) and how the attended features are transformed before aggregation ($W_V$). We study Quat-Sphere-Vision (QSV), a sparse spherical vision model that replaces this projection triple with a single learned unit quaternion per token: the relative quaternion $r_{ij} = q_i^{*} \otimes q_j$ supplies both the attention logit $\operatorname{Re}(r_{ij})$ and a sandwich-product feature transport $x \mapsto r_{ij} \otimes x \otimes r_{ij}^{*}$, with messages passed over sparse kNN graphs on concentric Fibonacci spheres. Ablations that change only the targeted component show the two roles to be asymmetric. Removing the transport reduces test accuracy by about four percentage points on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (single runs per CIFAR-100 variant), while replacing the learned attention weights with uniform averaging leaves it essentially unchanged. Parameter-matched controls then remove the geometry itself: standard attention on the same graph exceeds QSV (mean $87.3\%$ vs. $85.9\%$), and the same model on a flat 2D lattice reaches $91.1\%$, within $2.1$ points of a ResNet-20 trained under the same pipeline (single run). In the coupled kernel, nearly all of the learned pairwise computation resides in the transport channel.

</details>


### [249] [Aligning One-Step Generative Models with Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30840)
*Austin Wang,Ziheng Cheng,Lexing Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RWTD是一种一步生成模型后训练方法，仅需生成样本与标量奖励，通过混合当前与参考分布的加权传输蒸馏实现奖励对齐，在SANA Sprint上提升GenEval并保持组合能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步生成器单次网络评估即可高质量生成，但后训练困难：通用隐式生成器既无可处理似然也无去噪轨迹，且许多奖励不可微。

Method: 提出奖励加权传输蒸馏（RWTD）：无需梯度通过奖励，仅用生成样本与标量奖励；构造混合当前分布与参考分布的自适应目标，当前分量吸收训练中发现的新改进，参考分量锚定预训练生成器；通过特征空间最优传输与不动点回归实现该目标。

Result: 理论分析表明RWTD的不动点分布在参考模型的离策略奖励倾斜与当前模型的在策略倾斜之间插值，可原则性平衡奖励适应与先验知识保持。实验上，将一步SANA Sprint 1.6B的GenEval分数从0.73提升至0.80；独立偏好对齐实验显示良好的跨奖励泛化，实现均衡提升并保留组合能力。

Conclusion: RWTD为一步生成器提供了仅依赖样本与标量奖励的实用后训练框架，兼顾奖励优化与预训练知识保持，具有理论依据与实证有效性。

Abstract: One-step generators enable high-quality visual generation with a single network evaluation, but their post-training is difficult: general implicit generators provide neither tractable likelihoods nor denoising trajectories, and many rewards are non-differentiable. We introduce Reward-Weighted Transport Distillation (RWTD), a post-training method that requires only generated samples and scalar reward evaluations. Rather than aligning solely to the conventional reward-tilted reference distribution, RWTD constructs an adaptive target that mixes separately tilted current and reference distributions. The current component incorporates improvements discovered during training, while the reference component anchors the target to the pretrained generator. RWTD realizes this target through feature-space optimal transport and fixed-point regression. Theoretical analysis shows that the fixed-point distributions of RWTD interpolate between off-policy reward tilting of the reference and on-policy tilting of the current model, providing a principled approach to balancing reward adaptation with retention of prior knowledge. Empirically, RWTD substantially improves the GenEval score of the one-step SANA Sprint 1.6B backbone from 0.73 to 0.80, while separate preference alignment experiments demonstrate strong cross-reward generalization that yields balanced improvements and preservation of compositional capabilities.

</details>


### [250] [Different Corruptions, Different Signals: Uncertainty and Loss in Federated Data Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31454)
*Bradley Scott,Zeqi Luo,Edmond S. L. Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) data corruption can affect either inputs or labels, but it remains unclear whether input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss expose these corruption modes equally. This paper compares two corruption-detection signals in FL: input-conditional uncertainty and prediction-label loss. The uncertainty signal is characterised using a learned aleatoric variance estimate together with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout variance and entropy measures, while the loss is computed against the supplied label. We test these signals against additive image noise and persistent random label flips. On ResNet-20 with CIFAR-10 and SVHN under Dirichlet partitions with data that are not independent and identically distributed (non-IID), the two corruption types behave differently. For persistent random label flips, the within-client per-sample area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) is 0.85 on CIFAR-10 and 0.95 on SVHN for prediction-label loss, while every uncertainty estimator stays at chance (0.49--0.50). This pattern is consistent with the model remaining confident in the underlying image despite the supplied label being wrong. For image noise, expected-entropy uncertainty rises above chance (0.67 on CIFAR-10 and 0.66 on SVHN), while loss responds comparably (0.64 on both). Each signal is therefore the stronger detector for a different corruption: the prediction-label loss for persistent label flips, and expected-entropy uncertainty for image noise, with its advantage becoming apparent as federation-wide corruption prevalence increases. Robust FL data-quality assessment should match the signal to the corruption rather than rely on uncertainty alone across corruption types.

</details>


### [251] [Uncertainty-Aware Federated Learning for Infant Movement Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31463)
*Edmond S. L. Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向婴儿骨骼运动分析与全身运动评估(GMA)的联邦学习框架，并引入不确定性感知的联邦聚合策略(UA-FedAvg)，在fidgety运动分类任务上接近集中式训练的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 婴儿运动分析可为神经发育障碍的早期识别提供生物标志物，深度学习方法已能基于视频导出的骨骼表示实现与专家相当的GMA性能。但现有方法多依赖集中式训练，需将多机构数据汇集到单一站点，在隐私、治理与数据共享受限的临床场景中难以实现。

Method: 提出联邦学习框架用于基于骨骼运动数据的自动化婴儿运动分析与GMA，以fidgety运动分类为临床用例。采用Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout在推理阶段估计预测不确定性，并据此提出UA-FedAvg策略，将MC-Dropout得到的预测熵纳入联邦聚合过程，按各客户端的预测不确定性调整其贡献。实验采用跨被试评估协议与三客户端联邦设置。

Result: 联邦学习相比各客户端独立训练的本地模型显著提升分类性能，且性能接近集中式训练。在评估的各数据划分配置下，UA-FedAvg及其结合验证损失的变体总体优于传统FedAvg。

Conclusion: 联邦学习可在不集中数据的前提下实现接近集中式训练的婴儿运动分析性能，且通过将预测不确定性引入聚合过程可进一步提升效果，为隐私受限的多机构临床协作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Infant movement analysis provides valuable biomarkers for the early identification of neurodevelopmental disorders. Recent advances in deep learning have enabled automated analysis of infant movements from video-derived skeletal representations, achieving performance comparable to expert assessment for tasks such as General Movement Assessment (GMA). However, most existing approaches rely on centralized training, requiring data from multiple institutions to be collected and stored at a single site. Such assumptions are often impractical in clinical settings due to privacy, governance, and data-sharing constraints. To address these challenges, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first federated learning framework for automated infant movement analysis and General Movement Assessment using skeletal motion data. As a clinically relevant use case, the proposed framework is evaluated on fidgety movement classification. To quantify model confidence, Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout is employed to estimate predictive uncertainty during inference. Building upon this, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Federated Averaging (UA-FedAvg) strategy that incorporates predictive entropy derived from MC-Dropout into the federated aggregation process, enabling client contributions to be adjusted according to their predictive uncertainty. Experiments were conducted using a cross-subject evaluation protocol under a three-client federated learning setting. Results demonstrate that federated learning substantially improves classification performance compared with independently trained local models while achieving performance approaching that of centralized training. Furthermore, UA-FedAvg and its variant incorporating validation loss generally outperform conventional FedAvg across the evaluated data-split configurations.

</details>


### [252] [AutoResearch at Production Scale: Failure Modes and a Multi-Agent Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30541)
*Aparajith Chandran,Juwon Kim,Saurav Jha,Pablo Castells,Florian Hottier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文报告将AutoResearch范式（LLM迭代编辑训练脚本并保留提升指标的修改）应用于生产级推荐系统嵌入优化的12周实践，识别出5种失效模式并提出"预防-持久化-重定向"三原则框架，取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产推荐管线的嵌入系统优化需要系统性探索，但在规模化场景下消耗不成比例的工程精力。作者希望将AutoResearch自动化探索范式从原始小规模设置推广到生产规模，弥补该范式在真实工业环境中的适用性空白。

Method: 在两个独立开发的图书推荐表征学习系统上运行AutoResearch范式长达12周，共220+次实验，单次迭代消耗数小时多GPU算力，评估涉及竞争性标准，campaign跨越数周与众多训练任务。基于实践观察，归纳5种失效模式并提出三原则脚手架设计（prevent/persist/redirect），将每种失效模式映射到结构化补救措施，其具体实现随迭代成本扩展。

Result: 框架相较人工调参基线实现1.82倍Recall@6提升与2.1倍一致性提升；智能体自主设计出纯文本回退方案，将目录覆盖率扩大5.8倍。两个系统单次迭代成本相差近三个数量级，却呈现相同失效模式。

Conclusion: 基础设施脆弱性、智能体记忆衰减、搜索方向停滞、迭代成本不对称与指标固着是生产级自主研究的结构性属性，而非特定应用的产物；三原则脚手架为生产规模AutoResearch提供了可随迭代成本扩展的通用设计范式。

Abstract: Optimizing embedding systems for production recommendation pipelines demands systematic exploration that consumes disproportionate engineering effort at scale. We apply Andrej Karpathy's AutoResearch paradigm -- a large language model that iteratively edits a training script and retains modifications that improve a held-out scalar metric -- to automate this exploration. We report on twelve weeks of running this paradigm at production scale, where iterations consume hours of multi-GPU compute, evaluation involves competing criteria, and campaigns span weeks across many training jobs. Across two independently developed representation-learning systems for a book recommendation pipeline, we ran 220+ experiments and observed five recurring failure modes absent from the original setting: infrastructure fragility, agent memory decay, search-direction stagnation, iteration-cost asymmetry, and metric fixation. We contribute a three-principle scaffolding design -- prevent, persist, redirect -- that maps each failure mode to a structural remedy and whose instantiation scales with iteration cost. The framework produced a 1.82x Recall@6 lift and a 2.1x coherence lift over hand-tuned baselines, and the agent autonomously designed a text-only fallback that expanded catalog coverage by 5.8x. The two systems span nearly three orders of magnitude in per-iteration cost yet exhibit the same failure modes, suggesting these are structural properties of production-scale autonomous research rather than artifacts of either application.

</details>


### [253] [Common-Mode Collapse and Recovery in Direct Feedback Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31589)
*Varun Reddy,Bernardo L. Sabatini,Houman Safaai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究直接反馈对齐（DFA）训练中隐藏层出现的"坍塌"现象，追溯其成因于输出误差的共模分量，并通过均值-协方差分解与简化模型加以解释与缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DFA用输出误差的固定随机投影训练隐藏层；但在tanh隐单元与独立sigmoid输出设定下，普通SGD会在接近"类别频率常数预测器"的损失水平附近停滞。作者希望解释这一停滞的机制根源。

Method: 将误差分解为跨输入共享的共模分量；采用精确的均值-协方差分解，分离出由平均教学信号与平均突触前活动构成的秩一更新，并分析其对tanh饱和的驱动作用；构建由网络初始化、无需拟合参数的简化模型进行预测；通过MNIST、CIFAR-10及更深与卷积网络的多组实验，考察读出层、优化器与输入统计的影响，并测试多种缓解手段（基线读出校准至类别先验、符号化误差、减去批均值等）。

Result: 简化模型在48种设定下预测出激活敏感度的集中趋势；MNIST上类别可解码性在坍塌后大体保留，但固定学习率下读出学习缓慢；Adam学习更快却坍塌更深；将基线读出校准至类别先验可抑制坍塌并加速学习；较弱反馈以更少坍塌换取更慢学习；用误差符号替代会持续坍塌，而减去信号批均值可防止持续坍塌并改善学习；类似效应出现在更深、卷积网络与CIFAR-10上，严重性随读出、优化器和输入统计而变。

Conclusion: DFA的停滞可归因于误差共模分量通过秩一更新把tanh单元推向饱和；该机制具有跨数据集与架构的普遍性，且可通过校准读出基线或去除批均值等简单手段有效缓解，为理解与改进DFA类算法提供了机理依据。

Abstract: Direct feedback alignment (DFA) trains hidden layers through fixed random projections of output error. With tanh hidden units and independent sigmoid outputs, plain stochastic gradient descent can stall near the loss of a constant predictor of class frequencies. We trace this stall to the error's common mode, the component shared across inputs. An exact mean-covariance decomposition separates a rank-one update formed by the mean teaching signal and mean presynaptic activity. Its leading component drives tanh units toward saturation. At initialization, random feedback provides no systematic correction of the shared error on average; readout learning limits its duration. A reduced model initialized from the network, without fitted parameters, predicts the concentration of activation sensitivity across 48 settings. On MNIST, class decodability largely survives collapse, but readout learning remains slow at a fixed learning rate. Adam learns faster despite deeper collapse. Calibrating the baseline readout to the class prior suppresses collapse and speeds learning; weaker feedback trades less collapse for slower learning. Replacing errors by their signs sustains collapse; subtracting the signal's batch mean prevents sustained collapse and improves learning in the tested setting. Related effects occur in deeper and convolutional networks and on CIFAR-10, with severity and cost depending on the readout, optimizer and input statistics.

</details>


### [254] [PALM: Point-in-Time Adaptation for Financial Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30316)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出金融回测中PIT语言模型每年重新预训练并非必要，并提出PALM方法：在不修改预训练权重的前提下，于决策日前文本上拟合低秩适配器即可为旧检查点添加新时段知识，效果优于继续预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融回测中的语言模型存在前视偏差（look-ahead bias）：若模型训练语料包含研究期之后发布的文本，则模型已见过待预测结果。PIT语言模型的解决方案是按时间过滤语料预训练，并对每个自然年发布一个带明确知识截止日期的检查点。但每年一次预训练代价高昂（需完整预训练运行），而这一年度预训练是否真正必要从未被检验。

Method: 作者首先将每个检查点与其替代它的更新检查点在同一评估窗口上比较，发现新检查点并无更优表现，从而论证年度预训练不必要。据此提出PALM（Point-in-time Adaptation for financial Language Models）：在决策日期之前发布的文本上拟合低秩适配器（low-rank adapter），不修改任何预训练权重，作为年度预训练的简单有效替代方案。

Result: 对比实验显示，新检查点在同一评估窗口上并不优于被其取代的旧检查点；小型适配器即可为旧检查点已编码的知识补充新时段信息，且效果优于继续预训练（continued pretraining）。PALM在十年金融新闻数据上、以及多个PIT模型家族（知识截止时间跨度达二十年，参数规模1.3B至4.2B）上均得到验证。

Conclusion: 年度预训练运行对PIT金融语言模型并非必需；通过轻量的PIT低秩适配即可为旧检查点扩展新时间段知识，且优于继续预训练，在多种PIT模型与十年金融新闻上验证有效。代码已开源。

Abstract: Language models used in financial backtests suffer from look-ahead bias, as a model trained on text published after the study period has already observed the outcomes it is asked to predict. To handle this issue, point-in-time (PIT) language models are pretrained on chronologically filtered corpora and released as one checkpoint per calendar year, each with a documented cutoff. However, each additional year costs a full pretraining run, and whether that run is necessary has never been tested. In this paper, we show that the annual pretraining run is not necessary. We instead compare each checkpoint against the newer one that replaced it, and find that the newer checkpoint scores no better on the same evaluation window. Motivated by this observation, we propose PALM (Point-in-time Adaptation for financial Language Models), a simple yet effective alternative to annual pretraining that fits a low-rank adapter on text published before the decision date without modifying any pretrained weight. We further find that a small adapter is enough to add a new period to the knowledge an old checkpoint already encodes, and that this outperforms continued pretraining. We validate PALM on a decade of financial news and on various families of PIT models, whose cutoffs span two decades and whose sizes range from 1.3 to 4.2B. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/palm.

</details>


### [255] [RAZOR: Pruning Replaceable Experts in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30465)
*Mingyang Song,Mao Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需训练的专家剪枝方法RAZOR，依据"功能可替代性"（共识残差）打分，在多个MoE模型和预算下取得最优宏平均并优于REAP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型每个token只激活少数专家，却需存储整个专家池，存储负担重；专家剪枝可缓解该问题。在固定剪枝预算下目标是尽量保留原模型输出分布，但专家自身的使用频率或贡献大小并不能直接决定其被移除造成的损害，关键在于剩余计算能否替代其功能。

Method: RAZOR：免训练专家剪枝方法，用"共识残差"（专家输出相对原始加权混合的偏差）衡量功能可替代性。在固定层输入下推导出单删除精确恒等式，刻画幸存专家的重新归一化与路由器选择的补位效应，从而得到局部打分，并在校准token上聚合，用于在给定预算下剪枝，无需梯度或恢复训练。

Result: 在GLM-4.7-Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731和Hy3上以25%和50%的专家移除率测试，RAZOR在全部8个设置中取得所评估剪枝方法里最高的九任务宏平均。在两个有REAP基准对照的主干上超出REAP 2.12–5.59分，并在全部36个配对任务比较中获胜；在四组匹配的GLM-4.7-Flash与Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型—预算设置中也相对REAP降低了反向KL。

Conclusion: RAZOR能以免训练方式有效剪枝MoE专家并保持任务性能与预测保真度。但对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B生成回复的分析显示其多样性、格式与终止行为发生改变，说明任务保持与预测保真并不保证生成稳定性。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate few experts per token but store the full expert pool. Expert pruning reduces this storage burden; at a fixed pruning budget, the goal is to preserve the original model's output distribution as closely as possible. Yet an expert's usage or contribution magnitude does not by itself determine the damage caused by its removal. What matters is whether the surviving computation can replace its function. We introduce RAZOR, a training-free expert pruning method that scores functional replaceability using consensus residuals: deviations of expert outputs from the original weighted mixture. An exact single-deletion identity at a fixed layer input accounts for survivor renormalization and router-selected refill, providing local scores aggregated over calibration tokens for budgeted pruning without gradients or recovery training.
