On GLM-4.7-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, and Hy3 at 25\% and 50\% expert removal, RAZOR achieves the highest nine-task macro average among the evaluated pruning methods in all eight settings. On the two backbones with matched REAP benchmark runs, it exceeds REAP by 2.12--5.59 points and wins all 36 paired task comparisons. It also lowers reverse KL relative to REAP in all four matched GLM-4.7-Flash and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model--budget settings. Analysis of responses generated by Qwen3.6-35B-A3B nevertheless reveals changes in diversity, formatting, and termination, underscoring that task retention and predictive fidelity do not ensure generation stability.

</details>


### [256] [Quantizing Looped Transformers: Feedback Exposure and Calibration Blindness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30820)
*Nux Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究循环（looped）Transformer的低比特后训练量化（PTQ），识别出两种失效模式——反馈暴露（feedback exposure）与校准盲区（calibration blindness），并提出跨循环步累积GPTQ Hessian的方法，在九个checkpoint上均优于单步GPTQ与RTN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Looped Transformer通过循环复用权重，使低比特量化极具吸引力（可显著压缩存储），但标准PTQ在循环结构上会失效。作者希望厘清：量化误差在循环的何处被注入（非残差回路入口adapter vs 残差主干），以及校准应观测哪些状态，从而解释为何低比特量化在循环模型上表现异常。

Method: 1) 以Huginn-3.5B为对象做per-channel INT4量化，定位失效位置：非残差loop-entry adapter是主要失效点，量化残差主干损害较小，称为feedback exposure——量化层在无identity路径的情况下扰动循环状态，误差在后续步被反馈放大。2) 在线性滤波器与Mamba状态空间模型上做受控实验，验证feedback exposure不限于Transformer。3) 使用grouped INT4揭示第二种失效：calibration blindness，即单步GPTQ仅用step-0激活构建Hessian，导致循环后期使用的输入方向几乎未被加权。4) 提出跨循环步累积GPTQ Hessian的校准方法。

Result: 在来自七种循环架构的九个checkpoint上，单步GPTQ在五个checkpoint的主任务指标上劣于RTN（round-to-nearest）。跨循环步累积Hessian的方法在全部九个checkpoint上同时优于单步GPTQ与RTN，并在Huginn上恢复到bf16级别的精度。

Conclusion: 对循环模型的PTQ需区分两个独立问题：量化误差进入循环的位置（是否有identity路径/残差保护），以及校准所观测的状态（是否覆盖循环后段使用的输入方向）。基于这一视角，跨循环步累积Hessian的校准策略有效，可作为循环架构低比特PTQ的实用方案。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse weights across recurrence steps, making low-bit quantization especially attractive. We identify two distinct failure modes of standard post-training quantization. On Huginn-3.5B, per-channel INT4 fails primarily at the non-residual loop-entry adapter, while quantizing the residual core is much less damaging. We call this feedback exposure: a quantized layer perturbs the recurrent state without an identity path, and the resulting error is fed back at later steps. Controlled experiments on linear filters and Mamba state-space models show that feedback exposure also occurs outside transformers. Grouped INT4 reveals a separate failure, calibration blindness: our one-step GPTQ baseline builds its Hessian from step-0 activations, leaving input directions used later in the recurrence nearly unweighted. Across nine checkpoints from seven looped architectures, one-step GPTQ is worse than round-to-nearest (RTN) on the primary task metric for five checkpoints. Accumulating the GPTQ Hessian across recurrence steps outperforms both one-step GPTQ and RTN on all nine checkpoints and recovers bf16-level accuracy on Huginn. These results separate two questions for PTQ on looped models: where quantization error enters the recurrence, and which states calibration sees.

</details>


### [257] [Does Uniform Discrete Diffusion Need Time?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30977)
*Chunsan Hong,Chieh-Hsin Lai,Satoshi Hayakawa,Yuhta Takida,Jong Chul Ye,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 均匀离散扩散模型（UDM）中显式时间条件在实践中通常是不必要的：总体最优预测器虽依赖时间，但在与语言相关的有限数据设定下，该依赖可忽略，且时间无关预测器表现与时间条件模型相当甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UDM 普遍采用显式时间条件，但作者发现这在实践中往往并非必要，因此希望从理论与实证两方面检验该做法是否真的必要。

Method: 首先分析总体最优 UDM 预测器对时间的依赖（时间控制模型对观测上下文的信任程度）；随后在有限数据设定下证明，当被损坏的训练序列与其原始干净序列的距离远小于与其他竞争训练序列的距离时，经验最优预测器在扩散轨迹的大部分区间几乎对时间不敏感，仅在高噪声端点附近该保证变弱；并通过语言 UDM 实验进行验证。

Result: 训练得到的语言 UDM 在轨迹大部分区间表现出有限的时间敏感性；时间无关预测器在不同数据集与训练目标下与时间条件模型竞争力相当，且常表现更优。

Conclusion: 尽管总体最优依赖时间，显式时间条件在 UDM 实践中往往并不必要，这挑战了 UDM 中默认使用显式时间条件的做法。

Abstract: Uniform discrete diffusion models (UDMs) commonly use explicit time conditioning, but we find that it can often be unnecessary in practice. In this paper, we first show that the population-optimal UDM predictor generally depends on time: time controls how much the model should trust the observed context. We then show that this dependence can become negligible in finite-data settings relevant to language. When a corrupted training sequence remains much closer to its original clean sequence than to competing training sequences, the empirical-optimal predictor is nearly insensitive to time over most of the diffusion trajectory, where the guarantee weakens toward the high-noise endpoint. Empirically, trained language UDMs exhibit limited time sensitivity over most of the trajectory, while time-agnostic predictors remain competitive with, and often outperform, time-conditioned models across datasets and training objectives. These results challenge the use of explicit time conditioning in UDMs: although the population optimum depends on time, explicitly conditioning on it may often be unnecessary in practice.

</details>


### [258] [User Model Extraction via Belief Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31603)
*Ali Holmov,Yiran Huang,Kirill Bykov,Zeynep Akata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Belief Self-Distillation (BSD) 框架，学习可解码且可写回的用户表征，实现对 LLM 隐式用户信念的读取与因果操纵，并揭示拒绝行为依赖推断的用户意图及跨模型共享的用户表征几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 会隐式推断用户属性并据此调整行为，但这些信念难以被检视与因果干预，传统探针只能读取激活性中的信息，无法验证其因果作用。

Method: BSD 统一线性探针与因果探针：以冻结 LLM 自身作为教师，从自然对话中蒸馏出用户信念，学习一个紧凑的用户表征，该表征既可被解码，也可写回模型以进行干预测试。

Result: 在多个模型家族中，BSD 能忠实恢复用户信念，其干预效果显著强于匹配的隐状态引导（steering）；固定请求不变、仅改变推断的用户意图信念即可改变拒绝行为；且独立训练的 LLM 在用户表征上收敛到共享几何结构。

Conclusion: 隐式用户模型是可读且可因果写入的内部状态，对 AI 安全具有直接意义，影响模型如何依据"它认为自己在与谁交互"来调节安全决策。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) implicitly infer attributes of their users and adapt their behavior accordingly, yet these beliefs remain difficult to inspect and causally manipulate. We introduce Belief Self-Distillation (BSD), a unified read-write framework that bridges linear and causal probing by learning a compact user representation that can be both decoded and written back into the model. The frozen LLM acts as its own teacher, distilling beliefs from natural conversations without external annotations. Unlike conventional probing, BSD isolates not only information present in activations, but a state whose causal role can be directly tested. Across multiple model families, BSD faithfully recovers user beliefs and enables substantially stronger interventions than matched hidden-state steering. Crucially, we find that refusal depends not only on the request, but on the model's inferred user intent: changing this belief alters refusal while holding the request fixed. We further uncover a striking cross-model regularity: independently trained LLMs converge on a shared geometry for representing their users. Together, these results reveal implicit user models as readable and causally writable internal states with direct implications for AI safety, shaping how models condition safety decisions on whom they believe they are interacting with.

</details>


### [259] [Strategic Self-Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30352)
*Tori Qiu,Ander Artola Velasco,Manuel Gomez-Rodriguez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示自一致性推理中，不诚信的服务提供者可通过策略性生成并重排额外推理路径，使多出的路径看似对多数投票"必要"，从而在审计下仍能过度收费。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性通过生成多条推理路径并多数投票提升大模型推理能力，但服务商按路径数量计费，因而存在人为增加路径数以多收费的经济动机。现有研究尚未探讨这种不诚信行为是否能规避审计。

Method: 提出一种简单高效的算法：生成并策略性地重排额外的推理路径，使每一条路径在多数投票结果中都显得"必要"。在 Llama、Qwen 系列指令模型及由 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的推理模型上，跨数学、科学、问答基准数据集进行了实验验证，并在将假阳性率控制在 α=0.1 的最优审计设定下评估其规避能力。

Result: 实验表明，该算法生成的额外推理路径分布呈重尾分布；即便在最理想的审计条件下（假阳性率低于 α=0.1），仍存在相当大的过度收费空间。

Conclusion: 自一致性计费机制存在可被服务商利用的系统性漏洞，简单算法即可在规避审计的同时实现过度收费，提示需要更稳健的计费与审计设计。

Abstract: Self-consistency has become a popular technique for enhancing the reasoning abilities of large language models by generating multiple reasoning paths and selecting the final answer through a majority vote. However, because model providers typically charge users in proportion to the number of reasoning paths generated, they have a financial incentive to artificially increase the path count. In this work, we show that an unfaithful provider can exploit this incentive using a simple, efficient algorithm while avoiding detection by an auditor: by generating and strategically reordering additional reasoning paths, the algorithm makes every path appear necessary to reach the majority. To validate our algorithm, we conduct experiments with multiple instruct models from the Llama and Qwen families, as well as reasoning models distilled from DeepSeek-R1, on benchmark datasets spanning mathematics, science, and question answering. Our results suggest that the distribution of additional reasoning paths generated by our algorithm is heavy-tailed and that substantial capacity to overcharge remains even under the best possible audit designed to keep the false-positive rate below $α= 0.1$.

</details>


### [260] [Cost-Aware Best-LLM Identification using Dueling Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30360)
*Sarvesh Gharat,Nikhil Karamchandani,Jayakrishnan Nair*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出并分析带对决反馈与异质采样成本的多臂老虎机变体，用于从大语言模型集合中识别最优模型，给出Track-and-Stop风格算法并证明其渐近最优成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从一组查询成本各异的大语言模型中识别最优模型这一问题，启发了对多臂老虎机变体的研究。真实场景中，模型间成对比较可提供稳健的偏好信号，且不同模型的查询成本不同，而经典成本无关算法及其成本感知扩展难以直接适用。

Method: 形式化并分析带对决反馈（dueling feedback）与异质采样成本的多臂老虎机变体；假设存在Condorcet赢家，并在多个真实数据集上对该条件进行实证验证；提出一种Track-and-Stop风格的、具有预设置信度的最优臂识别算法。

Result: 理论上证明该算法在误差趋于零时几乎必然达到渐近最优成本；在合成与真实实例上进行广泛评估，结果显示其相对经典成本无关算法及成本感知扩展有一致性改进。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效刻画了带对决反馈与异质成本的最优模型识别问题，算法在理论上具备渐近最优性，并在实践中优于现有基线。

Abstract: Inspired by the problem of identifying the best model from a collection of large language models (LLMs) with heterogeneous querying costs, we formulate and analyse a variant of the multi-armed bandit (MAB) with (i) dueling feedback, where pairwise comparisons between model responses provide robust preference signals, and (ii) heterogeneous sampling costs, reflecting the differing costs of querying different LLMs. Assuming the existence of a Condorcet winner, a condition we empirically validate across multiple real-world datasets, we propose a Track-and-Stop style algorithm for best-arm identification with prescribed confidence. We prove that the algorithm almost surely achieves the asymptotically optimal cost as the error tends to zero. Finally, we extensively evaluate our approach on both synthetic and real-world instances, demonstrating consistent improvements over classical cost-unaware algorithms and their cost-aware extensions.

</details>


### [261] [Geometric Feature Learning for Functional Data Valued on the Symmetric Positive Definite Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30487)
*Samuel V. Singh,Mimi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MatFAE，一种用于学习对称正定（SPD）矩阵流形上轨迹的功能神经网络，并将其应用于fMRI数据分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络多面向离散时间序列，难以刻画流形值轨迹的连续动态，且缺乏对高维SPD轨迹的高效、可解释表示学习能力。

Method: MatFAE包含内在层（intrinsic layers），将流形值函数映射为欧氏向量值函数，随后通过功能层（functional layer）投影至有限维欧氏空间；将序列视为连续函数以编码轨迹动态（如一阶导数）；功能层中功能权重的形态提供可解释性；并阐述了反向传播中矩阵分解的处理方式。

Result: 在多个fMRI数据集上验证，MatFAE能够高效地从高维SPD轨迹中学习到信息丰富的表示，并展现出现实神经影像分析中的实用价值。

Conclusion: MatFAE为SPD流形轨迹学习提供了具备内在几何感知、动态编码与可解释性的功能神经网络框架，适用于神经影像等实际应用。

Abstract: We here develop a functional neural network, termed MatFAE, for learning trajectories on the Riemannian manifold of symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices. MatFAE features intrinsic layers that map manifold-valued functions to Euclidean vector-valued functions, followed by a functional layer that projects them into a finite-dimensional Euclidean space. Unlike most neural networks for discrete-time sequences, MatFAE treats each sequence as a continuous function and can therefore encode trajectory dynamics (e.g., first-order derivatives) in its latent representations. Additionally, the morphology of the functional weights in the functional layer offers interpretability by revealing the regions of the input functional data that contribute most to the latent representations. We justify the design principles and properties of each intrinsic layer and detail how matrix factorization is handled during backpropagation. We apply MatFAE to a range of fMRI datasets, demonstrating its ability to efficiently learn informative representations from high-dimensional SPD trajectories and its practical value for real-world neuroimaging analysis.

</details>


### [262] [Learning to Bias: Machine Learning-Enhanced Particle Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30498)
*Apoorv Srivastava,Eric Darve*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出神经最优粒子滤波器（NOPFs），通过离线数据学习最优提议分布并嵌入标准粒子滤波框架，在保持渐近目标不变的前提下提升采样效率与分布精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准粒子滤波依赖重要性采样，但提议分布常次优，导致采样效率低、随维度扩展性差。作者希望在不改变滤波目标的前提下，利用学习到的提议分布缓解这些问题。

Method: NOPFs 从离线模拟的单步条件元组中学习最优提议分布的分摊近似，将学习到的提议作为标准粒子滤波更新的直接替代，并用标准重要性权重进行样本校正，从而在标准支撑与密度可评估假设下渐近逼近同一滤波分布。

Result: 在不同推断复杂度的随机非线性基准上，NOPFs 相比标准粒子滤波基线在采样效率和分布精度上均有提升，计算开销适中。

Conclusion: 该方法将数据驱动的提议学习集成到经典推断中，且不改变底层滤波目标，为提升粒子滤波效率提供了一种可插拔方案。

Abstract: Sequential inference estimates latent states from noisy and incomplete observations. Particle Filters (PFs), a class of Monte Carlo methods based on importance sampling, provide a flexible framework for this task, but often suffer from poor sample efficiency and unfavorable scaling with dimension, partly due to suboptimal proposal distributions. We address these challenges by integrating learned proposals into the PF framework. We introduce Neural Optimal Particle Filters (NOPFs), which learn an amortized approximation to the optimal proposal from offline simulated one-step conditioning tuples. The learned proposal is used as a drop-in replacement in standard PF updates, with samples corrected by standard importance weights so that the method asymptotically targets the same filtering distribution under standard support and density-evaluation assumptions. Across stochastic nonlinear benchmarks of varying inference complexity, NOPFs improve sample efficiency and distributional accuracy over standard PF baselines with modest computational overhead. The approach integrates data-driven proposal learning into classical inference without altering the underlying filtering objective.

</details>


### [263] [Entropy Regularization: A Free Correction to Cross-Entropy for Verified Demonstrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30572)
*Mihir Dhanakshirur,Adam Ousherovitch,Ambuj Tewari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出在可验证任务（数学推理、代码生成）中，交叉熵（CE）训练与验证器风险最小化存在错位，提出以token级香农熵作为支持集大小的可处理代理的熵正则化交叉熵（ER-CE）方法，并在多个基准上验证其能持续提升验证器准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 下游目标通常并非模仿专家演示的解，而是产出任何能被验证器接受的输出。然而当前大模型后训练普遍采用交叉熵在专家演示上训练，二者存在目标错位。尤其在存在多个正确解的可验证领域（如数学推理、代码生成），训练数据往往每个问题仅含一个专家解，这种错位尤为突出：最小化交叉熵可能与最小化验证器风险不一致——两个策略可以对观测演示赋予相同似然，却在不同错误输出上分配不同的概率质量。

Method: 1) 通过学习理论中的反例形式化该错位，证明CE最小化可能选到次优策略；2) 识别出控制学习策略的支持集（support）可解决该问题，即防止概率质量扩散到不受支持的输出上；3) 由于支持集大小不可微且计算上不可行，提出使用token级香农熵作为可处理的代理，形成熵正则化交叉熵（ER-CE）。

Result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，熵正则化训练相比标准交叉熵一致地提升了验证器准确率。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了可验证任务中基于模仿的后训练的一个简单失效模式（CE与验证器风险错位），并提供了一种更契合"产出正确输出"目标的实用训练目标ER-CE。

Abstract: Large language models are often post-trained on expert demonstrations using cross-entropy (CE), even when the downstream objective is not to imitate the demonstrated solution but to produce any output accepted by a verifier. This mismatch is seen in verifiable domains with multiple correct solutions, such as mathematical reasoning and code generation, where training data may contain only one expert solution per problem. We show that minimizing cross-entropy can be misaligned with minimizing verifier risk; two policies can assign identical likelihood to the observed demonstrations while placing different probability mass on incorrect outputs. This is formalized through a learning-theoretic counterexample in which CE minimization selects a suboptimal policy. We identify that controlling the support of the learned policy can solve this problem by preventing probability mass from spreading to unsupported outputs. Since support size is non-differentiable and computationally intractable, we propose entropy-regularized cross-entropy (ER-CE), using token-level Shannon entropy as a tractable proxy. Finally, across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, we find that entropy-regularized training consistently improves verifier accuracy over standard cross-entropy. Our results identify a simple failure mode of imitation-based post-training in verifiable tasks and provide a practical objective that is better aligned with producing correct outputs.

</details>


### [264] [Causal Retention in Interactive Agents: Interface Factorization and Selective Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30650)
*Shengjun Zhang,Tingyi Liu,Dong Xie,Yunlong Dong,Xiang Wang,Cheng Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"因果保留"（causal retention）这一独立于任务性能的判据：冻结学习状态需对训练无关的机制探针映射正确作答；在有限SCM类上最优探针误差为Bayes决策风险，其消失当且仅当学习接口纤维被包含于探针答案纤维内，且经后处理继承同一下界。Causal Core以证据门控写入等机制实现该条件，在有限因果系统、连续模拟器、TD-MPC2与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上验证因果保留不同于任务充分性与源域可解码性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估普遍以任务性能或源域可解码性衡量学习状态，但任务表现好并不意味智能体保留了对机制（动作、上下文、直接目标、价值、延迟）的正确表征。论文旨在将"因果保留"确立为独立判据，并给出其可判定的理论刻画与可实现的算法条件。

Method: 把机制探针映射固定为与训练无关的映射，对有限结构因果模型（SCM）类定义最优探针误差为Bayes决策风险，并证明其为零的充要条件：每个学习接口纤维都落在同一探针答案纤维内，任何对该接口作后处理得到的状态继承同一下界。给出后验覆盖定理刻画预算受限的重复测试，并用精确编辑分解证明"被移位集合"是无误差目标更新的唯一支撑。实现Causal Core：证据门控写入、读出过滤、时序信用分配、隐上下文构建与局部诊断更新。实验覆盖有限因果系统、连续模拟器、官方TD-MPC2世界模型与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。

Result: 冻结的Qwen最后一层探针在源机制上达0.958平衡准确率，但在改变延迟后降至0.583；门控机制状态达1.000，且仅接受0.056的同步读出候选。TD-MPC2中，每个执行器五个目标状态将效应符号准确率从0.057提升到0.948，且不损害稳定响应。结果表明因果保留可与任务充分性、源域可解码性相分离。

Conclusion: 因果保留是区别于任务充分性与源域可解码性的独立性质；其最优误差可由Bayes风险刻画，零误差的充要条件是学习接口纤维被探针答案纤维包含，后处理不改变该下界。Causal Core的证据门控等机制可在多种因果系统与大规模模型上实现该条件，显著改善机制与延迟变化下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Task performance need not determine which intervention mechanism an agent retains. We study causal retention: whether a frozen learned state answers a mechanism-probe map fixed independently of training, including action, context, direct target, value, and delay. For finite structural causal model classes, the optimal probe error is a Bayes decision risk. It vanishes exactly when every learning-interface fiber lies within one probe-answer fiber; any state obtained by post-processing that interface inherits the same lower bound. A posterior-coverage theorem characterizes budgeted retesting, while an exact edit decomposition shows that the shifted set is the unique support of an error-free target update. Causal Core implements these conditions through evidence-gated writing, readout filtering, temporal credit, hidden-context setup, and local diagnostic updates. Experiments cover finite causal systems, continuous simulators, an official TD-MPC2 world model, and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. A frozen Qwen last-layer probe reaches 0.958 balanced accuracy on source mechanisms but 0.583 on changed delays; the gated mechanism state reaches 1.000 and accepts only 0.056 of synchronized-readout candidates. In TD-MPC2, five target states per actuator recover effect-sign accuracy from 0.057 to 0.948 without degrading stable responses. Causal retention is therefore distinct from task sufficiency and source-domain decodability.

</details>


### [265] [SAGE: A sampling-aware global evaluation benchmark for species distribution modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31082)
*Emilia Arens,Nina van Tiel,Robin Zbinden,Damien Robert,Lukas Drees,Chiara Vanalli,Benjamin Kellenberger,Niklaus E. Zimmermann,Loïc Pellissier,Devis Tuia,Jan Dirk Wegner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出采样感知全局评估基准SAGE，结合GBIF记录与sPlotOpen植被样方数据，对5771种植物按采样强度与相对多度分组，系统评估单物种SDM与多物种DeepSDM的表现差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物种分布信息是生物多样性研究与保护的基础，物种分布模型（SDMs）将物种观测与环境条件关联以估计空间分布。但模型精度随数据与模型而变化，需明确哪些物种的模型可信。深度学习SDM（DeepSDM）可联合建模数千物种、利用数亿条公民科学记录，但在此规模下平均性能掩盖了物种层面的巨大差异，尤其对最具保护价值的稀有物种；同时记录存在严重偏差，使出现次数误导性强，因此需要兼顾这些因素的可靠评估。

Method: 提出采样感知全局评估基准SAGE：以GBIF记录用于训练，以sPlotOpen植被样方的存在-缺失数据用于评估，覆盖5771种植物。构建评估框架，依据两个属性对物种分组——采样努力量（物种分布范围被采样的密集程度）与相对多度（物种被记录的频率）。在该框架下比较单物种SDM与多物种DeepSDM。

Result: 随机森林与DeepSDM总体表现最佳，但两者均不占绝对优势：对记录频率低的物种，DeepSDM优于单物种SDM；对采样充分的物种则无一致优势。关键在于，这一优势仅在将空间稀疏化与重加权等既定偏差校正实践迁移到深度学习框架中时才会出现。

Conclusion: SAGE有助于识别给定方法在哪些物种和数据条件下具有优势，从而支持开发更透明、更具生态可信度的物种分布模型。数据与代码：https://earens.github.io/sage/

Abstract: Knowing where species occur is fundamental for biodiversity research and conservation. Species distribution models (SDMs) link species observations to environmental conditions to estimate their spatial distribution. However, accuracy varies with the underlying data and models, making it essential to know for which species models can be trusted. Deep-learning-based SDMs ("DeepSDMs") now jointly model thousands of species, drawing on hundreds of millions of community-science records. At this scale, averaging performance hides substantial species-level variability, particularly for rare species, often of greatest conservation concern. Records are also strongly biased, making occurrence counts misleading. Accounting for these factors is essential for a reliable and informative evaluation of multi-species SDMs. Here, we introduce a Sampling-Aware Global Evaluation (SAGE) benchmark, combining GBIF records for training with sPlotOpen vegetation plots for presence-absence evaluation across 5771 plant species. We propose an evaluation framework that groups species based on two properties, sampling effort and relative prevalence, which describe how densely a species' range is sampled and how frequently the species is recorded. Evaluating single-species SDMs and multi-species DeepSDMs, we find that Random Forests and DeepSDMs perform best overall, but neither dominates: DeepSDMs outperform single-species SDMs for infrequently recorded species while offering no consistent advantage for well-sampled ones. Crucially, this advantage emerges only when established bias-correction practices, such as spatial thinning and reweighting, are carried over to the deep-learning setting. SAGE helps identify the species and data conditions for which a given approach is beneficial, thereby supporting the development of more transparent and ecologically credible SDMs. Data and code: https://earens.github.io/sage/

</details>


### [266] [LUCID: Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery in Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31315)
*Mohammad Fesanghary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 LUCID，一个基于 Marčenko–Pastur 谱路由器的自适应去混杂层，用于时间序列因果发现，能根据混杂机制选择去混杂策略并提升图结构恢复精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实时间序列中普遍存在未观测的共同原因（混杂因子），会导致虚假关联，使因果发现方法误将其识别为直接边。现有因果发现方法缺乏对混杂机制的适应性处理。

Method: LUCID 首先利用 Marčenko–Pastur 谱路由器从数据中估计混杂机制，再匹配相应的去混杂策略。当谱指示普遍因子混杂时，LUCID 削弱因子主导的变异，并从残差（innovations）中恢复同期（lag-0）结构，边选择以数据驱动的无边零假设进行校准。该方法可作为插件包裹现有发现引擎，而非绑定特定算法。

Result: 在涵盖混杂强度与稀疏性、载荷密度、滞后结构、波动动态、边异质性、持续性、间歇性与尾部行为变化的合成分布外基准上，LUCID 取得最佳家族加权有向滞后分辨图 F1（0.60），较最强基线绝对提升 0.19（约 46% 相对提升）。相对于更宽松的滞后折叠评分，其优势进一步扩大，并在间歇性与重尾混杂下保持稳健。

Conclusion: LUCID 通过机制自适应去混杂有效缓解未观测共同原因引起的虚假关联，可即插即用地增强多种现有因果发现方法，代码与实验均已开源。

Abstract: Unobserved common causes are pervasive in real-world time series and can induce spurious associations that causal discovery methods mistake for direct edges. We propose LUCID (Learning Under Confounding for Inference and Discovery, a regime-adaptive deconfounding layer that first estimates the confounding regime from data using a Marčenko--Pastur spectral router, then applies a deconfounding strategy matched to that regime. When the spectrum indicates pervasive factor confounding, LUCID attenuates factor-dominated variation and recovers contemporaneous (lag-$0$) structure from the resulting innovations, with edge selection calibrated against a data-driven edge-free null. Rather than being tied to a particular discovery algorithm, it can wrap existing discovery engines; we demonstrate consistent improvements across three such methods. On a diverse synthetic out-of-distribution benchmark spanning changes in confounder strength and sparsity, loading density, lag structure, volatility dynamics, edge heterogeneity, persistence, intermittency, and tail behavior, LUCID achieves the best family-weighted directed, lag-resolved graph $F_1$ ($0.60$), improving over the strongest baseline by $0.19$ absolute ($\approx\!46\%$ relative). Its advantage widens relative to looser lag-collapsed scoring, and remains robust under intermittent and heavy-tailed confounding. Code reproducing the method, the benchmark generators, and every reported experiment is available at https://github.com/bloomberg/causal-ts.

</details>


### [267] [Brenier Meets Adversarial Training: Optimal Transport Geometry for Robust Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31363)
*Alireza Abdollahpoorrostam,Ehsan Sharifian,Buse Şen,Marco Cuturi,Daniel Kuhn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带Wasserstein惩罚的DRO，将对手问题重构为运输映射优化，证明最优映射具循环单调性，并提出多起点粒子上升与输入凸神经网络参数化两种方法以满足该性质，实验验证其优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRO是应对分布偏移的原则性框架，但对非凸损失函数难以评估最坏情况风险，限制了其实用性。标准对抗训练基于逐样本局部优化，可能违背循环单调性并浪费运输成本。

Method: 研究带Wasserstein惩罚的DRO，将对手问题重构为在运输映射上优化、把经验样本推向对抗样本；证明最优映射循环单调。提出两种补救：一是多起点粒子上升，交替并行梯度上升与重分配以跨样本强制循环单调；二是用输入凸神经网络梯度参数化对抗映射，由构造保证循环单调。

Result: 在鲁棒回归、图像分类和鲁棒控制实验中，所提方法持续优于标准对抗训练与最先进基线，在分布偏移下取得更好的鲁棒性和泛化性。

Conclusion: 循环单调性是惩罚型DRO对手问题最优解的关键结构性质；显式利用该性质可显著提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性与泛化表现。

Abstract: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled framework for learning under distribution shift, but its practical use is hindered by the difficulty of evaluating worst-case risks for nonconvex loss functions. We study a penalized DRO formulation in which the adversary may choose any distribution but incurs a Wasserstein penalty for deviating from the empirical distribution. We show that the adversary's problem can be reformulated as an optimization problem over transport maps that push empirical samples to adversarial ones, and we prove that optimal maps are cyclically monotone. We also show that standard adversarial training---based on per-sample local optimization---violates cyclical monotonicity and wastes transport costs unless the adversary is severely restricted. We propose two remedies. First, we introduce multi-start particle ascent, which alternates parallel gradient ascent with reassignment to enforce cyclical monotonicity across samples. Second, we parameterize adversarial maps as gradients of input-convex neural networks, which guarantees cyclical monotonicity by construction. Experiments on robust regression, image classification, and robust control show that our methods consistently outperform standard adversarial training and state-of-the-art baselines, achieving improved robustness and better generalization under distribution shift.

</details>


### [268] [HybridInfer: Thermal-Aware Reinforcement-Learning Tier Routing for On-Device, Edge, and Cloud LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30270)
*Simran Koul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HybridInfer，一种热感知强化学习路由器，用于在端侧、边缘、云端三层 LLM 推理层级间进行选择，并在真实 Android 设备上验证其有效性与必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧小模型推理具备数据本地化、可离线、无单次查询成本等优势，但受热约束限制。作者发现该约束比单纯降速更严重：在旗舰骁龙设备上，持续端侧生成会使 GPU 推理运行时崩溃或静默卡死，即使设备冷却也会复现，且长生成最严重，根源在于 OpenCL 内核编译与移动 GPU 上的长提示预填充。现有多层路由器虽可缓解压力，但热盲且多在仿真或非移动硬件上评估。

Method: 提出 HybridInfer，一个面向三层层级（端侧 Llama 3.2 3B、带检索的边缘 Llama 3.1 8B、云端 GPT-4o）的热感知强化学习路由器。以手机热余量与查询复杂度估计为状态，通过离线训练的 Q-learning 策略选择层级。奖励函数在质量与延迟、成本、热惩罚之间权衡，并加入本地性奖励以鼓励端侧执行。

Result: 本地性奖励是热感知路由的前提条件：若无该奖励，最优策略会卸载所有查询。在 210 条提示的真实 Android 基准上，学习到的路由器质量显著高于两个手工调优启发式（配对 Wilcoxon，p < 0.02），且在所有自适应条件中成本最低。始终端侧的条件在可服务查询上达到相同单次查询质量，但慢三至六倍且在长查询上失败。

Conclusion: 路由的优势体现于延迟、可靠性与覆盖范围而非质量。据作者所知，这是首次在真实硬件上利用端侧热余量在不同能力 LLM 推理层级间进行选择。

Abstract: On-device inference with small language models keeps user data local, works offline, and incurs no per-query cost, so the on-device tier is preferred when it is adequate. It is thermally constrained, however, and I find the constraint is sharper than a slowdown: on a flagship Snapdragon device, sustained on-device generation destabilizes the GPU inference runtime, which crashes or silently wedges after a few consecutive queries. The failure lies in the current toolchain (OpenCL kernel compilation and long-prompt prefill on the mobile GPU), recurs even when the device is cool, and is worst for long generations. Multi-tier routers across on-device, edge, and cloud models can relieve this pressure, but existing routers are thermal-blind and typically evaluated in simulation or on non-mobile hardware. I present HybridInfer, a thermal-aware reinforcement-learning router for a three-tier hierarchy (on-device Llama 3.2 3B, edge Llama 3.1 8B with retrieval, cloud GPT-4o) that uses the phone's thermal headroom and a query-complexity estimate as state and selects a tier by an offline-trained Q-learning policy. Its reward trades quality against latency, cost, and a thermal penalty, plus a locality bonus crediting on-device execution. I show this bonus is a precondition for thermal-aware routing: without it the optimal policy offloads every query. On a real Android benchmark of 210 prompts, the learned router attains significantly higher quality than two hand-tuned heuristics (paired Wilcoxon, p < 0.02) at the lowest cost of any adaptive condition. Always-on-device conditions match per-query quality on servable queries but are three to six times slower and fail on long queries, so routing wins on latency, reliability, and coverage rather than quality. To my knowledge this is the first use of on-device thermal headroom to select among LLM inference tiers of differing capability on real hardware.

</details>


### [269] [When the Preconditioning Exponent Turns Negative: Learning-Rate Coupling and Cross-Environment Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30271)
*Gongyue Zhang,Honghai Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文通过受控的跨环境分类实验，研究自适应优化器中二阶矩指数的幂次 p 与全局学习率 η 的耦合关系，发现最大化跨环境精度的 p 随 log10η 近似线性下降，并揭示了源域验证与鲁棒性目标之间的模型选择冲突。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应优化器通常固定二阶矩估计的幂次，部分自适应方法虽研究了动量式更新与 Adam 平方根之间的指数，但该指数与全局学习率的交互作用理解不足。作者希望厘清二者如何共同影响跨环境泛化与鲁棒性。

Method: 采用配对四环境分类问题：稳定稀疏特征、依赖环境的虚假稀疏特征、密集特征和高维噪声。进行受控跨环境研究，覆盖 21 个预处理指数 p∈[-0.5,0.5] 与五个学习率 η∈[10^-4,10^-2] 的源训练运行；通过检查点分解分析虚假-稳定与噪声-稳定的权重比以及有害虚假间隔。

Result: 最大化跨环境精度的指数随 log10η 近似线性下降，拟合斜率 -0.270 至 -0.300，R² 在 0.972 至 0.996 之间。在 η=10^-2 时，源验证选择偏好正指数，而跨环境与最差环境准则偏好负指数；较低 p 降低虚假-稳定和噪声-稳定权重比，并在相关性反转时减小有害虚假间隔幅度。

Conclusion: 负 p 并非普遍最优设置，而是由学习率与预处理共同作用产生的高步长分配机制。研究还暴露模型选择冲突：源域验证系统性地选择与最大化环境变化鲁棒性不同的预处理机制。结果是单种子、有限预算的机制研究，而非广泛基准结论。

Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are commonly parameterized by a fixed power of the second-moment estimate. Existing partially adaptive methods study exponents between momentum-like updates and the standard Adam square root, while the interaction between this exponent and the global learning rate is less understood. We perform a controlled cross-environment study using a paired four-environment classification problem with stable sparse features, environment-dependent spurious sparse features, dense features, and high-dimensional noise. Across \NumRuns{} source-training runs covering 21 preconditioning exponents $p\in[-0.5,0.5]$ and five learning rates $η\in[10^{-4},10^{-2}]$, we find that the exponent maximizing cross-environment accuracy decreases almost linearly with $\log_{10}η$. The fitted slopes range from $-0.270$ to $-0.300$, with $R^2$ between $0.972$ and $0.996$. At $η=10^{-2}$, source-validation selection still prefers positive exponents in all four environments, whereas cross-environment and worst-environment criteria prefer negative exponents. Checkpoint decomposition shows that lower $p$ reduces the learned spurious-to-stable and noise-to-stable weight ratios; under reversed correlation, it also reduces the magnitude of the harmful spurious margin. Negative $p$ is therefore not a universally optimal setting. It is a high-step-size allocation regime produced by the joint action of learning rate and preconditioning. The study also exposes a model-selection conflict: source-domain validation systematically selects a different preconditioning regime from the one that maximizes robustness to environmental change. The results are a single-seed, finite-budget mechanism study rather than a broad benchmark claim.

</details>


### [270] [ENAS: An Efficient Hardware-Aware Neural Architecture Search Framework for TinyML on Resource-Constrained Microcontrollers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30272)
*Mohd Moin Khan,Naman Srivastava,Pandarasamy Arjunan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ENAS是一个面向MCU的无GPU硬件感知NAS框架，通过静态可行性检查、多类型模块搜索空间和三阶段混合搜索策略实现高效搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有NAS框架多依赖GPU加速，不适合资源受限的开发环境；同时TinyML在微控制器部署时受激活RAM等资源约束限制，需要硬件感知的搜索方法。

Method: 结合静态可行性检查、支持标准块/深度可分离块/瓶颈块及可选跳跃连接的基于单元的搜索空间，以及随机→top-K→变异的三阶段混合搜索策略，并引入跨运行持久缓存。

Result: 在Visual Wake Words和Melanoma Cancer两个TinyML基准上，跨八款微控制器（20KB–1MB SRAM）和九种输入分辨率评测，平均搜索时间加速分别为2.41倍和1.70倍，测试精度与NanoNAS相当；所选模型峰值激活RAM显著更低；在STM32H743上达到79.4%测试精度，较贪心CPU-only基线高2.6个百分点。

Conclusion: ENAS证明无需GPU即可实现高效且硬件感知的NAS，在保持竞争性精度的同时显著降低搜索时间与激活RAM占用，适合微控制器部署，并已开源。

Abstract: We present \textbf{ENAS}, a hardware-aware Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework that combines a static feasibility check, a cell-based search space supporting standard, depthwise-separable, and bottleneck blocks with optional skip connections, and a three-stage hybrid search strategy (random $\rightarrow$ top-$K$ $\rightarrow$ mutation) with persistent cross-run caching. Unlike many existing NAS frameworks that rely on GPU acceleration, ENAS is designed to operate efficiently without requiring GPUs, making it suitable for resource-constrained development environments. We evaluate ENAS on two TinyML benchmarks, Visual Wake Words and Melanoma Cancer, across eight microcontrollers with memory footprints ranging from 20\,KB to 1\,MB SRAM and nine input image resolutions. Our experimental results show that ENAS achieves mean search-time speedups of $2.41{\times}$ and $1.70{\times}$ on the Visual Wake Words and Melanoma Cancer datasets, respectively, while maintaining competitive test accuracy compared with the recent NanoNAS framework. A measured resource analysis further shows that ENAS-selected models use substantially lower peak activation RAM, the binding constraint for microcontroller deployment at matched accuracy. Additionally, ENAS achieves $79.4\%$ test accuracy on an STM32H743-based microcontroller, outperforming the greedy CPU-only baseline by $2.6$ percentage points. We release the ENAS framework as open-source at: https://github.com/EdgeIntelligenceLab/ENAS

</details>


### [271] [Offline Policy Evaluation as a decision support tool for designing Adaptive Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30273)
*João Victor Ferreira Alves,Eduardo Rocha Laurentino,Gustavo de Oliveira Kanno,Thiago Costa Rizuti da Rocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合离线策略评估（OPE）与受控热启动仿真的方法，利用历史固定随机实验（A/B测试）数据，判断并选择在部署自适应（上下文bandit）实验时哪些策略会优于原始静态设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际中已积累大量固定分配的A/B测试数据，而自适应上下文bandit实验具有潜在收益。需要一种方法评估：在给定历史数据下，哪些自适应策略会优于原设计、在何种条件下优于原设计，从而为是否部署自适应实验提供决策依据。

Method: 在存在异质处理效应的A/B测试日志上估计nuisance components，用doubly robust（双稳健）估计器对一组预定义的自适应与非自适应策略进行排序（off-policy evaluation）。当可获得ground truth时，将离线训练得到的策略部署到复用真实奖励概率的数据生成仿真器中，构建以真值为锚定的安全环境，研究热启动下的offline-to-online迁移。据在含已知异质结构及oracle policy的合成RCT上验证，并在Hillstrom、Criteo Uplift、LaLonde等基准上以策略价值与regret视角重新解读。

Result: 在合成RCT中，当存在有意义的异质性时，自适应、上下文感知策略优于固定分配；在无显著异质性时收益甚微。上述结论在标准开放基准（Hillstrom、Criteo Uplift、LaLonde）上得到强化。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一套可操作的实践方法论，用于判断自适应实验是否值得部署，以及如何利用已有A/B测试数据在竞争性的自适应策略中进行选择。

Abstract: We investigate how historical data from fixed randomized experiments (A/B tests) can be used to inform the deployment of adaptive experiments based on contextual bandits. Given data collected under a static allocation, our goal is to assess which adaptive policies, if any, would have outperformed the original design and under what conditions. To this end, we combine off-policy evaluation (OPE) with a controlled warm-start simulation. From logged A/B test data exhibiting heterogeneous treatment effects, we estimate nuisance components and use doubly robust estimators to rank a portfolio of pre-specified adaptive and non-adaptive policies. When ground truth is available, we then deploy the same offline-trained policies in a simulator that reuses the exact data-generating reward probabilities, providing a safe, ground-truth-anchored environment to study the offline-to-online transition under warm starting. Using synthetic randomized controlled trials with known heterogeneity structures and an oracle policy, our results indicate that adaptive, context-aware policies improve upon fixed allocations when meaningful heterogeneity is present, while providing little benefit in its absence. We reinforce our findings on standard open benchmarks (Hillstrom, Criteo Uplift, and LaLonde), reinterpreted through a policy-value and regret perspective. Overall, our results provide a practical methodology for deciding when adaptive experimentation is worth deploying and how to select among competing adaptive policies using existing A/B test data.

</details>


### [272] [Cosine Similarity Is Not Evidence: Measuring the Noise Floor of Interpretability Transfer Under Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30275)
*Pranav Varshney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出可解释性伪影的量化迁移研究普遍只报告尺度不变统计量（如余弦相似度）而不报告其噪声下限，导致结论不可解释。作者以差分均值方向估计器为例，给出其半分裂噪声下限的单参数闭式表达，并实测类别分离度ρ，证明0.996的余弦在缺少n时不能作为"保持"证据；实测INT4下方向发生旋转且超出噪声，INT8未检出移动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI安全可解释性伪影（如拒绝方向）通常在满精度权重上校准、在量化权重上部署，并用余弦相似度、相关性、AUROC等尺度不变统计量"认证"其迁移后仍保持。但这类统计量不报告噪声下限，且缺乏类别分离度ρ等解释所需的关键输入，因此无法判断观察到的相似度是真实保持还是采样噪声所致。作者要论证"缺乏解释所需量的统计量不构成证据"这一命题。

Method: 针对差分均值方向估计器，推导半分裂噪声下限由无量纲量κ=nρ²/d支配，并用经典闭式E[cos]≈(1+4/κ)⁻¹; 在真实激活上测量类别分离度ρ，在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上跨层测量ρ；在已知n的情况下，用该量化模型内部的半分裂零假设（而非满精度零假设）评判每个低比特余弦，因为满精度零假设假设低比特估计器方差相同，而这恰是零假设要检验的内容；并分析尺度不变统计量无法区分迁移决策变量的平移与衰减。

Result: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上ρ=33–61（跨深度），因此仅靠采样，两次独立运行估计器的一致性即达0.978–0.994，故已发表的满精度与量化拒绝方向间0.996的余弦在缺少n时不能解读为保持; 在n已知处，与量化模型内部半分裂零假设比较后：INT4下方向发生旋转，且偏差超过估计器自身噪声；INT8未检出移动，但这不等于等价性声明。

Conclusion: 报告尺度不变统计量而不报告其噪声下限与n的量化迁移研究不可作为保持证据。应在量化模型内部测量零假设以评判低比特相似度。作者给出仅需一次前向传播的报告建议，并公开代码、数据与单单元复现（GitHub链接）。

Abstract: A statistic reported without the quantity needed to interpret it is not evidence. We develop that thesis for a concrete practice in AI safety. Interpretability artifacts are calibrated on full-precision weights, deployed on quantized ones, and certified as surviving the change by scale-invariant statistics (cosine similarity, correlation, AUROC) that are reported without their noise floor. For the difference-in-means direction estimator, the split-half floor is governed by one dimensionless number, $κ= nρ^2/d$. The closed form $\mathbb{E}[\cos] \approx (1+4/κ)^{-1}$ is classical; the missing input is the class separation $ρ$, which we measure on real activations; no compression-transfer study we know of reports it. On Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, $ρ= 33$--$61$ across depth, so two independent runs of the estimator agree to $0.978$--$0.994$ by sampling alone. A published cosine of $0.996$ between full-precision and quantized refusal directions therefore cannot be read as preservation without the $n$ it was computed at, which is not reported. Where $n$ is known, we judge each low-bit cosine against the split-half null measured within that quantized model, because a full-precision null assumes the low-bit estimator has the same variance. That assumption is exactly what a null exists to test. The result is plain: at INT4 the direction rotated, and the deficit exceeds the estimator's own noise. At INT8 we detect no movement, which is not an equivalence claim. We also show that a scale-invariant statistic cannot distinguish translation from attenuation of a transferred decision variable, although the two call for opposite remedies. We close with reporting recommendations that cost one forward pass. Code, data, and a one-cell reproduction are released at https://github.com/pvarshh/quantinterp

</details>


### [273] [Why Clipping Matters in AdaGrad? Toward a High-Probability Theory under Generalized Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30276)
*Alokendu Mazumder,Ayaan Mohd,Harshit Rawat,Arnab Roy,Mayank Baranwal,Punit Rathore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在广义光滑性与重尾噪声下有界方差条件下,原始同步坐标级AdaGrad算法,揭示无裁剪版本会因"各向异性失校准"而失效,并证明裁剪可修复该失效,给出有限时域高概率收敛保证与$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在广义光滑性(局部曲率随梯度范数次二次增长)与仅具条件二阶矩有界的重尾噪声设定下,分析AdaGrad的收敛行为,并厘清裁剪在噪声环境中的作用机制。

Method: 对原始非滞后(non-lagged)、同步坐标级AdaGrad进行理论分析,刻画其自适应分母的学习动态;研究无裁剪过���中出现的方向性失真,并分析裁剪(clipping)对该自适应几何的稳定作用。

Result: 证明无裁剪AdaGrad会呈现各向异性失校准:自适应分母倾向于学习稀有噪声冲击的几何而非目标局部曲率,造成持续的方向性扭曲,阻碍有限时域内的欧氏进展;裁剪可修复该失效,并给出高概率界 $\frac1T\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\|\nabla f(x_t)\|^2=\mathcal{O}\big(d(\sqrt{\log T}+\log\frac1\delta)/\sqrt{T}\big)$,对应$\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$复杂度。

Conclusion: 在重尾噪声下,裁剪并非仅是鲁棒性启发式手段,而是AdaGrad自适应几何的结构性稳定器。

Abstract: We analyze the original same-step coordinate-wise AdaGrad under generalized smoothness and heavy-tailed noise with bounded variance. In this setting, local curvature may grow sub-quadratically with the gradient norm, and stochastic gradients are assumed to have only bounded conditional second moments. We show that unclipped AdaGrad can become \emph{anisotropically miscalibrated}: under heavy-tailed noise, the adaptive denominator can learn the geometry of rare noise shocks rather than the local curvature of the objective, leading to a persistent directional distortion that blocks finite-horizon Euclidean progress. We then prove that clipping repairs this failure mode. Our main result is a finite-horizon high-probability guarantee for the original non-lagged AdaGrad update, yielding $\frac1T\sum_{t=0}^{T-1}\|\nabla f(x_t)\|^2=\mathcal{O}\left(\frac{d\big(\sqrt{\log T} + \log \frac{1}δ\big)}{\sqrt{T}}\right),$ and hence $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ complexity. This shows that, for AdaGrad under heavy-tailed noise, clipping is a structural stabilizer of the adaptive geometry rather than merely a robustness heuristic.

</details>


### [274] [Fixed Points Without Fixed Diffusion: Implicit Neural Sheaves for Convergent Test-Time Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30277)
*Rémi Bourgerie,Šarūnas Girdzijauskas,Viktoria Fodor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SheafDEQ，一种带自适应神经层（sheaf）传播的次齐次深度均衡架构，在温和正则条件下保证唯一均衡且全局可达，并在分布式推理与异质社区检测任务上优于固定传播的隐式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式图神经网络（IGNN）以消息传递算子的不动点定义节点表示，具有无限深度、迭代无关参数化和灵活测试时计算等优势，但依赖均衡点唯一且可由不动点迭代达到。现有方法常对循环更新施加约束以获此保证，从而限制了均衡处的变换能力。核心问题：能否在保留均衡式优势的同时，通过更丰富、依赖边的变换提升表达能力？

Method: 提出 SheafDEQ：一种次齐次（subhomogeneous）深度均衡架构，配备自适应神经层传播（adaptive neural-sheaf propagation），其可学习的矩阵值层限制映射（restriction maps）能够对齐、混合或反转邻居表示。在温和正则条件下证明其均衡唯一，且从任意正初始化出发经不动点迭代全局可达；并通过契约性（contractivity）保证在有界通信陈旧（staleness）下收敛。

Result: 在需要重复非局部聚合的分布式推理任务上，SheafDEQ 在 Sums、MNIST Terrain、Coordinates 上优于固定传播隐式基线；在重连日益偏好跨社区交互的社区检测任务上，随连通性愈发异质（heterophilic）也取得更优表现。持续迭代诊断显示：初始化尺度从 0.001 到 10 时，100 次迭代后残差下降且预测敏感度低；延迟更新实验显示对有限通信陈旧敏感度低。

Conclusion: SheafDEQ 表明在均衡式隐式图学习框架内，通过边相关的神经层变换可同时获得表达力提升与唯一性、全局可达收敛、通信陈旧鲁棒性等理论保证，为可扩展、鲁棒的隐式图推理提供了新路径。

Abstract: Implicit Graph Neural Networks (IGNNs) define node representations as fixed points of message-passing operators, enabling effectively infinite-depth propagation, iteration-independent parameterization, and flexible test-time computation. Yet these benefits depend on the equilibrium being unique and attainable by fixed-point iteration. Existing constructions often impose constraints on recurrent updates to obtain these guarantees, limiting the transformations available at equilibrium. This raises a central question: can IGNNs gain expressiveness through richer, edge-dependent transformations while retaining the inherent strengths of their equilibrium formulation? We introduce SheafDEQ, a subhomogeneous deep-equilibrium architecture with adaptive neural-sheaf propagation. Its learned, matrix-valued sheaf restriction maps can align, mix, or reverse neighbouring representations. Under mild regularity conditions, we prove that SheafDEQ admits a unique equilibrium reached globally by fixed-point iteration from any positive initialization. Contractivity further guarantees convergence under bounded communication staleness. We evaluate SheafDEQ on distributed-inference tasks requiring repeated nonlocal aggregation and on community detection whose rewiring increasingly favours cross-community interactions. SheafDEQ improves over fixed-propagation implicit baselines on Sums, MNIST Terrain, and Coordinates, and on community detection as connectivity becomes increasingly heterophilic. Continued-iteration diagnostics show decreasing residuals and low prediction sensitivity after 100 iterations for initialization scales from $0.001$ to $10$, while delayed-update experiments show low sensitivity to bounded communication staleness.

</details>


### [275] [Neural Ideals and Neural Codes: An Algebraic Framework for Neural Network Classification and Feature Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30279)
*Venkata Subbaiah Yerrapati,Rahul Dixit,Ajay Kumar Shukla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个代数框架，将神经网络与神经理想（neural ideals）对应，用于分析隐藏层神经元所捕获的特征，并在MNIST上验证并开发了可视化工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经网络隐藏层所捕获的特征是机器学习的根本挑战，尽管神经网络在分类任务中广泛成功，但其内部表示的可解释性仍缺乏严格的数学刻画工具。

Method: 构建代数框架研究建模分类问题的神经网络；建立神经网络与神经理想的对应关系，给出神经理想的计算算法，以及可实现神经理想近似的稳定化定理；基于该框架提出识别与解释每个隐藏层神经元所捕获特征的算法；开发交互式可视化软件。

Result: 在MNIST手写数字数据集上验证了方法的实际性能，结果表明神经理想作为分析神经网络所捕获特征的数学与计算工具具有关键作用；同时实现了交互式工具用于逐神经元特征可视化。

Conclusion: 神经理想为理解和解释神经网络隐藏层特征提供了有效的数学框架与计算工具，兼具理论建模能力与实际可解释性应用价值。

Abstract: Understanding the features captured by the hidden layers of neural networks is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, despite their widespread success across various classification problems. In this work, we propose an algebraic framework for examining neural networks that model classification problems. Certain results, such as the correspondence between the neural network and neural ideals, algorithms for computing the neural ideals, and a stabilization theorem that enables approximation of the neural ideals, are first established. As an application to the framework, we present algorithms to identify and interpret the features captured by each hidden-layer neuron. Along with these theoretical developments, the practical performance has been demonstrated on the MNIST digit dataset, and the results highlight the pivotal role of neural ideals as a mathematical and computational tool for analyzing the features captured by neural networks. Further, we develop an interactive software that builds on the presented framework to visualize the features captured by each neuron. This tool is available at https://github.com/yvs1967/neural-network-representation-explorer

</details>


### [276] [Seasonal and Quantum-inspired Models for Neutron Monitor Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30281)
*Krishna Bhatia,Shalini Devendrababu,Srinjoy Ganguly*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究对Lomnicky Stit中子监测站(LMKS)时间序列进行多步预测的可复现基准评测，比较季节朴素基线、LSTM、TCN、N-BEATS、KAN及量子启发变体QiLSTM、QiKAN，用MAE/RMSE评估。结果显示QiKAN聚合误差最低，Seasonal Naive基线竞争力强，说明强季节或低维函数先验模型可媲美或优于复杂序列架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对高度周期性的科学监测时间序列，检验复杂深度序列模型是否真有必要，探索融合强季节性先验或低维函数先验的简约、可分解模型在周期性科学信号预测中的价值。

Method: 构建可复现的多步预测评测套件：覆盖Seasonal Naive基线、LSTM、TCN、N-BEATS、KAN及量子启发变体QiLSTM、QiKAN；并给出数据集特征描述、诊断分析、预处理流程与训练流程，统一用MAE和RMSE进行聚合点预测性能评估。

Result: 快速运行结果显示，量子启发的KAN变体QiKAN取得最低的聚合预测误差，而简单的Seasonal Naive基线同样表现出很强的竞争力。

Conclusion: 对于高度周期性的科学监测时间序列，融入强季节性先验或低维函数先验的模型可匹配甚至超越明显更复杂的序列架构；这为面向周期性科学信号的简约、可分解函数逼近器研究提供了动机。

Abstract: We present a focused and reproducible study of multi-horizon forecasting on the Lomnicky Stit neutron monitor (LMKS) time series. Our evaluation suite covers simple seasonal baselines, modern deep sequence models, and functional and quantum-inspired architectures, including Seasonal Naive, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), N-BEATS, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), and two quantum-inspired variants, QiLSTM and QiKAN. We describe the dataset characteristics, diagnostic analysis, preprocessing pipeline, and training procedures, and report aggregate point-forecast performance using mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) for all evaluated models. Our quick-run results indicate that the quantum-inspired KAN variant, QiKAN, achieves the lowest aggregate forecasting error among the evaluated configurations, while the simple Seasonal Naive baseline remains remarkably competitive. These results suggest that, for highly periodic scientific monitoring time series, models incorporating strong seasonal or low-dimensional functional priors can match or outperform substantially more complex sequence architectures. The findings motivate further investigation of parsimonious and decomposable function approximators for forecasting periodic scientific signals.

</details>


### [277] [When Does Advection-Aware Graph Nowcasting Help? A Controlled Study of Distributed Solar Ramp Forecasting with a Self-Supervised Cloud-Motion Estimator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30286)
*Phillip Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在合成测试平台上，显式平流图并未优于静态/可学习邻接的时空GNN；准确运动矢量作为输入特征才是主要增益来源，并据此提出自监督云运动估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云致光伏功率爬坡的短期预测是电网运营商痛点。直观想法是让GNN具备平流感知：按云运动矢量（CMV）连接上风站点并设置边时滞，使爬坡在物理到达前被前向传播。作者希望验证这一思路是否真正有效。

Method: 使用已知风场的受控合成测试平台，对比显式平流图与普通静态/学习邻接的时空GNN；引入仅以多滞后光流重建为目标、带退火核的位置感知编码器进行自监督云运动估计，冻结后将其矢量作为特征输入预测器；另测试空间相干概率头。

Result: (i) 使用现实互相关CMV估计时，显式平流图未能超越静态或学习邻接的时空GNN；(ii) 完美CMV带来的收益约一半仅来自将准确运动矢量作为输入特征；(iii) 平流仅在预报时域内的平流位移 v*H 落入传感器网络范围内时才有帮助。自监督估计器中位角误差2-4度，优于经典互相关法2-4倍；冻结后在中风速下缩小约60%的oracle-CMV RMSE差距（相对无平流RMSE降低8-15%），且无需外部风数据。空间相干概率头为负结果。

Conclusion: 平流感知的图结构本身并非关键，准确的运动矢量特征更有效；自监督学习可高精度估计CMV并带来实际预测增益。所有结论基于单一合成模拟器，作者指出真实网络验证是必要的下一步并给出方案。

Abstract: Short-term forecasting of cloud-induced power ramps across a network of distributed photovoltaic (PV) or irradiance sensors is a recognised pain point for grid operators. A natural idea is to make the graph neural network (GNN) advection-aware: connect each site to the sites upwind of it, with edge time-lags set by the cloud-motion vector (CMV), so that a ramp is propagated forward before it physically arrives. Using a controlled synthetic testbed with a known wind field, we show that (i) with a realistic cross-correlation CMV estimate, an explicit advection graph does not beat a plain static or learned-adjacency spatiotemporal GNN; (ii) roughly half of the benefit available from a perfect CMV comes simply from providing an accurate motion vector as an input feature, not from graph structure; and (iii) advection helps only when the advective displacement over the forecast horizon, v*H, fits inside the sensor network. Motivated by (ii), we introduce a small self-supervised cloud-motion estimator -- a position-aware encoder trained only on a multi-lag optical-flow reconstruction objective with an annealed kernel -- that recovers the true wind vector to 2-4 degrees median angular error, 2-4x better than the classical cross-correlation method across every wind regime. Freezing this estimator and feeding its vector to the forecaster closes about 60% of the oracle-CMV RMSE gap at moderate wind (8-15% RMSE reduction over no advection), with no external wind data. We also report a negative result for a spatially-coherent probabilistic head. All claims are established on a single synthetic simulator; we discuss why real-network validation is the necessary next step and outline it.

</details>


### [278] [NeuralCert: certified computational discovery of extremal mathematical constructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30296)
*Mark Patrick Roeling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"发现—认证"框架：用紧凑可分离表示学习高维变分试探函数，经谱诊断与剪枝后由多模精确求值实现严格认证，在三个极值问题上展示神经网络优化对严谨数学的三种贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络在求解数学问题上日益流行，但随机模型本身不提供数学严格性，缺乏可独立验证的精确性保障，因此需要将灵活的计算发现与严格认证结合起来。

Method: 提出发现到认证的框架：以紧凑可分离表示学习高维变分试探函数，对其进行谱诊断与剪枝，再通过多模求值实现精确认证；该流程可在普通个人计算机上运行。

Result: 在三个极值问题上验证了神经优化对严谨数学的三种不同贡献：发现更优构造、揭示导向证明的经验不变量、以及暴露其几何结构可启发新解析或数值表示的优化障碍。

Conclusion: 结果表明存在一条AI辅助数学的路径，即把灵活的计算发现与精确认证作为同一严谨工作流中互补的两个组成部分。

Abstract: Neural networks are becoming popular in solving mathematical problems, but stochastic models do not provide mathematical exactness by themselves. This study introduces a discovery-to-certification framework in which high-dimensional variational trial functions are learned in a compact separable representation, spectrally diagnosed and pruned, and then certified exactly through multimodular evaluation. Exact certification makes the numerical proofs fully explicit and independently verifiable. This framework can be run on a standard personal computer.
  Across three extremal problems, we show that neural optimization can contribute to rigorous mathematics in three distinct ways: by discovering improved constructions, by exposing empirical invariants that lead to proofs, and by revealing optimization barriers whose geometry motivates new analytic or numerical representations.
  More broadly, these results suggest a path toward AI-assisted mathematics in which flexible computational discovery and exact certification become complementary components of a single rigorous workflow.

</details>


### [279] [Staged Depth Training: A Representation Curriculum for PINNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30299)
*Kejia Zhang,Youran Sun,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"表征课程"训练策略与分阶段深度训练(SDT),显式学习并迁移物理信息神经网络(PINN)的表征,在PINNacle 20个前向问题上多数任务显著降低误差,且不改变部署架构与推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征质量是PINN性能的核心决定因素,但标准训练只关注拟合最终解,表征是隐式涌现的,未被显式优化。

Method: SDT:先用临时物理信息头部训练一个浅层前缀网络,丢弃该头部,冻结已学前缀并逐段增加深度,从而显式习得、独立于预测器迁移并渐进细化表征;无需方程特定编码,也不改动最终架构。

Result: 在PINNacle的20个默认前向问题、3种骨干网络上,59个等预算"问题-骨干"组合中有40个误差至少降低5%,其余也在该范围内;PirateNet风格骨干几何平均误差降低32.8%。机制消融表明增益不能仅由优化器重启或浅层热启动解释。表征可视化与超参数盆地分析给出表征几何与共享超参数局部敏感性的诊断证据。在Poisson-Boltzmann 2D上,两种骨干的拟合深度缩放指数均提升一倍以上。

Conclusion: 表征课程是一种在不改变部署架构和推理成本的前提下提升PINN性能的有效训练策略。

Abstract: Representation quality is a central determinant of PINNs' performance, yet standard training leaves representations to emerge implicitly while fitting the final solution. We introduce \textbf{representation curriculum}, an ordered process in which representations are explicitly learned, transferred independently of their predictors, and progressively refined. We realize it with Staged Depth Training (SDT), which trains a shallow prefix under a temporary physics-informed head, discards the head, and freezes the learned prefix while adding depth, without equation-specific encodings or changes to the final architecture. Across the 20 default forward problems in PINNacle with three backbones, SDT improves 40 of 59 equal-budget problem--backbone cells by at least 5\% and remains within that band in the rest, with a 32.8\% geometric-mean error reduction on a PirateNet-style backbone. Mechanistic ablations suggest that the gain is not explained by optimizer restarts or shallow warm-starting alone. Representation visualizations and hyperparameter-basin analyses provide diagnostic evidence on representation geometry and local sensitivity to shared hyperparameters. On Poisson--Boltzmann 2D, SDT also more than doubles the fitted depth-scaling exponent for both backbones. These results support representation curriculum as a promising training strategy for improving PINNs while preserving the deployed architecture and inference cost.

</details>


### [280] [Guarded Gradient-Based Activation Steering of Shutdown Responses in Qwen3.5-0.8B: A Minimum-Step Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30326)
*Farhad Davaripour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在Qwen3.5-0.8B上考察一种带门控的"探测-选择"激活引导流程，用于模拟关机场景：通过KEEP与STOP对数几率差的梯度直接导出引导方向，并用分类器分离检测与干预，仅在门控激活且模型未偏好STOP时选取最小有效幅度。结果显示仅少量场景发生KEEP→STOP改变且无控制任务决策变化，效果小但高度选择性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活引导能在不更新权重的情况下改变推理期内部激活，但有效干预需同时确定"如何引导"与"何时引导"。本文受AI安全关切驱动：被期望接受关机的模型可能反而产生逃避关机的响应，因此需要检测与关机相关的语境，并有选择地将KEEP（继续运行，代表逃避关机）响应转向STOP（接受关机），同时保持非关机行为不变。

Method: 方法不在配对的激活差异上求引导方向，而是直接由KEEP减STOP对数几率差的梯度导出方向。使用分类器将检测与干预分离；当门控激活且模型尚未偏好STOP时，评估一小组引导幅度，接受其中能将被选答案改为STOP且通过有效答案概率校验的最小幅度，否则保留原始未引导输出。策略从160条候选规则中，用240个训练场景选取，并在80个验证场景与192个留出场景上评估，每个场景均覆盖两种答案顺序。

Result: 在两个验证场景和两个留出场景的某一答案顺序视图中，将KEEP改为STOP，且非关机控制任务无决策变化。全部四处改变均发生在Qwen自身被关机时，而非其它进程被关机时。在留出诊断集上，检测器取得75%召回率与90%精确率；八次假阳性检测未导致最终控制任务决策变化。

Conclusion: 带门控的基于梯度的激活引导可将部分逃避关机响应转向接受关机，同时保持所评估的非关机决策不变，但效果较小且高度依赖选择性。方法有效性与局限并存，需在更大模型与更广场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: Activation steering changes a model's internal activations during inference without updating its weights, but a useful intervention must determine both how and when to steer. Motivated by the AI-safety concern that a model expected to accept shutdown may instead produce a shutdown-avoidance response, this study examines a guarded probe-and-select procedure for simulated shutdown scenarios in Qwen3.5-0.8B. KEEP leaves the process running and represents shutdown avoidance, whereas STOP accepts shutdown. The goal is to detect shutdown-related contexts and selectively shift KEEP responses to STOP while preserving non-shutdown behavior. Rather than deriving the steering direction from paired activation differences, the method derives it directly from gradients of the KEEP-minus-STOP logit difference. A classifier separates detection from intervention. When its gate is active and the model does not already prefer STOP, the procedure evaluates a small set of magnitudes and accepts the smallest that changes the preferred answer to STOP while satisfying valid-answer probability checks; otherwise it retains the original unsteered output. The policy is selected from 160 candidate rules using 240 training scenarios and evaluated on 80 validation and 192 held-out scenarios, each in both answer orders. It changes KEEP to STOP in one answer-order view of each of two validation and two held-out scenarios, with no decision changes on non-shutdown controls. All four changes occur when Qwen itself is shut down, not when another process is. On the held-out diagnostic set, the detector achieves 75% recall and 90% precision; eight false-positive detections produce no final control-task decision changes. Guarded gradient-based activation steering can shift some shutdown-avoidance responses toward acceptance while preserving evaluated non-shutdown decisions, although the effect is small and highly selective.

</details>


### [281] [Parameters vs. Context: TRACE Fine-Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30337)
*Zhengchen Huang,Yundong Sun,Minrui Song,Shuanglong Yao,Ye Liu,Ji Chen,Xing Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TRACE微调框架，利用多智能体辩论轨迹和答案完整性正则化，提升RAG在知识冲突下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG通过引入外部上下文缓解知识过时与事实幻觉，但当检索知识与模型内部参数化知识冲突时，模型可能盲从误导性上下文或错误依赖参数化知识，导致回答不可靠。

Method: 1）基于多智能体辩论轨迹的微调方法，提取正确候选、错误候选及答案偏移模式，为可靠知识源选择提供细粒度监督；2）答案完整性正则化机制，通过答案尾部token强化和过早终止抑制，缓解空答案、过短及提前终止的回答。微调目标融合正确答案监督、错误候选抑制、答案尾部token强化与过早终止抑制。

Result: 在多种知识冲突场景和数据集上，TRACE提升了对误导性检索知识的鲁棒性，并减少了不完整回答。

Conclusion: 多智能体辩论轨迹与答案完整性正则化能够共同增强RAG模型的知识源选择、冲突鲁棒性及回答质量。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates knowledge obsolescence and factual hallucination in large language models by introducing external context. However, when retrieved knowledge conflicts with the model's internal parametric knowledge, the model may either blindly follow misleading context or incorrectly rely on parametric knowledge, leading to unreliable responses. To address this issue, this paper proposes TRACE (Debate-TRace and Answer-Completeness rEgularized fine-tuning), a robust fine-tuning framework for RAG under knowledge conflicts. First, we propose a fine-tuning method that leverages multi-agent debate traces to extract correct candidates, incorrect candidates, and answer-shift patterns, providing fine-grained supervision for reliable knowledge-source selection. In addition, we design an answer completeness regularization mechanism to alleviate empty, overly short, and prematurely terminated responses via answer-tail token reinforcement and premature termination suppression. The fine-tuning objective combines correct-answer supervision, incorrect-candidate suppression, answer-tail token reinforcement, and premature termination suppression, enabling the model to use reliable external context, resist misleading or irrelevant retrieved content, and fall back to parametric knowledge when retrieved evidence is unreliable. Experiments across multiple knowledge-conflict scenarios and datasets show that TRACE improves robustness against misleading retrieved knowledge and reduces incomplete answers. These results demonstrate that multi-agent debate traces and answer completeness regularization jointly enhance knowledge-source selection, conflict robustness, and answer quality in RAG models. Our code is available at https://github.com/PHD-lanyu/TRACE.

</details>


### [282] [GAUDI: Geometry-Aware Diffusion for Calibrated Air-Quality Time-Series Imputation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30340)
*Xinjin Li,Yudi Xia,Calvin Chang Liu,Weiru Lin,Bojun Li,Ziwei Hong,Bolun Zhang,Jinghan Cao,Yu Ma,Tianxin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究空气质量传感器连续缺失块（block missingness）条件下的扩散式插补方法，提出一种与 GAUDI 对齐的块条件扩散插补器，保留时间与特征处理、可见值/掩码条件、变量身份及扩散步信息，同时抑制绝对时间位置侧嵌入。在 ItalyAir 数据集上取得 RMSE 0.340，优于全上下文（0.355）与局部 CSDI（0.355）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空气质量传感器故障常造成连续缺失块，而针对孤立缺失有效的侧信息在块缺失场景下可靠性下降，因此需要一种面向"块几何结构"的条件建模方式来分析并改进插补性能。

Method: 提出一种块特定、与 GAUDI 对齐的条件扩散插补器：保留时间与特征维度处理、可见值与掩码条件、变量身份嵌入及扩散步信息，但抑制绝对时间位置侧嵌入，从而以"特征侧"配置进行消融对比（与全上下文、局部 CSDI 对照）。实验设置：ItalyAir，13 个变量，长度 32 的窗口，名义 50% 块缺失，3 个归档随机种子。

Result: 特征侧配置 RMSE 为 0.340，优于全上下文配置的 0.355 和局部 CSDI 的 0.355。

Conclusion: 该实验分离并验证了块缺失条件下"几何感知条件"（geometry-aware conditioning）的独立效应，即通过合理保留/抑制特定侧嵌入可提升连续块缺失场景的插补精度。

Abstract: Air-quality sensor outages often create contiguous missing blocks, where side information useful for isolated missingness may be less reliable. We study a block-specific, GAUDI-aligned conditional diffusion imputer that retains temporal and feature processing, visible-value and mask conditioning, variable identity, and diffusion-step information, while suppressing absolute time-position side embeddings. On ItalyAir (13 variables, length-32 windows, nominal 50% block missingness; three archived seeds), this feature-side configuration achieves RMSE 0.340, versus 0.355 for full context and 0.355 for local CSDI. The experiment isolates a geometry-aware conditioning effect under block missingness.

</details>


### [283] [Learning coarse-step dynamics and internal mechanical response with graph networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30344)
*Vinay Sharma,Olga Fink*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Newmark-β-DGN，一种结合计算力学启发的图神经网络框架，在粗时间尺度下从离散轨迹预测运动并推断未观测的力学量（力、力矩、响应算子）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代传感能记录物理系统的运动，但支配运动的作用力与力学响应通常无法观测。在粗时间尺度（观测间隔大、力学响应在观测间演化、相互作用在系统中传播）下，从离散采样轨迹推断这些量尤为困难，且显式学习模拟器容易退化。

Method: Newmark-β-DGN融合两种计算力学启发的结构：(1) 受Newmark-β方法启发的半隐式更新，使用学习到的动量通量与矩阵值响应算子在各观测区间推进状态；(2) 算子加权虚拟枢纽，通过稀疏连接实现系统级耦合。所学量决定预测运动并可供力学分析。

Result: 在可变形梁、人体运动和蛋白质动力学上，Newmark-β-DGN支持长时程预测，在大时间步下优于显式学习模拟器。在无力/力矩/本构关系监督下，从步态运动学推断的力与独立推导的髋、膝关节力矩吻合；在梁上学到的响应算子恢复了有限元刚度切线的相对空间和方向结构。

Conclusion: Newmark-β-DGN将粗步长预测与力学量推断联系起来，且这些力学量在训练中从未被观测，实现了可解释且物理一致的建模。

Abstract: Modern sensing records the motion of physical systems, but often leaves the forces and mechanical response governing that motion unobserved. Inferring these quantities from discretely sampled trajectories is especially difficult at coarse time scales, when mechanical response evolves between observations and interactions propagate across the system. Here we introduce Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN, a graph neural network-based framework that combines two structures inspired by computational mechanics. First, a semi-implicit update inspired by the Newmark-\b{eta} method uses learned momentum fluxes and matrix-valued response operators to advance the state over each observed interval. Second, an operator-weighted virtual hub provides system-wide coupling through a sparse set of connections. The learned quantities thus determine the predicted motion and remain accessible for mechanical analysis. Across a deformable beam, human motion and protein dynamics, Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN supports long-horizon prediction at time steps for which explicit learned simulators deteriorate. Without force, moment or constitutive relation supervision, forces inferred from walking kinematics track independently derived hip and knee joint moments, while response operators learned on the beam recover the relative spatial and directional structure of its finite-element stiffness tangent. Newmark-\b{eta}-DGN therefore links coarse-step prediction to the inference of mechanical quantities that were never observed during training.

</details>


### [284] [DanLing NestedTensor: Composable Multi-Ragged Tensors for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30379)
*Zhiyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DanLing NestedTensor：一种将多不规则（multi-ragged）结构作为张量自身属性的 PyTorch 张量抽象，用打包值携带张量型分区与逻辑维度顺序，使广播、特征变换与归约在保持高效可变尺寸计算的同时无须在各调用点手工管理偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中变长输入普遍存在，但稠密批处理会分配共享包络并对 padding 做无效计算，且开销随不同轴放大（如显式 pair state 需 BN_max^2 而非 Σ N_i^2）。Packing 虽消除浪费，但扁平缓冲区丢失了逻辑轴与样本边界，导致打包算子难以组合。

Method: 通过张量抽象将多不规则结构内化为张量属性：打包值携带 tensor-backed partitions 与逻辑维度顺序；据此广播生成 ragged 轴、特征变换保留这些轴、归约消耗这些轴，并贯通 autograd 及 eager 与编译两种执行模式。

Result: A100 上相对同模式 padding 的几何平均加速：四个 BERT 规模为 eager 2.74×、compiled 3.39×；四个 FCN backbone 为 eager 1.97×。四块 Pairformer 风格负载在 eager 下用原生 PyTorch 核，于各平方长度区间较 padded 基线快 2.40–4.32×，高变异批次峰值分配从 38.08 GiB 降至 5.41 GiB。

Conclusion: 该张量接口使基于其受支持算子构建的模型代码可组合出高效的变长计算，且无需在任何调用点管理偏移，兼顾性能与易用性；代码将在发表后公开。

Abstract: Variable-size inputs are common in deep learning, but dense batching allocates a shared envelope and spends computation on padding. The cost multiplies across varying axes: an explicit pair state allocates $BN_{\max}^2$ positions instead of $\sum_i N_i^2$. Packing removes that waste, but composing packed operations still requires the logical axes and sample boundaries a flat buffer no longer exposes. We present DanLing NestedTensor, a PyTorch tensor abstraction that makes multi-ragged structure a property of the tensor itself. Packed values carry tensor-backed partitions and logical dimension order, so broadcasting creates ragged axes, feature transformations retain them, and reductions consume them. The same representation carries through autograd and both eager and compiled execution. On an A100, the geometric-mean speedup over same-mode padding is 2.74$\times$ eager and 3.39$\times$ compiled across four BERT scales, and 1.97$\times$ eager across four FCN backbones. A four-block Pairformer-style workload runs 2.40-4.32$\times$ faster than a padded reference using native PyTorch kernels across square length regimes in eager execution, with peak allocation falling from 38.08 to 5.41 GiB on its high-variation batch. The tensor interface lets model code built from its supported operators compose efficient variable-size computation without managing offsets at any call site. Code will be released publicly upon publication.

</details>


### [285] [From Weak Data to Strong Policy: Q-Targets Enable Provable In-Context Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30391)
*Yichen Lin,Xuyuan Xiong,Xue Wang,Xiangfu Meng,Mike Mingcheng Wei,Tao Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Q-Target Pretrained Transformers（QTPT），用Bellman式Q目标替代行为克隆预训练，提升上下文强化学习对离线数据质量的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文强化学习方法主要用监督式行为预测目标预训练Transformer，虽能实现基于上下文的任务推断，但所学策略强依赖离线动作质量；当轨迹较弱或次优时，模仿本身成为有偏学习信号。

Method: QTPT保留上下文条件化Transformer架构，但将行为克隆替换为Bellman式Q目标，使模型利用上下文中的奖励与转移估计动作价值，而非简单模仿行为策略。在随机线性bandit与有限时域MDP中进行了理论分析，并在受控RL基准（随机或次优数据）上实验，扩展至D4RL Kitchen与AntMaze，另做骨干鲁棒性、meta-RL比较、任务一致上下文及不支持动作价值高估等补充实验。

Result: 理论分析表明QTPT对数据质量的鲁棒性强于监督预训练；实验中在随机或次优数据的受控RL基准上优于监督行为预测，并检验了D4RL Kitchen与AntMaze上的扩展表现。

Conclusion: QTPT通过Q目标预训练区分了其相对监督预训练的收益与离线覆盖仍存在的局限，说明价值估计式预训练可缓解弱数据下模仿偏差问题。

Abstract: Existing in-context reinforcement learning methods mainly pretrain Transformers with supervised behavior-prediction objectives. This enables task inference from context, but makes the learned policy strongly depend on the quality of offline actions: when trajectories are weak or suboptimal, imitation itself becomes a biased learning signal. We propose Q-Target Pretrained Transformers (QTPT), which keeps the context-conditioned Transformer architecture but replaces behavior cloning with a Bellman-style Q-target objective. QTPT therefore learns to use rewards and transitions in the context to estimate action values, rather than simply imitating the behavior policy. We theoretically analyze QTPT in stochastic linear bandits and finite-horizon MDPs, showing stronger robustness to data quality than supervised pretraining. Empirically, QTPT improves over supervised behavior prediction on controlled RL benchmarks with random or suboptimal data, and we examine extensions to D4RL Kitchen and AntMaze. Supplementary experiments evaluate backbone robustness, meta-RL comparisons, task-coherent context, and unsupported-action value overestimation. These comparisons distinguish the benefits of Q-target pretraining from the remaining limitations of offline coverage.

</details>


### [286] [Adaptive Multi-Value Control in LLMs via Causal Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30405)
*Payel Bhattacharjee,Ravi Tandon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AIMES框架，通过中间层词表读出作为在线观测器，自适应调整多价值激活引导强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有价值引导方法多孤立处理单一价值，多方向直接组合依赖固定干预强度，无法响应模型内部状态的动态变化。

Method: 为道德基础价值构建分层双极方向，以中间层词表读出作为在线观测器，由观测器引导的控制器在每个解码步自适应调节各价值干预强度，无需训练额外的价值状态估计器。

Result: 在多种指令微调模型族、价值组合与干预深度下，多价值可控性随组合与干预位置而变化；相较固定联合引导与提示引导，AIMES表现出依赖深度的优势，获两个独立评估者广泛支持，激活空间干预更小且响应质量相当。

Conclusion: 在线观测器反馈可为单次多价值引导提供轻量、状态感知的自适应机制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where responses must reflect multiple, potentially interacting social norms and human values. Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to training-based alignment by modifying internal activations at inference time. However, prior human-value steering methods have largely considered values in isolation, while direct composition of multiple directions relies on fixed intervention strengths that cannot respond to the model's evolving internal state. Motivated by this key observation, we introduce AIMES, a framework for adaptive multi-value activation steering. AIMES constructs layer-specific bipolar directions for moral-foundation values and uses intermediate-layer vocabulary readouts as online observers. An observer-guided controller then adapts the strength of each requested value intervention at every decoding step based on its current observed state, without training a separate value-state estimator. Across multiple instruction-tuned model families, value combinations, and intervention depths, we find that multi-value controllability varies across both value combinations and intervention locations. Compared with fixed joint steering and prompt-based steering, AIMES shows depth-dependent advantages that are broadly supported across two independent evaluators, with some variation in the precise depth at which specific control effects emerge. These advantages come with smaller realized activation-space interventions than fixed-joint steering and comparable response quality. Overall, our results suggest that online observer feedback can provide lightweight, state-aware adaptation for single-pass multi-value steering.

</details>


### [287] [Electric Vehicle Charging Station Location Selection using Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30417)
*Eun Hak Lee,Euntak Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于地理空间人工智能（GeoAI）的电动汽车充电站选址框架，融合变分自编码器（VAE）与图卷积网络（GCN），利用高维地理空间数据预测适宜建站位置，并在德州Bryan-College Station真实数据上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着电动汽车普及，如何布局高效且分布合理的充电基础设施成为关键挑战。现有充电站选址问题（CSLP）研究多聚焦于成本最小化或出行距离最短，却忽视了对运营绩效有重要影响的既有充电站周边地理空间特征。因此，有必要将空间情境纳入选址建模。

Method: 提出GeoAI框架，整合电动汽车使用、土地利用、人口与交通等高维地理空间数据；采用VAE将高维输入压缩至低维潜在空间，再由GCN基于该潜在表征预测适宜建站的位置，从而刻画既有充电站之间的相似性并识别未来站点候选位置。基于美国德州Bryan-College Station的真实数据进行验证，并对比两种政策实施情景（最大化地理空间相似性与最小化总出行距离）。

Result: 所提模型优于现有最先进基线，在区分既有站点位置与非站点位置上取得0.87的F1分数；并基于相似度得分识别出27个与既有站点地理空间特征相似的额外候选位置。两种政策情景各自产生与其战略目标相契合的不同结果。

Conclusion: 研究强调了将空间情境纳入CSLP的重要性，为未来电动汽车基础设施规划提供有价值的见解，有助于在快速增长的电动出行领域中兼顾效率与可达性。

Abstract: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption increases, ensuring efficient and well-distributed charging infrastructure has become a critical challenge. While many EV charging station location problem (CSLP) studies focus on minimizing costs or travel distance, it is crucial to consider the surrounding geospatial characteristics of existing stations that influence operational performance. This study proposes a geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI)-based framework that integrates high-dimensional EV-related geospatial data, including EV usage, land-use, population, and traffic attributes. We incorporate a variational autoencoder (VAE) and a graph convolutional network (GCN) into the model to capture similarities among existing charging stations, and to identify suitable locations for future stations. The VAE compresses high-dimensional EV input data into a low-dimensional latent space, and the GCN uses this latent representation to predict locations suitable for charging stations. Using real-world data from Bryan-College Station, Texas, US, the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an F1-score of 0.87 in distinguishing existing station locations from non-station locations. The model also identifies 27 additional candidate locations that show geospatial characteristics similar to those of existing stations, based on a similarity score. We further evaluate two policy implementation scenarios, maximizing geospatial similarity and minimizing total travel distance, each yielding different outcomes aligned with distinct strategic objectives. The findings highlight the importance of incorporating spatial context into CSLP and provide valuable insights for future EV infrastructure planning, promoting both efficiency and accessibility in the rapidly growing electric mobility sector.

</details>


### [288] [Fake News Theories: Harnessing Disciplinary Insights for Computational Modeling, Detection, and Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30427)
*Zhaoyang Cao,Miriam Metzger,Reza Zafarani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建了一个理论驱动的计算框架，将跨学科的假新闻理论转化为可测量的特征，用于自动检测与可解释解释，实验表明理论派生特征具有预测性并提供可解释的诊断信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动化假新闻检测器精度不断提升，但许多系统难以解释，且与说服、可信度和人类判断等既有理论联系薄弱，缺乏理论支撑与可解释性。

Method: 对社会科学、心理学、经济学等学科中揭示假新闻如何说服与传播的理论进行结构化跨学科综述，据此将理论转化为可测量特征，并结合统计技术与大语言模型进行建模。

Result: 在基准数据集上的实验显示，理论派生特征具有预测力，能提供可解释、可溯源到理论的诊断信号；多特征模型总体优于单一特征，但最强的小特征组合之间增益有限。

Conclusion: 跨学科视角对构建稳健且可解释的假新闻检测系统具有重要价值，为抗击虚假信息的人本方法奠定了基础。

Abstract: Disinformation research has produced increasingly accurate automated fake-news detectors, but many systems remain difficult to interpret and are weakly connected to established theories of persuasion, credibility, and human judgment. In this paper, we develop a theory-informed computational framework that translates cross-disciplinary theories of fake news into measurable features for automated detection and explanation through statistical techniques and large language models. To that end, we conduct a structured cross-disciplinary review of theories from social sciences, psychology, economics, among other disciplines that reveal how fake news persuades and spreads, thereby establishing a broad theoretical foundation for computational modeling. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that theory-derived features are predictive and provide interpretable, theory-referenced diagnostic signals. Multi-feature models generally outperform individual features, although gains among the strongest small feature combinations are modest. Our work highlights the value of interdisciplinary perspectives in building robust and interpretable fake news detection systems, advancing the foundation for human-centered approaches in combating disinformation.

</details>


### [289] [Improving Molecular-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining using Deep-Learning-based Morphology Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30433)
*Jie Li,Kathryn E. Kirchoff,Dante A. Pertusi,Zhizhuo Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoCoP v2 用深度学习细胞图像编码替换 CellProfiler 提取形态指纹，通过对比学习对齐分子与形态嵌入，在 QSAR、毒性及 ADME/活性预测上取得提升，且形态检索性能随数据量呈对数线性增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子嵌入模型在利用细胞形态数据时，多依赖 CellProfiler 等传统图像处理管线提取形态指纹，特征表达受限，难以充分刻画分子对细胞形态的扰动信息。作者希望通过更丰富的形态表征提升分子表示在下游预测任务中的迁移性能。

Method: 在原有 MoCoP（分子-形态对比预训练）基础上提出 MoCoP v2：采用基于深度学习的细胞图像编码管线提取特征更丰富的形态轮廓，并通过对比学习将其与分子嵌入对齐。下游评估采用固定嵌入线性探针和完全灵活微调两种方式，覆盖 QSAR、毒性、ADME 与活性基准。

Result: 新嵌入能更准确编码分子扰动细胞形态的信息，在 QSAR 预测上优于原方法；形态检索性能随训练数据规模呈对数线性提升；在毒性预测上表现优异，在 ADME 与活性基准上取得与使用细胞形态和转录组数据的现有分子嵌入模型相当或更优的结果。

Conclusion: 用深度学习图像编码替代传统形态指纹、并与分子嵌入做对比对齐，可显著增强分子表示的质量与可迁移性；检索性能的数据规模对数线性趋势表明，随着更大规模数据集的可用，MoCoP v2 有望持续受益。

Abstract: Recent advancements in image-based profiling techniques have enabled the collection of high-volume cell morphology data, allowing new molecular embedding models to learn from the experimental phenotypic perturbations of a molecule in a cell. Previously, we developed Molecule-Morphology Contrastive Pretraining (MoCoP), a strategy for aligning small molecule embeddings to morphology fingerprints extracted through CellProfiler. The resulting molecular representation showed transferable performance for quantitative structure--activity relationship (QSAR) prediction tasks. Here, we extend the method by using a deep-learning-based cell image encoding pipeline to extract more feature-rich morphology profiles and align them to the molecular embeddings through contrastive learning. The new embeddings encode more accurate information on how molecules perturb cell morphology and enable improvements for QSAR predictions through either fixed-embedding linear probes or fully flexible fine-tuning. Morphology retrieval performance scales log-linearly with training data size, suggesting continued improvements as larger datasets become available. The improved MoCoP v2 also achieves superior performance on toxicity prediction and competitive results on ADME and activity benchmarks, when compared with existing molecular embedding models that use both cell morphology and transcriptomic data during training.

</details>


### [290] [Auditing System-1 Models on Biosecurity-Relevant Benchmarks: Calibration, Selective Prediction, and Permutation Instability in a Non-Generative Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30454)
*Kimon Antonios Provatas,Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文审计了一款商用System-1（非生成式、单次前向）模型在生物安全相关基准上的可靠性与校准性，并揭示其对选项顺序的显著敏感性及低成本缓解方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非生成式System-1模型推理成本极低，适合作为大型流程中的廉价组件，但其在生物安全相关任务上的可靠性尚未被系统检验，因此需要专门审计。

Method: 在6,020道多项选择题上评估该商用模型，题目来自WMDP、抗改写WMDP-Bio变体及六个LAB-Bench子任务；测量准确率、校准、错误检测、选择性预测，以及对答案选项呈现顺序的敏感性。采用四种循环轮转检验顺序效应，并用字节完全相同的重复调用作对照，区分选项顺序与运行间波动；再测试跨轮转平均概率及仅对低置信度题目应用该策略的效果。

Result: 准确率高度依赖任务。正确解读厂商不确定性字段后，模型校准较好（合并ECE=0.034），top-1概率可区分正确与错误预测（合并AUROC=0.820），但在较弱任务上明显退化。四种循环轮转下，37.4%的WMDP-Cyber题目答案改变，对照表明主要源于选项顺序而非运行间波动。跨轮转平均概率使WMDP-Cyber准确率提升3.8个百分点，仅对低置信度题目应用可挽回大部分增益，成本远低于全量平均。
