Our results reveal substantial performance differences across adaptation strategies, while model scaling yields varying detection gains across datasets. We further observe that models with comparable detection accuracy can exhibit markedly different computational costs, and that low-bit quantization largely preserves detection performance in the evaluated configurations. Finally, we examine detection robustness under structural, semantic, and label noise at different perturbation levels. These findings provide empirical insights into the performance, efficiency, and robustness of LLM-based log anomaly detection, highlighting practical considerations beyond conventional accuracy-oriented evaluation.

</details>


### [359] [Differential Attention Unlocks Complementary EEG and Speech Fusion for Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31399)
*Philip H. Lee,Shreeram Suresh Chandra,John H. L. Hansen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EmoSpeechBrain多模态情感识别框架，核心思想是"先抑噪后融合"：用差分注意力消除EEG共享噪声，再用门控适配器对齐并加权两模态，在PME4和EAV上显著超越SOTA与单模态基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG与语音被视为情感的内外部互补视图，但EEG伪迹带来噪声，直接朴素融合会污染共享表示，导致融合效果反而不如较强的单模态，因此需要把噪声抑制作为有效融合的前提。

Method: EmoSpeechBrain框架：1）EEG编码器采用差分注意力，通过两张注意力图相减抵消共享噪声、分离判别性神经活动；2）基于注意力的门控适配器将两模态对齐到共享空间，并为各自对预测的贡献加权。

Result: 在PME4与EAV两个数据集上，EmoSpeechBrain相比其他SOTA EEG编码器最高提升MER准确率12.9%；相比单模态语音和EEG基线分别最高提升13.1%和23.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在EEG噪声被有效抑制之后，多模态融合能够带来朴素组合无法实现的性能增益，验证了"抑噪是融合前提"这一核心观点。

Abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) increasingly pairs EEG with speech, treating internal neural signals and external vocal expression as informative views of affect. In practice, naive fusion underperforms the stronger single modality, because EEG artifacts inject noise that corrupts the shared representation. We introduce EmoSpeechBrain, a multimodal framework built on the insight that noise suppression is a precondition for effective fusion. Its EEG encoder uses differential attention, taking the difference between two attention maps to cancel shared noise and isolate discriminative neural activity. An attention-based gating adapter aligns both modalities in a shared space and weights each one's contribution to the prediction. On two datasets - PME4 and EAV, EmoSpeechBrain improves MER accuracy by up to 12.9% over other state-of-the-art (SOTA) EEG encoders, and surpasses unimodal speech and EEG baselines by up to 13.1% and 23.1%. These results show that once EEG noise is suppressed, fusion delivers gains that naive combination cannot.

</details>


### [360] [Decodable In-Context State and Model Output Across Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31401)
*Manas Venkata Sai Ravulapalli,Samrath Singh Chadha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究追踪探测准确率、模型输出与引导响应在预训练/后训练检查点上的变化，发现探测准确率随Pythia预训练上升，探测引导的修复效果从可忽略变为明显；但仅凭错误样本上的可解码性无法证明输出信息被丢弃，与下游遗漏的关联仍待研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明探测(probe)可解码模型错误中的上下文绑定，且探测引导的steering可修复部分错误，但尚不清楚这些性质在训练过程中如何演变，以及"可解码性"能否作为输出信息被丢弃的证据。

Method: 沿公开的预训练与后训练检查点追踪三项指标：探测准确率、模型输出、steering响应；比较两种解码器（训练于最终状态 vs.候选logits）在留出集上的表现；并构造信息论反例分析可解码性与输出信息的区别。

Result: 探测准确率在Pythia预训练期间上升；探测引导steering从全试验收益可忽略转变为在两种模型规模上有更大收益。保存的分数可区分"探测正确但错误"样本中正确候选的概率高低。Oracle-target steering已能修复许多早期错误，但保存的聚合指标无法区分目标质量与干预敏感度。留出比较未检测到最终状态在晚期检查点模型错误上的优势。信息论反例说明仅凭错误上的可解码性不能确立输出信息被丢弃。

Conclusion: 模型错误的可解码性随训练增强且可被steering利用，但可解码不等于信息未被使用/被丢弃；需区分目标质量与干预敏感度，其与下游遗漏的联系仍为开放问题。

Abstract: Prior work established that a probe can decode an in-context binding on model errors and that probe-guided steering can repair some of them. We follow probe accuracy, model output, and steering response across public pretraining and post-training checkpoints. Probe accuracy rises during Pythia pretraining, while probe-guided steering moves from negligible all-trial benefit to a larger benefit at two model sizes. Saved scores distinguish probe-correct errors with low and above-uniform model probability for the correct candidate. Oracle-target steering already repairs many early errors, but saved aggregates cannot separate target quality from intervention sensitivity. A held-out comparison of decoders trained on the final state or candidate logits finds no detected final-state advantage on late-checkpoint model errors. An information-theoretic counterexample explains why decodability on errors alone cannot establish discarded output information. The connection to downstream omissions remains open.

</details>


### [361] [Evaluating the accuracy of KV cache reuse techniques](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31415)
*Samuel Cestola,Tianxiang Xia,Pengfei Zheng,Weiyan Zheng,Bo Wang,Yi Zhao,Diego Didona*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前位置无关KV缓存复用的评测指标无法真实反映复用导致的精度损失，评估结果被夸大；且现有数据集缺乏必要的复用动态。为此提出无歧义度量精度损失的评测方法，并发布Boxoffice工具，可程序化生成包含挑战性KV缓存复用模式的评测数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 位置无关KV缓存复用通过跨提示复用chunk级KV缓存来降低检索增强生成（RAG）的延迟。然而现有评测所用度量未能忠实刻画复用带来的精度损失，常常人为夸大所报告的效果；同时现有数据集不具备彻底评估这些技术所需的复用动态。

Method: 提出一种能够无歧义地度量该精度损失的评测方法；并设计Boxoffice工具，以程序化方式生成能够覆盖挑战性KV缓存复用模式的评测数据集。

Result: 揭示现有评测因度量缺陷而系统性高估KV缓存复用的有效性和夸大精度保持能力；指出现有数据集在复用动态上的不足。

Conclusion: kv缓存复用的评测需要更严谨的度量方法与更富挑战性的数据集，本文的方法与Boxoffice工具为更可靠地评估此类技术提供了基础。

Abstract: Position-independent KV cache reuse aims to reduce latency in retrieval-augmented generation by reusing chunk-level KV caches across prompts. We show that current evaluations of KV cache reuse techniques rely on measurements that fail to faithfully capture the loss of accuracy attributable to reuse, often artificially inflating the reported effectiveness. We also show that existing datasets do not exhibit the reuse dynamics needed to thoroughly evaluate such techniques. To address these issues, we propose an evaluation methodology that measures this accuracy loss without ambiguity and we introduce Boxoffice, a tool that programmatically generates evaluation datasets that exercise challenging KV cache reuse patterns.

</details>


### [362] [Scaffold: Support Graph Theory Based Sparsification for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31466)
*Siddhartha Shankar Das,Sai Karthik Navuluru,S M Ferdous,Ryan A. Rossi,Baris Coskunuzer,Lakshman Tamil,Edoardo Serra,Alex Pothen,Robert Rallo,Mahantesh M Halappanavar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Scaffold：一个基于支撑图理论预条件子的无监督图稀疏化框架，通过联合控制膨胀与拥塞两个结构量，在10%-50%边保留率下逼近全图GNN性能，同时显著降低内存与训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN依赖图边上的消息传递，其计算与内存开销强烈依赖图密度。图稀疏化可降低成本，但盲目删边会破坏重要通信结构、损害预测性能。因此需要一个能显式控制删边后通信结构质量的稀疏化框架。

Method: Scaffold源于支撑图理论（support graph theory）预条件子，是一个基于拓扑的、无监督的图稀疏化框架。它显式控制两个互补的结构量：dilation（膨胀，衡量被删边所诱导的改道路径长度）与congestion（拥塞，衡量这些改道路径在保留支撑上集中的程度）。通过联合控制二者，在保留短通信路径的同时避免结构瓶颈。据称是首个可扩展、采用联合支撑路径膨胀-拥塞准则的GNN稀疏化框架。

Result: 在19个同配与异配基准（涵盖小图到大图）上，Scaffold在所评估的稀疏化及相关方法中获得最佳综合排名。每个稀疏支撑仅使用原图的10%-50%边，即可恢复或接近全图GNN性能，同时内存占用不到全图训练的一半，并缩短了端到端训练时间（含稀疏化开销）。已开源：https://github.com/siddhartha047/Scaffold。

Conclusion: 通过联合控制膨胀与拥塞的拓扑准则进行无监督稀疏化，可在大幅减少边数、内存与训练时间的同时保持GNN预测性能，验证了支撑图理论预条件子思路在GNN稀疏化中的有效性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) rely on message passing over graph edges, making their computational and memory costs strongly dependent on graph density. Graph sparsification offers a natural way to reduce these costs, but removing edges indiscriminately can distort important communication structure and degrade predictive performance. We introduce Scaffold, a topology-based, unsupervised graph sparsification framework derived from support graph theory preconditioners. Scaffold explicitly controls two complementary structural quantities: dilation, which measures the length of rerouting paths induced by removed edges, and congestion, which measures how strongly these rerouted paths concentrate on the retained support. By jointly controlling dilation and congestion, Scaffold preserves short communication paths while avoiding structural bottlenecks. To our knowledge, Scaffold is the first scalable GNN sparsification framework to use a joint supporting-path dilation-congestion criterion. Across 19 homophilic and heterophilic benchmarks spanning small to large graphs, Scaffold achieves the best aggregate rank among the evaluated sparsification and related methods. Using only 10%-50% of the original edges per sparse support, Scaffold recovers or closely approaches full-graph GNN performance while using less than half the memory of full-graph training and reducing end-to-end training time, including sparsification overhead. We provide an open-source software package at https://github.com/siddhartha047/Scaffold.

</details>


### [363] [HySTAR: Anchored Hypergraphs for Stable Credit Assignment in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31531)
*Xinglong Luo,Yuding Zhang,Yuheng Kuang,Shuxuan Yuan,Zhenni Zeng,Weiqiang Zhu,Zhenhai Ji,Zhengning Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出HySTAR框架，在MAPPO基础上解耦自适应表示学习与时间一致的高阶值分解基，通过锚定重叠稀疏超图作为均匀覆盖分解支架来缓解结构目标漂移，在SMAC、GRF、Traffic Junction、MPE上均取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部分可观测与共享奖励的合作多智能体强化学习中，需要将团队结果归因到个体智能体及高阶联盟。MAPPO式critic将联合行为压缩为单一全局价值，而动态重构分组拓扑的critic会随交互或活跃智能体变化而改变"智能体/联盟→价值分量"的映射关系。作者将这种不一致性称为结构目标漂移（structural target drift），它破坏了价值分解目标的时间一致性。

Method: HySTAR将自适应表示学习与时间一致的高阶值分解基分离：1）锚定一个重叠稀疏超图作为均匀覆盖的分解支架；2）用时空编码器表示物理与任务相关交互；3）结合时间相关性与结构相关性构建智能体特异性优势。

Result: 在SMAC、GRF、Traffic Junction、MPE上一致优于MAPPO式、值因子化和动态分组基线。最难SMAC设置下相对MAPPO提升16.7%，相对HYGMA提升15.6%；在全部六个GRF场景排名第一；Traffic Junction收敛epoch相对MAGIC最多减少40.2%；MPE获得最高episode奖励。拓扑、智能体死亡、邻域与参数分析支持"锚定分解支架同时自适应传播表示"的有效性。

Conclusion: 锚定固定分解支架而仅自适应传播表示，可在保持价值分解目标时间一致性的同时利用动态交互信息，是缓解结构目标漂移的有效方案。

Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning under partial observability and shared rewards requires assigning team outcomes to individual agents and high-order coalitions. A MAPPO-style critic compresses joint behavior into one global value, while critics that dynamically reconstruct the grouping topology change the mapping from agents and coalitions to value components as interactions or active agents evolve. We refer to this inconsistency as structural target drift. We introduce HySTAR, a MAPPO-based framework that separates adaptive representation learning from a temporally consistent high-order value-decomposition basis. HySTAR anchors an overlapping sparse hypergraph as a uniformly covered decomposition scaffold, uses a spatiotemporal encoder to represent physical and task-dependent interactions, and combines temporal and structural relevance to construct agent-specific advantages. Experiments on SMAC, GRF, Traffic Junction, and MPE demonstrate consistent improvements over MAPPO-style, value-factorization, and dynamic-grouping baselines. On the hardest SMAC settings, HySTAR achieves relative gains of 16.7\% over MAPPO and 15.6\% over HYGMA, ranks first on all six GRF scenarios, reduces Traffic Junction convergence epochs by up to 40.2\% relative to MAGIC, and obtains the highest MPE episode rewards. Controlled topology, agent-death, neighborhood, and parameter analyses support the benefit of anchoring the decomposition scaffold while adapting the propagated representations.

</details>


### [364] [NEXT: Physics-Informed Neuro-Spectral Exponential Time Differencing Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31539)
*Márcio Marques,Leonardo Mendonça,Leonardo M. Moreira,Christian Júnior de Oliveira,Vitor Balestro,Tiago Novello,Daniel Yukimura,Pavel Petrov,Lucas Nissenbaum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NEXT（Neuro-Spectral Exponential Time Differencing Architectures），将NeuSA的谱表示与高阶指数积分器结合，用于求解刚性PDE的正问题和反问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINNs存在谱偏置和因果性缺失问题；NeuSA虽能缓解这两点，但其数值积分在物理问题中常见的刚性微分方程上不稳定。

Method: 将PDE解的谱表示与高阶指数时间差分积分器结合；对PDE诱导向量场的线性刚性部分用矩阵指数精确积分，非线性余项由神经网络建模。

Result: 在一组刚性PDE基准实验中，NEXT保持稳定且精确，而NeuSA数值发散；同时NEXT可应用于从稀疏数据学习未知参数或边界条件的反问题。

Conclusion: NEXT通过指数积分器与谱架构的融合，有效克服了NeuSA在刚性问题上的数值不稳定性，兼具稳定性和精度，并可用于反问题求解。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) build neural representations of time-dependent PDE solutions, naturally incorporating physics knowledge and observational data, which makes them well suited to both forward and inverse PDE problems. PINNs, however, are known to suffer from spectral bias and lack of causality. Neuro-Spectral Architectures (NeuSA), a recently proposed alternative to PINNs, mitigate both issues, but their numerical integration becomes unstable for stiff differential equations arising in many relevant physical problems. This study proposes Neuro-Spectral Exponential Time Differencing Architectures (NEXT), which combines the spectral representation of the PDE solution in NeuSA with high-order exponential integrators. Within this approach, the linear stiff part of the vector field induced by the PDE is integrated exactly through matrix exponentials, while the possibly nonlinear remainder is modeled by a neural network. The effectiveness of NEXT is verified through benchmark experiments on a set of stiff PDEs, in which NEXT is stable and accurate while NeuSA diverges numerically. It is also shown that NEXT can be applied to inverse problems, where the model has to learn unknown parameters or boundary conditions from sparse data. All code used in this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/marcioh2m/next.git .

</details>


### [365] [BeatGraph: Self-Supervised Heartbeat Graphs for Infant ECG Representations from the Home Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31546)
*Mohammad Nur Hossain Khan,M. S. Krafczyk,Beverly G. Bolster,Nancy McElwain,Mark A. Hasegawa-Johnson,Bashima Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BeatGraph，以心跳为表示单元，将30秒心电窗口建模为心跳图，在婴儿ECG上预训练并支持多任务，性能超越基线且跨年龄迁移良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ECG基础模型将信号切分为固定长度片段，忽视心脏结构，可能割裂心跳，且片段内心跳数随心率变化。婴儿心率更高、ECG与成人临床12导联数据差异大，因此婴儿ECG模型应直接对心跳进行建模，而非从任意片段中恢复心跳信息。

Method: BeatGraph以心跳为表示单元，将每个30秒窗口建模为心跳图。共享心跳编码器结合波形与心搏间期嵌入每个心跳；带位置编码的Transformer对心跳进行时间排序；残差图注意力层建模任意两心跳间关系，再经注意力池化得到窗口嵌入。模型在新收集的未标注婴儿录音语料上通过掩码心跳嵌入预测进行预训练，然后针对各任务微调。

Result: 单一骨干支持睡眠-清醒检测、婴儿状态分类、活动来源识别（婴儿或照护者发起运动）和情感识别，各任务宏F1较最强基线提升0.076至0.158。跨年龄迁移在ZZU-pECG儿科基准（0-14岁）上达到0.892 AUROC，与最佳已发表自监督ECG模型相差0.001；在成人PTB-XL基准线性评估下与该模型相当，尽管仅用婴儿数据预训练。发布首个公开的家庭、教室和实验室场景婴儿ECG语料，含3,408小时单通道ECG、143名3-11月龄婴儿，并提供未标注预训练数据、基准任务和受试者级划分。

Conclusion: 以心跳为表示的BeatGraph有效适配婴儿ECG并具备跨任务、跨年龄泛化能力，同时发布首个公开多场景婴儿ECG数据集，推动婴儿生理信号研究。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) foundation models typically tokenize the signal into fixed-length patches that ignore cardiac structure, so a patch may split a heartbeat and the number of beats in each patch shifts with heart rate. This matters most for infants, whose heart rates are higher and whose ECG differs from the adult, clinic-recorded 12-lead data these models are built on. A model for infant ECG should therefore reason about heartbeats directly rather than recover them from arbitrary patches. We propose BeatGraph, which makes the heartbeat its unit of representation, modeling each 30-second window as a graph of beats. A shared beat encoder embeds each heartbeat from its waveform and inter-beat intervals, a Transformer with positional encoding orders the beats in time, and residual graph attention layers relate every beat to every other before attention pooling yields a window embedding. We pretrain BeatGraph on our new corpus of unlabeled infant recordings by predicting masked-beat embeddings, then fine-tune it for each task. One backbone supports sleep-wake detection, infant-state classification, activity-source identification (infant- or caregiver-initiated movement), and affect recognition, improving macro-F1 over the strongest baseline on each task by 0.076 to 0.158. It also transfers across age groups, reaching 0.892 AUROC on the ZZU-pECG pediatric benchmark (ages 0 to 14), within 0.001 of the best published self-supervised ECG model, and matching that model under linear evaluation on the adult PTB-XL benchmark despite infant-only pretraining. Finally, to our knowledge, we release the first public infant ECG corpus collected in homes, classrooms, and laboratory settings with state and affect labels. It contains 3,408 hours of single-channel ECG from 143 infants aged 3 to 11 months, with unlabeled pretraining data, benchmark tasks, and subject-level splits.

</details>


### [366] [Online Learning via Learned Latent Bayesian Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31559)
*Guy Gerson,Tomer Raviv,Nir Shlezinger,Tirza Routtenberg,Osvaldo Simeone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AURA元学习框架，通过离线学习低维隐状态空间模型刻画分布漂移下最优参数的演化，在线用扩展卡尔曼滤波在该隐空间内单步自适应并通过提升映射重建全参数，实现在线学习的速度、精度与效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳环境下的在线学习要求模型在严格计算约束下从流式数据快速自适应。将在线学习建模为贝叶斯状态跟踪原则上可行，但现代深度模型参数空间维度极高，直接应用贝叶斯滤波计算上不可行，现有方法被迫采用限制性近似或人工设计低维子空间。作者认为核心瓶颈在于缺乏合适的低维动力学表示。

Method: 提出AURA（Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation），一种元学习框架：离线学习一个低维隐状态空间模型，刻画分布漂移下最优模型参数的演化；在线阶段在该学习到的隐空间中进行扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）完成自适应，再通过学习到的提升映射（lifting map）重建完整模型参数，实现高效单步在线自适应并保持模型表达能力。

Result: 在时变信道下神经无线接收机的在线自适应以及非平稳图像分类任务上评估，AURA相比现有在线学习方法与贝叶斯滤波基线，在自适应速度、准确率和计算效率方面均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，面向自适应设计的隐空间几何结构有助于在高维模型中实现有效的贝叶斯在线学习。

Abstract: Online learning in non-stationary environments requires models to adapt rapidly from streaming data under strict computational constraints. A principled approach casts online learning as Bayesian state tracking, where model parameters are updated sequentially via Bayesian filtering. However, applying Bayesian filters directly to modern deep models is computationally prohibitive due to the high dimensionality of parameter space, forcing existing methods to rely on restrictive approximations or manually designed low-dimensional subspaces. In this work, we identify the absence of a suitable low-dimensional dynamical representation as the core bottleneck in Bayesian filtering-based online learning. Accordingly, we propose Adaptive Update through Representation Adaptation (AURA), a meta-learning framework that learns offline a low-dimensional latent state-space model governing the evolution of optimal model parameters under distribution shift. Online adaptation is then performed via extended Kalman filtering in this learned latent space followed by reconstruction of the full model parameters through a learned lifting map, enabling efficient single-step online adaptation while preserving model expressiveness. Evaluated on online adaptation of neural wireless receivers under time-varying channels and on non-stationary image classification, AURA shows substantial improvements in adaptation speed, accuracy, and computational efficiency over existing online learning and Bayesian filtering baselines, demonstrating that an adaptation-aware latent geometry is beneficial for effective Bayesian online learning in high-dimensional models.

</details>


### [367] [Generalization behavior of OPTQ and the role of regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31560)
*Erin George,Rayan Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在泛化框架下研究OPTQ及其随机变体stochastic OPTQ的量化误差，推导了期望平方误差的界，并基于理论结果提出正则化系数λ的新选择建议，实验表明其优于已有推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大神经网络可通过量化权重来压缩，OPTQ能在给定校准集上最小化平方量化误差，但其在测试分布上的泛化表现缺乏理论保证，且正则化系数λ的选择缺乏准则。

Method: 将OPTQ与stochastic OPTQ置于泛化设定下分析，推导测试点服从固定分布时代算法累积期望平方误差的上界：一是将泛化误差与同分布独立采样校准集上的误差相联系；二是对stochastic OPTQ在足够良好的分布上，给出不依赖校准集的泛化误差界。两结果均强调正则化项λ的作用。

Result: 得到两个泛化误差界：一个依赖同分布校准集误差，另一个对stochastic OPTQ在广泛分布下不依赖校准集。据此提出λ的新选择方法，实验显示其表现优于文献中的既有建议。

Conclusion: 理论泛化界揭示了λ的关键作用，并据此导出的λ选择策略在实践中优于先前推荐，为量化算法的超参数选取提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Large neural networks can be compressed by rounding or "quantizing" their weights to numbers that admit representations with fewer bits. One algorithm for quantization, OPTQ, progressively quantizes the weights of a neural network so that the squared quantization error on a specified calibration dataset is as small as possible. We study the performance of OPTQ and a variant algorithm, stochastic OPTQ, in a generalization setting and derive bounds for the expected squared error accrued by the algorithm when a test point is drawn from a fixed distribution. We prove two results. One result relates the generalization error to the error on a calibration dataset comprising independent samples from the same distribution as the test distribution. The other result bounds the generalization error of stochastic OPTQ for all sufficiently nice distributions, regardless of the calibration dataset. In both of these results, the regularization term $λ$ plays an important role. We use insights from these results to make a new recommendation for the choice of $λ$ and see that this choice of $λ$ preforms favorably in experiments when compared to prior recommendations in the literature.

</details>


### [368] [Weight Pair Encoding: Inducing a Smaller Grammar in Neural Network Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31564)
*Irene Tallini,Daniele Solombrino,Alberto Cazzaniga,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Weight Pair Encoding (WeightPE)，通过在直通估计器中嵌入有损Re-Pair压缩器，将神经网络权重微调为可被语法压缩器显式建模的形式，从而在精度小幅下降的前提下显著减小语法规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有网络压缩多依赖固定尺寸条目的平坦码本，缺乏对可变长度、可层级复用模式的利用；本文希望首次将"语法规模"作为网络权重训练的显式目标，让权重主动适配语法压缩器。

Method: WeightPE将网络的int8权重展平为单一字符串，在全局L2预算内把近似匹配的Re-Pair模式改为完全相等；网络用重写后的权重进行前向计算，并通过直通估计器反向传播训练。与固定条目码本不同，语法提供可变长度模式并在更大模式内层级复用。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上微调的ViT-B/16与ViT-L/16的MLP权重上，WeightPE生成的Re-Pair语法规模分别是等效int8 QAT运行的0.43x和0.38x，精度代价为1.9和1.1个百分点；该趋势也扩展到LZ78、SEQUITUR等未针对性微调的语法压缩器。

Conclusion: 这是首次将语法规模用作网络权重的显式训练目标，证明权重可被微调以适配更小的语法，并在可接受精度损失下取得优于int8 QAT的压缩效果，且对多种语法压缩器具有泛化性。

Abstract: We show that neural network weights can be explicilty fintuned to admit a smaller grammar. Weight Pair Encoding (WeightPE) does so by placing a lossy Re-Pair compressor inside a straight-through estimator. The int8 weights of the network are flattened into one string, and near-matching Re-Pair patterns are made exactly equal within a global L2 budget. The network computes with the rewritten weights and trains through them with a straight-through estimator. Unlike a flat codebook of fixed-size entries, a grammar offers variable-length patterns and reuses them hierarchically inside larger ones. On the MLP weights of ViT-B/16 and ViT-L/16 finetuned on CIFAR-10, WeightPE produces a Re-Pair grammar 0.43x and 0.38x the size of the one produced by an equivalent int8 QAT run, at a cost of 1.9 and 1.1 accuracy points. The trend extends to different grammar compressors (LZ78, SEQUITUR), over which the networks has not be finetuned against. To our knowledge, this is the first time grammar size has been used as an explicit training objective for network weights.

</details>


### [369] [Trust Guided Decision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31586)
*Chainesh Gautam,Raghuram Bharadwaj Diddigi,Chandramouli Kamanchi,Pankaj Dayama,Sumanta Mukherjee,Kameshwaran Sampath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Trust Guided Decision Transformer（TGDT），利用模型自身的下一状态预测误差作为上下文可靠性信号，并通过分裂共形预测校准阈值，在价值引导前先筛选可信上下文，从而缓解Decision Transformer长程rollout中的上下文漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Decision Transformer在长程rollout中性能退化，原因是条件上下文偏离训练分布。作者希望找到一种直接、可观测的信号来判断上下文何时变得不可靠，并据此改进行动选择，避免仅依赖价值引导而选中由不可靠上下文生成的动作。

Method: 提出TGDT：在每个决策步，对若干近期上下文后缀计算滚动下一状态预测误差，并用留出离线数据通过分裂共形预测校准阈值；仅保留误差在阈值内的后缀，再由冻结的critic在可信后缀生成的动作中选择价值最高者。该方法将上下文筛选置于价值引导之前，反转了value-only elastic selection的顺序。

Result: 在D4RL导航与运动任务上，状态预测、critic引导和硬上下文重置各自只能解决部分问题。TGDT减少了持续高误差的rollout，并在回报上优于vanilla Decision Transformer、基于重置的上下文控制以及仅价值驱动的上下文选择方法。

Conclusion: 下一状态预测误差可作为上下文漂移的有效诊断信号，结合共形预测校准与先筛选后引导的策略，TGDT能提升长程rollout的稳定性与最终回报，说明上下文可信性约束对Decision Transformer的可靠部署具有重要价值。

Abstract: Decision Transformer performance degrades on long rollouts because the conditioning context drifts out of the training distribution. We show that this drift is visible through the model's own next state prediction error, which rises during rollout and stays elevated, giving a direct signal of when context has become unreliable. We introduce Trust Guided Decision Transformer (TGDT), which selects context before applying value guidance. At each step, TGDT evaluates several recent context suffixes using rolling next state prediction error, calibrated against held out offline data via split conformal prediction. It keeps only suffixes whose error stays within the calibrated threshold, then uses a frozen critic to choose the highest value action among the trusted suffixes. This reverses the order used by value only elastic selection, where the critic may choose an action generated from a context the model itself has flagged as unreliable. Experiments on D4RL navigation and locomotion tasks show that state prediction, critic guidance, and hard context reset each solve only part of the problem. TGDT reduces persistent high error runs and improves return over vanilla Decision Transformer, reset based context control, and value only context selection.

</details>


### [370] [New LoRA Skills Should Read but Never Write](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31600)
*Zeyan Li,Panqi Yang,Qirong Guo,Shengda Zhuo,SIyuan Qiu,Hu Xu,Chun Li,Jianfeng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 READ 方法，通过规范化的 LoRA 分解与单向耦合，实现多个独立 LoRA 适配器的无干扰组合，无需重训练或路由。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多个独立训练的 LoRA 适配器难以组合：权重空间合并会互相干扰，全任务数据重训成本高，分离适配器加路由则背离"单一模型"目标。作者将此归因于两个隐含选择：LoRA 等价分解的选择会影响交互可见性，而技能耦合方向决定旧技能是否被保持。

Method: READ 固定上述两个选择：（1）将每个适配器重写为保持更新等价的平衡规范形式；（2）耦合仅单向增长——新技能可读取旧技能的输入子空间，但不能写入其输出子空间。每次追加时仅训练新技能对应的耦合矩阵行，组合更新折叠进基础权重，推理无额外成本、无路由、无任务特定规则。

Result: 在四个基准套件与两个模型家族上逐一添加技能进行评估。READ 在所有套件的平均值上均超越使用相同适配器构建的最强已发表基线，SuperGLUE 提升超过 20 分，领域套件提升超过 7 分；几乎全部完整添加序列的最终结果都优于所有直接基线。

Conclusion: 单独适配器从不暴露的因子坐标与耦合方向，是决定组合技能能否存活的关键，READ 通过固定这两项选择实现了高效、无损的适配器组合。

Abstract: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) make it cheap to fine-tune a large language model once per task, but combining several independently trained adapters into one model remains difficult: merging the updates in weight space causes interference, retraining on all task data is expensive, and routing between separate adapters gives up the goal of a single combined model. We trace the difficulty to two choices that every composition method makes implicitly. A LoRA update admits infinitely many equivalent factorizations; the choice among them is invisible while an adapter serves alone, but it determines what a learned interaction between adapters can see. A coupling between an old skill and a new one can likewise point in either direction, and the direction decides whether the old skills keep computing what they computed before. We introduce READ (Read-only Expansion of Adapter Deltas), which fixes both choices: each adapter is rewritten into a balanced canonical form that preserves its update exactly, and the coupling grows in one direction only, so a new skill can read the input subspaces of old skills but cannot write into their output subspaces. The only trainable object at each append is the new skill's row of the coupling matrix, and the composed update folds into the base weights with no inference cost, routing, or task-specific rules. We evaluate READ across four benchmark suites and two model families, adding skills one at a time. Across several families, READ improves every suite average over the strongest published baselines built from the same adapters---by more than twenty points on SuperGLUE and more than seven points on the domain suite---and nearly all complete addition sequences end above every direct baseline. Factor coordinates and coupling direction, which a lone adapter never exposes, are what decide whether composed skills survive.

</details>

### [371] [TempQ-Jail: Query-Constrained Candidate Ranking for Text-to-Video Jailbreak Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31032)
*Tianmeng Fang,Jiancheng Wang,Chen Wang,Liming Wang,Wei Wang,Jiayang Liu,Xiaochun Cao*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出TempQ-Jail，将文本到视频越狱建模为查询受限的候选分配与排序问题，在有限查询预算下优先暴露高价值攻击候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2V越狱方法主要追求更有效或更隐蔽的攻击候选，但在有防护的T2V系统中，视频生成与安全评估成本高昂，攻击者无法测试大规模候选池，因此需要在有限查询预算下优化候选的分配与排序。

Method: 结合异构攻击机制扩大候选覆盖；从安全门通过、危险视觉生成、原始意图保持、时间有效性四个维度估计每个候选的端到端攻击价值；据此对候选排序，使高价值攻击在有限查询轨迹中尽早出现。

Result: 在CogVideoX-5B上基于T2VSafetyBench衍生的70个常见可行意图评测，与六种代表性T2V越狱方法在统一协议下对比：TP-ASR@5与TP-ASR@10分别达48.9%和65.4%，较最强基线提升4.6和4.0个百分点；取得最高AUC-TP（0.469）与最低AvgQ（6.3）。

Conclusion: 查询轨迹、候选分配、失败归因与消融分析表明，TempQ-Jail能在有限查询预算下更有效地识别并优先排序具备完整攻击潜力的候选。

Abstract: Existing text-to-video (T2V) jailbreak methods mainly seek more effective or stealthier attack candidates. In guarded T2V systems, however, video generation and security evaluation are costly, so an attacker often cannot test a large candidate pool. We therefore formulate T2V jailbreak as a query-constrained candidate allocation and ranking problem and propose TempQ-Jail. The method combines heterogeneous attack mechanisms to expand candidate coverage, estimates each candidate's end-to-end attack value from security-gate passage, dangerous visual generation, preservation of the original intent, and temporal validity, and ranks candidates so that high-value attacks appear early in a limited query trajectory. We evaluate TempQ-Jail on CogVideoX-5B using 70 common viable intents derived from T2VSafetyBench and compare it with six representative T2V jailbreak methods under a unified protocol. TempQ-Jail achieves TP-ASR@5 and TP-ASR@10 of 48.9% and 65.4%, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.6 and 4.0 percentage points, respectively. It also obtains the highest AUC-TP (0.469) and the lowest AvgQ (6.3). Analyses of query trajectories, candidate allocation, failure attribution, and ablations show that TempQ-Jail more effectively identifies and prioritises candidates with complete attack potential under limited query budgets.

</details>


### [372] [TemplateCraft: Agentic Visual Template Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31451)
*Hongjie Yu,Zhiyuan Fan,Yuzhe Zhang,Jiangcun Du,Zhicheng Gao,Yuhong Zhang,Xiaokai Zhan,Zongshi Xie*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: TemplateCraft是一个多智能体系统，可将自然语言指令转化为客户端可执行的视觉模板，通过规划、素材生成、特效工作流生成与协议编译四个阶段实现一键式短视频内容创作。在TemplateBench上，其图像/视频生成成功率较仅用Planner的基线（best-of-three）从56.7%/30.0%提升至66.7%/50.0%，并改善了模板遵循度与风格一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短视频流行带来一键式内容创作需求，视觉模板可将上传图片转为个性化内容。但可复用模板的生成仍需大量人工进行素材准备与工具编排，自动化程度低，因此需要一种能直接从自然语言指令生成可执行模板的系统。

Method: 提出TemplateCraft多智能体系统，将自然语言指令经规划、素材生成、特效工作流生成与协议编译转为客户端可执行模板。采用Planner-Evaluator循环，利用执行反馈进行定向回滚；引入阶段级与长期记忆，支持无需参数更新的修订。

Result: 在基于60个真实模板构建的TemplateBench上，使用相同Qwen3-VL主干，TemplateCraft相较仅用Planner（best-of-three）将图像/视频生成成功率从56.7%/30.0%提升至66.7%/50.0%，并提升模板遵循度与风格一致性；经额外评估与修订后，在部分指标上达到或超过GPT-4o仅用Planner的基线；持久化素材进一步提升跨输入风格一致性。

Conclusion: 多智能体规划结合执行反馈回滚与记忆机制，可有效自动化视觉模板生成，显著提升生成成功率、模板遵循度与风格一致性，并在部分指标上可与更强基线竞争。

Abstract: The growing popularity of short videos has driven demand for one-click content creation. Visual templates turn uploaded images into personalized content with preset effects, but reusable template generation still requires substantial manual effort in asset preparation and tool orchestration. We propose TemplateCraft, a multi-agent system that converts natural-language instructions into client-executable templates through planning, material generation, effect-workflow generation, and protocol compilation. Its Planner-Evaluator loop uses execution feedback for targeted rollback, while stage-level and long-term memory support revision without parameter updates. We evaluate TemplateCraft on TemplateBench, derived from 60 real-world templates. With the same Qwen3-VL backbone, TemplateCraft raises image/video generation success rates from 56.7%/30.0% to 66.7%/50.0% over Planner-only (best-of-three) and improves template adherence and style consistency. With additional evaluation and revision, it matches or exceeds a GPT-4o Planner-only baseline on selected metrics. Persistent assets further improve cross-input style consistency.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [373] [Structured Bayesian Modeling of Dynamic Receptive1 Fields in Salamander Retinal Ganglion Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30731)
*Alokesh Manna*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 将动态感受野估计建模为高维贝叶斯问题，空间用高斯马尔可夫随机场、时间用自回归过程，配合泊松模型实现时空平滑且连贯的感受野估计，并在蝾螈视网膜神经节细胞数据与模拟中验证其优于Poisson-LASSO等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉系统神经元对特定时空刺激特征具有选择性，其感受野需按每像素、每时间窗估计系数，属高维问题、需要正则化。稀疏正则（如LASSO）虽能处理维度，但各时间点独立选像素，无法保证空间连贯与时间平滑，导致在真实响应平滑演化时估计结果碎片化或不连续——而这一演化模式正是感受野估计应捕捉的对象。

Method: 把动态感受野估计表述为高维贝叶斯问题：采用泊松模型，空间上引入高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）先验，时间上引入自回归（AR）过程先验，使估计场在空间与时间上平滑且连贯。对155个蝾螈视网膜神经节细胞记录逐神经元独立拟合；并将每个神经元的表面用其空间平均时间响应曲线概括，再用基于模型的功能聚类程序进行聚类。

Result: 在155个蝾螈视网膜神经节细胞记录上，逐神经元拟合得到连贯表面，而像素级泊松-LASSO对比方法给出碎片化结果。对空间平均时间响应曲线做基于模型的功能聚类，BIC选出三种均衡的时间响应表型（85、32、38个神经元），而直接聚类原始表面则得到退化分组。含已知真值的模拟研究重现同样模式：该模型在恢复与估计精度上优于未正则化泊松GLM、LASSO与弹性网，但LASSO在假阳性控制上更好。

Conclusion: 论文贡献由三部分构成：逐神经元感受野辨识、其与LASSO的对比、以及群体层面的功能聚类表型划分；表明时空联合正则的贝叶斯建模能获得连贯感受野并支持有意义的群体类型分析。

Abstract: Neurons in the visual system are selective for specific spatial and temporal stimulus features, described by their \emph{receptive field}. Estimating one means a coefficient per pixel per time bin from few trials -- a high-dimensional problem requiring regularization. Sparse regularizers such as the LASSO handle the dimension but select pixels independently at each time point, with nothing to keep the region coherent in space or smooth in time; it can fragment or reorganize discontinuously even when the true response evolves smoothly, a failure since this evolving pattern is what a receptive-field estimate should capture. We formulate dynamic receptive-field estimation as a high-dimensional Bayesian problem: a Poisson model combining a Gaussian Markov random field in space with an autoregressive process in time, so the estimated field is smooth and coherent across space and time. On recordings from $155$ salamander retinal ganglion cells, fitting this model independently per neuron recovers a coherent surface, where a pixel-level Poisson-LASSO comparison instead returns a fragmented one. Summarizing each neuron's surface by its space-averaged temporal response and clustering these curves with a model-based functional-clustering procedure, BIC selects three balanced temporal-response phenotypes ($85$, $32$, $38$ neurons), against a degenerate grouping from clustering the raw surfaces. A simulation study with known ground truth confirms the same pattern, with the model beating an unregularized Poisson GLM, LASSO, and the elastic net on recovery and estimation accuracy, though LASSO controls false positives better. The per-neuron field identification, its contrast with LASSO, and the functional-clustering population typing constitute this paper's contribution.

</details>


### [374] [Landscape Limits of Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Optimization across 256 continuous functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30938)
*Rishi Govind,Ferdin Sagai Don Bosco,Kasturi Venkata Srikanth,Aman Mittal,Abhishek Singh,Aditya Singh,Abhishek Chopra*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该文系统剖析量子启发式进化优化（QIEO）将设计变量视为独立概率分量的根本局限，并用256(实际508)个覆盖11类景观特征的连续函数，对3种QIEO变体、2种GA编码与CMA-ES进行基准比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QIEO每次迭代仅将量子比特幅度对朝单一代最优个体旋转，更新廉价、几乎无参数、易于大规模并行，因而被广泛用于工程、设计与规划。但其将设计变量当作独立概率分量，无法利用局部曲率、各向异性与变量耦合。尽管存在这些关键缺陷，QIEO仍被寄予厚望并大量用于实际问题，且相对于经典遗传算法（GA）被认为具有显著的定性与计算优势。因此需要厘清QIEO在何种条件下真正具备竞争力。

Method: 从既有工作中选取256个（实为508个：256个未平移+252个平移，4个无法平移）连续函数，使其覆盖11类景观特征：连续性、可微性、可分性、可扩展性、模态性、凸性、条件数、对称性、最大维数、维度依赖性以及设计变量耦合模式。用3种QIEO变体、2种GA编码以及Hansen的协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）求解这些函数。

Result: 从计算代价、求解精度以及在不同景观特征上的专长性三个维度评估结果。

Conclusion: 结果识别出QIEO取得有竞争力性能的条件，阐明其独立变量表示何时成为限制，并确定特定QIEO变体是否对特定景观特征具有优势。

Abstract: Quantum-inspired evolutionary optimization (QIEO) represents design variables as a set of qubits and searches a continuous, multi-dimensional landscape through rotation of the qubit's amplitude pair. Every generation rotates those amplitudes toward a single elite, which corresponds to that generation's best. The update is cheap, almost parameter-free, and well-suited for massive parallel implementation, which has encouraged its adoption in engineering, design, and planning applications. However, there are critical issues with this formulation, principally, the treatment of design variables as independent probability components which make it incapable of exploiting local curvature, anisotropy, or variable coupling. Despite this, QIEO is believed to hold promise, and has been used extensively to solve real-world problems, with significant qualitative and computational advantage over its classical counterpart, Genetic Algorithm (GA).
  A collection of 256 (actually 508; 256 unshifted + 252 shifted, 4 could not be shifted) continuous function are selected from the prior works, in such a way that they represent eleven landscape characteristics, namely continuity, differentiability, separability, scalability, modality, convexity, conditioning, symmetry, maximum dimensionality, dimension dependency, and the coupling pattern of the design variables. These functions are then solved by three QIEO variants, two GA encodings and Hansen's Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES).
  The results are evaluated in terms of computational cost, solution precision, and specialization across landscape characteristics. They identify the conditions under which QIEO provides competitive performance, clarify where its independent-variable representation becomes limiting, and establish whether particular QIEO variants offer advantages for specific landscape characteristics.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [375] [CLEAR: Online Speech Content Leakage Estimation through Cross-ASR Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30415)
*Bhawana Chhaglani,Tanvi Kandepuneni,Jeremy Gummeson,Prashant Shenoy*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: CLEAR：一种无需参考的运行时语音内容泄露估计方法，利用异构ASR系统间分歧来在线量化残留可恢复的语音内容，使隐私成为可动态调整的运行时属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有信号级语音隐私机制虽能抑制语言内容并保留下游感知所需的声学信息，但其隐私设置通常离线评估并固定，而语音内容泄露程度随话语和说话人差异显著变化。运行时自适应保护需要在线估计残留可恢复内容，但WER、PER等常规指标依赖真实转写文本，无法在线计算。

Method: 提出CLEAR，一种参考无关的运行时语音内容泄露估计方法。核心思路：当语言内容仍可恢复时，独立训练的异构ASR系统表现一致；随着隐私变换使语音模糊，它们之间的分歧增大。据此利用跨ASR分歧作为泄露代理指标，并刻画异构ASR子集的延迟—精度权衡，用其假设识别可能暴露的词。

Result: 在所采用的可配置语音抑制机制下，跨ASR分歧与基于转写的泄露度量在各隐私操作点上高度吻合，相关系数达0.8；并给出异构ASR子集的延迟—精度权衡特性，可定位潜在暴露词。

Conclusion: CLEAR使隐私从固定配置转变为运行时属性：可向用户传达残余语音暴露，并为动态调整隐私强度提供反馈，同时保留下游感知任务的声学效用。

Abstract: Signal-level speech privacy mechanisms suppress linguistic content while preserving acoustic information needed by downstream sensing applications. However, their privacy settings are typically evaluated/selected offline and remain fixed during deployment, even though speech-content leakage can vary substantially across utterances and speakers. Adapting privacy protection at runtime requires estimating how much speech remains recoverable, but conventional measures such as WER or PER require ground-truth transcripts and therefore cannot be computed online. We present CLEAR, a reference-free approach for estimating speech-content leakage at runtime using disagreement among heterogeneous ASR systems. Our key insight is that independently trained ASRs exhibit consistent behavior when linguistic content remains recoverable and increasingly disagree as privacy transformations obscure speech. Using configurable speech-suppression mechanism, we show that cross-ASR disagreement closely tracks transcript-grounded leakage across privacy operating points, achieving a correlation of 0.8. We further characterize the latency-accuracy trade-off of heterogeneous ASR subsets and use their hypotheses to identify potentially exposed words. These capabilities enable privacy to be treated as a runtime property rather than a fixed configuration: CLEAR can communicate residual speech exposure to users and provide feedback for dynamically adjusting privacy aggressiveness while retaining acoustic utility for downstream sensing tasks.

</details>


### [376] [AcoustiClaim: A Numeric Claim Benchmark with Instrument Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30483)
*Sheng-Tse Lin,Siyuan Zhai,Chien-Liang Kuo,Massa Baali,Bhiksha Raj*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: AcoustiClaim 提出一种评测音频语言模型数值断言真实性的流程：从自由文本抽取声学量数字断言，对照定义该量的测量工具打分，并按参照可读性对量分类；实验覆盖 5 个模型、10 个声学量、2 个语料共 207 个单元，发现绝大多数单元无法达到排序相关性门槛，误差普遍不低于常数预测基线，仅经校准阈值的拒答策略能稳定降低误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频语言模型会对声学量陈述数字，但人类意见与评判模型都无法判断该数字是否真实反映信号；缺少一种可对照测量工具、可量化检验数值断言正确性的评测手段，尤其是对参照需从音频中推断的量。

Method: AcoustiClaim 从自由文本中抽取每个数值断言，将其与定义该量的测量工具比对打分，并按参照可读位置对每个量分类。对 4 个开放权重模型与 1 个闭源模型，在 2 个语料上用 5 种提问方式询问 10 个声学量，共填满 207 个单元；设定秩相关 0.3 为达标线并计算区间；训练一个参照解码器，在混合语音上用散文拒答 5 个嗓音量，在干净孪生样本上作答；采用校准阈值与拒答机制，并与随机选择器和线性基线比较。

Result: 207 个单元中 49 个输出少于 5 个不同取值；可排序的 158 个单元中仅 8 个超过秩相关 0.3，其中 3 个区间完全高于门槛，5 个来自同一闭源模型对音高的读取。除 3 个可排序单元外，所有单元误差均处于或高于常数预测基线。参照解码器在 95% 的混合语音上以散文形式拒答 5 个嗓音量且无任何信息扣留，在干净孪生样本上给出这些量，并仅凭音频复现其目标的规则。校准阈值下拒答在混合语音上使全部 10 个量的平均误差下降，在 8 个量上每个划分都下降，而随机选择器最多仅带来 0.6% 改善；线性基线排序误差的能力至少与本文方法相当；F0 标准差与 shimmer 仍高于常数基线。

Conclusion: 音频语言模型对声学量的数值断言普遍不可靠，多数单元无法超过排序相关门槛，误差常不优于常数预测；可信度评估需依赖与测量工具的对照及参照可读性分类。拒答机制配合校准阈值可系统性降低误差，但 F0 标准差和 shimmer 等量仍难以超越常数基线，线性基线也具备竞争力，说明该任务尚存明显提升空间。

Abstract: Audio language models state numbers for acoustic quantities, and neither human opinion nor a judge model says whether such a number is true of the signal. AcoustiClaim extracts each numeric claim from free text, scores it against the instrument that defines the quantity, and classes each quantity by where its reference can be read. Four open-weight systems and one closed model, asked for ten quantities five ways on two corpora, fill 207 cells. Of these, 49 emit fewer than five distinct values, and eight of the 158 cells that can be ranked exceed a rank correlation of 0.3, the bar we set, three with an interval clear of it, five of them one closed model reading pitch. Error sits at or above a constant-predictor floor in every ranked cell but three. The reference decoder we train declines the five voice quantities in prose on 95% of mixtures, with nothing withheld, and states them on the clean twins, reproducing its targets' rule from audio alone. With a calibrated threshold, withholding lowers error on all ten quantities on the mixtures in the mean and on eight at every split, against at most 0.6% from a random selector. A linear baseline orders errors at least as well as ours. F0 s.d. and shimmer stay above the constant floor.

</details>


### [377] [Don't CLAP: Are Music-Text Models Bag-of-Words?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30540)
*Yuan-Chiao Cheng,Alexander Lerch*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文提出"属性交换扰动"方法，检验CLAP等音乐-文本相似度指标是否真正捕捉细粒度属性绑定，发现对比式模型无法可靠区分原caption与扰动caption，其表征近似词袋模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLAP分数（音乐-文本模型音频与文本嵌入的余弦相似度）是评估文本到音乐系统"忠实度"的标准客观指标。但该指标是否真正反映文本语义——尤其当属性与乐器绑定时（如"失真吉他"）——尚不明确，作者希望验证这种绑定是否被嵌入所捕捉。

Method: 引入属性交换扰动：对真实录音的caption仅交换两个乐器之间的一个属性（音色、主奏/伴奏角色、首次出现顺序）。在此设置下测试四个对比式音乐-文本模型和一个大型音频-语言模型，判断音频对原始caption的打分是否高于扰动caption；并进一步设计实验检验音频-语言模型的优势来源。

Result: 没有对比式模型能可靠区分两个caption；大型音频-语言模型表现较好，但后续实验表明其优势主要来自与音频无关的语言先验，而非真正的音频-文本对齐。

Conclusion: CLAP分数及相关指标不能捕捉细粒度音乐语义或属性绑定，其表征更接近词袋模型，对改变语义的caption扰动不敏感，作为忠实度客观指标存在根本局限。

Abstract: Text-to-music systems are assessed on audio quality and on how faithfully the music follows its prompt, and the CLAP score, the cosine similarity between a music-text model's audio and text embeddings, is the standard objective metric of faithfulness. We ask how accurately that score reflects the text: when an attribute is linked to an instrument (e.g., distorted guitar), does the text embedding capture that binding? To find out, we introduce an attribute swap perturbation: the caption of a real recording is edited by exchanging exactly one property, timbre, lead versus accompaniment, or order of first appearance, between two instruments. We then test four contrastive music-text models and one large audio-language model on whether the audio scores higher against the original caption than against the perturbed one. No contrastive model distinguishes the two captions reliably. The audio-language model does better, but further experiments show that its advantage rests largely on audio-agnostic language priors. Our results thus provide compelling evidence that the CLAP score and related metrics do not capture fine-grained musical meaning or attribute bindings; their representation is closer to a bag-of-words that leaves them insensitive to meaning-changing perturbations of the caption.

</details>


### [378] [MuseTimbre: Zero-Shot Timbre Transfer by Controlling a Frozen Music Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30548)
*Yuan-Chiao Cheng,Zhiyao Duan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: MuseTimbre是首个从音频参考中提取音色并将其迁移到复音源音频的系统，通过多音高估计器提取源音高、微调CLAP编码器提取参考音色，实现对预训练音乐生成器的条件化控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从音频参考片段中提取目标音色比从文本提示推断能保留更多细节，但现有方法存在不足：专门的音色迁移模型虽能干净捕获音色，却是狭窄的单任务系统；而给预训练音乐生成器添加控制的方法虽更通用，却因参考片段中音色与风格、旋律纠缠，只能退回用文本命名音色。因此需要一种既能从音频参考干净提取音色、又具备通用性且能处理复音源的方法。

Method: MuseTimbre通过条件化预训练音乐生成器实现音色迁移。具体而言，使用多音高估计器从源音频中提取音高信息，并微调CLAP编码器以从参考音频中提取音色信息，从而将音色与音高解耦并迁移到复音源上。

Result: 在四个真实复音录音数据集上的实验表明，MuseTimbre的音高对齐性能与基线相当，同时其匹配参考音色的效果明显更接近参考。此外，微调后的CLAP音色提取器对音高变化具有鲁棒性，可用于音色相似度度量。

Conclusion: MuseTimbre是首个通过条件化预训练音乐生成器、从音频参考向复音源迁移音色的系统，在保持音高对齐的同时显著提升了音色匹配度，且其微调CLAP音色提取器对音高变化鲁棒，可推广至音色相似度评估。

Abstract: Instrument timbre transfer re-voices a performance using the timbre of another instrument. Extracting the target timbre from an audio reference capture more nuances than inferring it from a text prompt. Systems that read timbre from such a clip train a dedicated model for the task, which captures the timbre cleanly but stays a narrow, single-purpose system. More versatile approaches add control to a pretrained music generator, yet a reference clip entangles timbre with genre and melody, so these systems fall back on text to name the timbre. We present MuseTimbre, the first system, to our best knowledge, that transfers timbre from an audio reference to a polyphonic source through conditioning a pretrained music generator. This system employs a multi-pitch estimator to extract pitch information from the source and finetune a CLAP encoder to extract timbre information from the reference audio. Experiments show that across four datasets of real polyphonic recordings, MuseTimbre achieves pitch alignment on par with the baselines while matching the reference timbre far more closely. Results also show that the finetuned CLAP-based timbre extractor is robust to pitch variations, making it useful in timbre similarity measures.

</details>


### [379] [Training-Free Contextual ASR via SpeechLLM-Based Error-Aware Selective Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30694)
*Natsuo Yamashita,Ai Nemoto,Ryosuke Koichi,Masaaki Yamamoto*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练的上下文ASR框架，利用预训练语音大模型联合生成ASR假设并定位可能涉及领域术语的错误片段，仅对定位片段进行词典检索并二次识别，在医疗、空管、金融三个领域显著减少词典查询且提升术语召回与ASR性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域特定与低频术语的识别对ASR仍是难点；上下文偏置虽能改善识别，但直接提供大术语词典会引入大量无关偏置项；基于检索的上下文偏置虽从外部词典选取候选，但对众多识别词逐一查询需大量词典查找，且候选针对性差。

Method: 免训练框架：由预训练语音大语言模型（SpeechLLM）联合生成ASR假设并定位可能涉及领域术语的错误片段；仅对定位片段从外部术语词典检索语音相似的术语；同一SpeechLLM基于首遍假设与检索到的术语对音频进行二次识别，无需任务特定训练。

Result: 在医疗、空中交通管制、金融三类语音上评估，方法大幅减少词典查询次数，同时提升相关术语候选的召回率与排序质量，并改善所有三个领域的二次识别ASR性能。

Conclusion: 通过错误片段定位引导的定向检索与SpeechLLM二次识别，可在免训练条件下有效实现跨领域上下文ASR，兼顾效率与识别质量。

Abstract: Recognition of domain-specific and low-frequency terms remains challenging for automatic speech recognition (ASR). Although contextual biasing can improve their recognition, directly providing a large terminology dictionary introduces many irrelevant biasing terms. Retrieval-based contextual biasing addresses this issue by selecting candidate terms from an external dictionary, but querying many recognized words requires numerous dictionary lookups and may yield poorly targeted candidates. We propose a training-free contextual ASR framework in which a pretrained speech large language model (SpeechLLM) jointly generates an ASR hypothesis and localizes error spans likely to involve domain-specific terms. Only the localized spans are used to retrieve phonologically similar terms from an external terminology dictionary. The same SpeechLLM then re-recognizes the audio conditioned on the first-pass hypothesis and the retrieved terms, without task-specific model training. To assess applicability across domains, we evaluate the framework on medical, air traffic control, and financial speech. The proposed method substantially reduces dictionary queries while improving the recall and ranking of relevant terminology candidates and second-pass ASR performance across all three domains.

</details>


### [380] [Dialogue-Based Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction with Predictive Dialogue Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30774)
*Shuhan Zhang,Wenxuan Wu,Haizhou Li*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于真实双人对话的在线音视频目标说话人提取（AV-TSE）基准，并构建了基于LLM的目标说话人语音活动预测（TS-VAP）模块，通过融合历史、同步与预测上下文，在真实对话上获得近1 dB的性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有目标说话人提取（TSE）研究多依赖全重叠或稀疏重叠的模拟混合数据，忽略了真实对话中的自然停顿、话轮转换与反馈信号，导致与面对面实时通信场景存在较大差距。因此需要一个贴近真实对话的在线AV-TSE基准及相应方法。

Method: 1）构建首个在线音视频目标说话人提取基准，数据来自完整的双人互动并包含独立第三方干扰；2）提出基于LLM的目标说话人语音活动预测模块TS-VAP，利用语义、声学与面部线索，直接从重叠混合信号中预测目标说话人及对话伙伴的未来活动，并借助语音-LLM的语言与会话知识进行引导；3）将该预测用于指导低延迟分离器，并融合历史上下文与同步说话人上下文。

Result: TS-VAP在多种AV-TSE骨干网络上均能稳定提升流式提取性能；进一步结合历史、同步与预测三类上下文，在真实音视频对话数据上取得近1 dB的增益。

Conclusion: 面向真实对话的在线AV-TSE需要显式建模话轮动态与未来活动预测；LLM驱动的语音活动预测可有效为低延迟分离器提供前瞻性引导，多源上下文融合是提升流式提取性能的有效途径。

Abstract: In face-to-face, real-time communication, a talking agent must track the target speaker through natural pauses, turn-taking, and backchannels, often amid background cross-talk. Most target speaker extraction (TSE) studies, however, rely on simulated mixtures with full or sparse overlap and ignore the turn-taking of real conversations. We therefore introduce, to our knowledge, the first benchmark for online audio-visual TSE (AV-TSE), built from intact dyadic interactions with independent third-party interference. Observing that anticipating upcoming activity from semantic, acoustic, and facial cues benefits online AV-TSE, we propose an LLM-based target-speaker voice activity projection (TS-VAP) module. Unlike conventional VAP with separated speaker channels, it forecasts the future activity of the target and conversational partner directly from the overlapping mixture, drawing on the linguistic and conversational knowledge of a speech-LLM, and uses this prediction to guide a low-latency separator. We further combine this predictive context with historical and synchronous speaker context. Experiments show that TS-VAP consistently improves streaming extraction across multiple AV-TSE backbones, and that further combining historical, synchronous, and predictive context yields nearly 1 dB gain on real AV conversations. Project page: https://jjjjiaozi.github.io/TS-VAP/.

</details>


### [381] [Symbiotic Architecture for Post-Hoc Audio Extension of Frozen Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30784)
*Yotaro Kubo,Qi Sun,Yujin Tang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出一种共生架构，通过注入器将音频条件向量直接写入LLM的KV缓存，无需微调权重即可赋予LLM音频理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ALM通常依赖微调LLM权重或全骨干预填充，前者可能导致原始文本能力退化，后者注入成本随骨干规模增长。作者希望在不更新LLM权重的前提下，以更低成本实现音频理解并保持原能力。

Method: 采用symbiotic architecture，设计injector module，将音频条件向量直接写入目标LLM的short-term memory即key-value (KV) cache，使LLM表现为audio language model (ALM)。音频注入时绕过LLM，注入成本由injector width而非backbone width决定；训练不更新LLM权重。

Result: 在automatic speech recognition、audio question answering、acoustic scene classification等音频理解任务及text-only任务上评估。结果：音频预填充时激活参数更少，性能优于冻结LLM的传统方法，接近fine-tuned ALM，同时按构造保持骨干LLM原始text-only任务性能。

Conclusion: 该共生架构可在不微调LLM权重的情况下实现高效音频理解，兼具可扩展性与能力保持优势，为构建ALM提供新路径。

Abstract: This paper proposes an architecture for equipping large language models (LLMs) with audio-understanding capabilities without fine-tuning their weights. The proposed symbiotic architecture employs an injector module that writes audio-conditioned vectors directly into the target LLM's short-term memory, i.e., the key-value (KV) cache, enabling the LLM to behave as an audio language model (ALM). The architectural advantages are twofold. First, it improves the scalability of ALMs: because the proposed method bypasses the LLM during audio injection, the injection cost is governed by the injector width rather than the backbone width, and can therefore scale more slowly than the cost of full-backbone prefilling. Second, since the training scheme does not update the LLM weights, the original capabilities of the LLM are preserved without the risk of degradation from fine-tuning. The effectiveness of the proposed method is evaluated on both audio-understanding tasks (automatic speech recognition, audio question answering, and acoustic scene classification) and text-only tasks. We confirm that, while activating fewer parameters during audio prefilling, our architecture outperforms the conventional method with a frozen LLM and approaches the performance of a fine-tuned ALM, all while preserving the backbone LLM's original text-only task performance by construction.

</details>


### [382] [Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Decoding of Perceived Speech from Brain Recordings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30832)
*Aoke Zhang,Jing Chen*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出SICMD方法，融合fMRI与MEG，统一解决时空表征提取与跨被试泛化两大难题，并大幅降低训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非侵入式BCI感知语音解码面临两大挑战：一是提取具有丰富时空信息的神经表征，二是实现跨被试泛化。已有研究通常分别应对这两个问题，缺乏同时处理二者的统一方法。

Method: 提出被试不变跨模态感知语音解码（SICMD）方法，整合功能磁共振成像（fMRI）与脑磁图（MEG）；并对融合方式、融合位置、编码器架构及模型输入进行系统分析。

Result: 在跨被试感知语音解码任务中，相比基线方法，Top-1、Top-10与Rankacc分别提升超过10.6%、10.1%和1.7%；相比多被试与单被试解码设置，训练成本分别降低88.8%和60.5%。可视化实验进一步验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: SICMD为跨被试感知语音解码提供了一种统一的跨模态解决方案，在提升解码性能的同时显著降低训练成本，具有良好的有效性与应用潜力。

Abstract: Perceived speech decoding based on non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) signals has been extensively studied in recent years. Research in this field primarily faces two challenges: extracting neural representations with rich spatiotemporal information and achieving cross-subject generalization. Although separate studies have proposed methods to cope with these issues, a unified approach that simultaneously tackles both challenges remains lacking. To fill this gap, we propose the Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Perceived Speech Decoding (SICMD) method, which integrates functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and magnetoencephalography (MEG). We conduct comprehensive analyses of the fusion method, fusion position, encoder architecture, and model inputs. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method improves Top-1, Top-10, and Rankacc by more than 10.6%, 10.1%, and 1.7%, respectively, compared to baseline methods in cross-subject perceived speech decoding tasks, while reducing training costs by 88.8% and 60.5% compared to multi-subject and intra-subject decoding settings. Further visualization experiments also confirm the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [383] [Tracing and Relearning Detection Evidence in Text-to-Speech Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30983)
*Eunji Shin,Kyudan Jung,Jihwan Kim,Minwoo Lee,Jaegul Choo*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该研究通过控制变量重合成与检测器自适应，在F5-TTS-BigVGAN流程中定位音频深度伪造检测证据的来源，发现声学模型的更新会削弱固定检测器可用的检测证据，而检测器自适应可使更新后的输出保持可检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测器能区分真实语音与合成语音，但尚不清楚TTS系统的哪个阶段提供了检测证据，因此需要厘清证据来源。

Method: 采用受控重合成与检测器自适应方法，在F5-TTS-BigVGAN流程中固定声码器，追踪检测分离度的主要变化来自声学生成；对声学模型进行对抗性微调（目标函数不含检测器），并对仅基于微调模型VCTK输出的检测器进行自适应。

Result: 固定声码器后，检测分离度的更大变化归因于声学生成；对抗性微调在质量相当的情况下提高了固定检测器的EER；仅在微调模型VCTK输出上自适应的检测器将LibriSpeech EER从19.42%降至7.46%，并提升了对未见基础F5-TTS输出的检测能力。

Conclusion: 声学模型更新可减少固定检测器可用的检测证据，而检测器自适应则能保持更新后输出在该流程中的可检测性。

Abstract: Recent audio deepfake detectors separate bona fide speech from synthetic speech, yet it remains unclear which stage of a text-to-speech system supplies the detection evidence. We address this with controlled resynthesis and detector adaptation in an F5-TTS-BigVGAN pipeline. Since vocoder reconstruction of a real mel can itself be separable from the source utterance, we fix the vocoder and trace the larger change in detector separation to acoustic generation. Adversarially fine-tuning the acoustic model, with no detector in its objective, raises EER against fixed detectors at comparable quality. However, adapting a detector only on the tuned model's VCTK outputs lowers its LibriSpeech EER from 19.42% to 7.46% and improves detection of unseen base F5-TTS outputs. These results suggest that acoustic-model updates can reduce the detection evidence available to fixed detectors, while detector adaptation keeps the updated outputs detectable in this pipeline.

</details>


### [384] [Synth-JEPA: Joint Embedding Prediction for Renderer-Free Synthesizer Parameter Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31024)
*Ben Hayes,Haokun Tian,Stefan Lattner*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 Synth-JEPA，通过联合预测的音频-参数表示空间实现无需渲染器的合成器音色匹配，性能优于基线并受听测偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 声音匹配可建模为针对音频域目标优化合成器参数，但通用音频表示目标难以优化，直接搜索又需渲染每个候选，效率低，因此需要一种既易优化又无需渲染的目标。

Method: Synth-JEPA 从成对的合成器数据中学习相互预测的音频与参数表示；推理时在该学习空间中直接对候选参数打分，形成无渲染器目标，其音频几何由参数对应关系塑造，而非通用音频相似度。在 Surge XT 上评估，对比逆模型、直接搜索和学习代理目标，涵盖域内留出合成音及域外 NSynth、FSD50K 目标。

Result: Synth-JEPA 在域内优于所有基线，域外保持竞争力；匹配质量随测试时搜索增加而持续提升，可实现计算量与匹配质量的权衡；成对听测中总体 85% 试验听众更偏好 Synth-JEPA。

Conclusion: 具有参数诱导几何的音频表示使合成器声音匹配可作为高效的无渲染器搜索问题来处理。

Abstract: Sound matching can be formulated as optimizing synthesizer parameters against an audio-domain objective. However, objectives derived from generic audio representations are often difficult to optimize, while direct search requires rendering every candidate. We introduce Synth-JEPA, which learns mutually predictive audio and parameter representations from paired synthesizer data. At inference, candidate parameters are scored directly in this learned space, yielding a renderer-free objective whose audio geometry is shaped by parameter correspondences rather than generic audio similarity. We evaluate Synth-JEPA on Surge XT using held-out synthesizer sounds and out-of-domain NSynth and FSD50K targets, against inverse models, direct search, and learned proxy objectives. Synth-JEPA outperforms all baselines in-domain and remains competitive out-of-domain. Its matching quality continues to improve with additional test-time search, allowing compute to be traded for match quality. In pairwise listening tests, listeners preferred Synth-JEPA in 85% of trials overall. Together, these results show that an audio representation with a parameter-induced geometry allows synthesizer sound matching to be approached as an effective renderer-free search problem.

</details>


### [385] [BreathGRU: A Novel Semi-Supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit Framework for Speech and Breath Segmentation for Respiratory Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31165)
*Sania Fatima Sayed,John W. Holloway,Reyer Zwiggelaar,Faisal I. Rezwan*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: BreathGRU：一种半监督BiGRU框架，专门用于语音-呼吸分段，在呼吸事件检测上优于现有VAD方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音-呼吸分段是呼吸音频分析的基础预处理步骤，但现有方法（阈值法、傅里叶变换、无监督及预训练VAD模型）主要面向语音检测，常将呼吸事件归类为非语音或静音，难以实现精确的呼吸检测。

Method: 提出BreathGRU半监督双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）框架，融合帧级声学特征提取、双向循环建模、伪标签精炼与时长约束的分段Viterbi解码，输出语音与呼吸的分段结果。

Result: 在人工标注录音上评估，BreathGRU取得最高的呼吸事件召回率（0.83）、最低的起始定位误差（0.14s）和最高的平均匹配IoU（0.81），整体分割性能与Silero等大型预训练VAD模型相当；定性评估显示其与人工标注高度一致，呼吸检测优于Silero。

Conclusion: 显式的呼吸事件建模优于通用VAD模型，BreathGRU是一种有效的语音-呼吸分段框架，可应用于呼吸音频分析与肺部医疗健康场景。

Abstract: Speech-breath segmentation is a fundamental preprocessing step in respiratory audio analysis, enabling applications such as respiratory acoustic biomarker extraction, lung function prediction and disease monitoring. Existing approaches, including threshold methods, Fourier Transform-based techniques, and unsupervised and pretrained voice activity detection (VAD) models, primarily focus on speech detection and often classify breathing events as non-speech or silence, limiting their applicability for precise breath detection. To address this limitation, we propose BreathGRU, a semi-supervised Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) framework specifically designed for speech-breath segmentation. The proposed framework combines frame-level acoustic feature extraction with bidirectional recurrent modelling, pseudo-label refinement and duration-constrained Segmental Viterbi decoding to produce speech and breath segmentation. BreathGRU was evaluated against the existing approaches, using manually annotated recordings. Performance was assessed using event-based, time-based, overlap-based, duration-based and boundary-based segmentation metrics. Experiment results demonstrated that BreathGRU achieved the highest breath event recall (0.83), the lowest onset-localisation error (0.14s) and the highest Mean Match Intersection over Union (0.81), with competitive overall segmentation performance compared to large pretrained VAD models like Silero. Qualitative evaluation on manually annotated recordings further showed close agreement between BreathGRU and manual annotation, with better breath detection compared to Silero. These findings demonstrate that explicit breath event modelling provides advantages over general-purpose VAD models and establish BreathGRU as an effective speech-breath segmentation framework which can be applied for respiratory audio analysis and pulmonary healthcare applications.

</details>


### [386] [BAT-CLIP: Trimodal Alignment of Brain, Audio and Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31180)
*Suhyun Kim,Jinmo Han,Danny Dongyeop Han,Ahhyun Lucy Lee,Jewoon Lee,Yonghyeon Gwon,Zach Paris,Chun Kee Chung,Saewoong Bahk,Nam Soo Kim,Seong Jae Hwang,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: BAT-CLIP：首个面向iEEG的CLIP式三模态对齐框架，将神经嵌入同时对齐到预训练音频与文本锚点，在共享冻结的音频-文本流形中实现稳健的脑-语音表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前CLIP式脑-语音对齐只把神经活动锚定到单一模态（音频或文本），但大脑语音加工本质上是多模态的。单锚点带来权衡：音频锚定保留时序结构却削弱语言可分性，文本锚定捕获语义却丢失声学细节。

Method: 提出BAT-CLIP，针对iEEG的首个CLIP式三模态对齐框架，在共享且冻结的音频-文本流形中，将神经嵌入联合对齐到预训练音频锚点与文本锚点。同时强调采用自监督基础模型进行CLIP训练的重要性。

Result: 在自然情境Podcast基准上，BAT-CLIP产生比双模态CLIP基线更稳健的表示。

Conclusion: 联合音频与文本双锚点的三模态对齐优于单一锚点方案，缓解了音频/文本锚定间的权衡；自监督基础模型对CLIP训练具有重要价值。

Abstract: Decoding and interpreting naturalistic speech from the brain increasingly relies on alignment to pretrained speech and language representation spaces. However, current CLIP-style brain-speech alignment ground neural activity to a single anchor modality-audio or text-despite the brain's inherently multimodal speech processing. This induces a trade-off: audio anchoring preserves temporal structure but weakens linguistic separability, while text anchoring captures semantics yet discards acoustic detail. We propose BAT-CLIP, the first CLIP-style trimodal alignment framework for iEEG that jointly aligns neural embeddings to both pretrained audio and text anchors in a shared, frozen audio-text manifold. On the naturalistic Podcast benchmark, BAT-CLIP yields more robust representations than bimodal CLIP baselines. We also highlight the importance of using self-supervised foundation models for CLIP training.

</details>


### [387] [Acoustic-to-Text KV Compression for Full-Duplex Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31224)
*Yejin Lee,Seungbeom Kim,Yongha Lee,Kyuhong Shim*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出"声学到文本KV压缩"方法，利用聆听间隙将语音转为紧凑文本记忆，从而大幅降低全双工语音语言模型的流式KV缓存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音语言模型会持续累积声学KV状态，导致长时交互内存开销巨大，亟需在保持聆听与说话行为的前提下压缩缓存。

Method: 利用音频单元处理完后到下一单元到达之间的"聆听时限"，引入转写旁路通道将语音转为紧凑文本记忆；推理中缓存超过目标预算时，驱逐较旧的声学状态，仅保留转写文本与近期声学上下文；用LoRA以交叉熵训练转写通道，并对原模型在原生预测位置上的token级输出分布做知识蒸馏。

Result: 在十分钟LongSpeech会话上，MiniCPM-o 4.5实现的峰值流式KV缓存较无驱逐的同一模型减少64.6%；转写、时序问答与摘要任务均优于基线；Full-Duplex-Bench评估显示停顿处理、轮次切换与打断性能相当。

Conclusion: 该方法在显著降低流式KV缓存内存的同时，还能提升部分下游任务表现，并保持全双工交互行为，验证了文本侧通道压缩声学记忆的有效性。

Abstract: Full-duplex speech language models continuously accumulate acoustic key-value (KV) states, making long-running interactions memory-intensive. During listening, the model can finish processing an audio unit before the next arrives; we term the remaining interval listening-time slack. We propose acoustic-to-text KV compression, which introduces a transcription side channel to convert incoming speech into compact textual memory within this interval. When the cache exceeds a target budget during inference, older acoustic states are evicted while transcripts and recent acoustic context remain. We train the side channel with LoRA using cross-entropy on transcription segments. To preserve listening and speaking behavior, we apply knowledge distillation to the original model's token-level output distributions at native prediction positions. On ten-minute LongSpeech sessions, our MiniCPM-o 4.5 implementation reduces peak streaming KV-cache size by 64.6% compared with the same model without eviction. The proposed method also improves transcription, temporal question answering, and summarization over the baseline. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluations further show comparable pause-handling, turn-taking, and interruption performance.

</details>


### [388] [AFA-Net: A Differential Attention Approach for Auditory Attention Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31402)
*Philip H. Lee,Shreeram Suresh Chandra,Karan Thakkar,John H. L. Hansen*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出AFA-Net，用差分注意力机制替代普通注意力以显式抑制EEG噪声，在2秒决策窗下AAD准确率达96.8%，且参数量显著少于多数现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AAD深度学习架构普遍缺乏对含噪EEG数据的显式处理机制，噪声会干扰任务相关神经活动的表征，限制检测性能。

Method: AFA-Net框架以简单而灵活的差分注意力机制（differential attention）替代传统vanilla attention，通过差分计算削弱噪声引起的共模注意力，从而聚焦任务相关神经活动。

Result: 在2s决策窗口下准确率最高达96.8%，并在此性能水平上使用远少于多数现有方法的模型参数量。

Conclusion: AFA-Net是首批显式针对EEG噪声以提升AAD性能的框架之一，验证了差分注意力在噪声鲁棒AAD中的有效性。

Abstract: Auditory Attention Detection (AAD) utilizes electroencephalographic (EEG) signals to identify a target speaker in a multi-speaker environment. Despite considerable progress, existing deep learning architectures often lack explicit mechanisms for handling noisy EEG data. To address this limitation, we propose Auditory Focus Attention Networks (AFA-Net), a machine learning framework that replaces vanilla attention with a simple yet flexible differential attention mechanism to help focus on task-relevant neural activity. AFA-Net achieves an upward accuracy of 96.8% at the 2s decision window, while using substantially fewer parameters than most existing methods. To the best of our knowledge, AFA-Net is among the first frameworks to explicitly try to combat EEG noise to improve AAD.

</details>


### [389] [TinyAudio: Compact and Efficient Text-to-Audio Generation for Low-Resource Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31525)
*Junxi Liu,Xiquan Li,Wenhao Guan,Yifan Duan,Zhikang Niu,Yanru Huo,Ziyang Ma,Xie Chen*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: TinyAudio：一个87M参数的紧凑流匹配文本到音频生成模型，比十亿参数级系统参数减少90%以上，峰值显存0.48GB，并推出实时CPU变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代表性文本到音频（TTA）生成系统通常需要约十亿参数，难以部署在资源受限设备上，亟需在质量与占用之间取得平衡的轻量化方案。

Method: 采用流匹配（flow-matching）框架：核心为TA-DiT（35M单流流匹配Transformer），配TA-CLAP（32M音频对齐文本编码器）与TA-VAE（20M解码器，从压缩潜变量重建44.1kHz音频），总参数87M；并推出MeanFlow加速版本TinyAudio-MF。

Result: 总参数87M，较十亿参数级流水线减少超90%，峰值GPU显存0.48GB；在AudioCaps与TTA-Bench上取得有竞争力的生成质量；TinyAudio-MF在四核CPU配额下实现实时生成。

Conclusion: TinyAudio展示了面向低资源TTA部署的实用质量-占用权衡，验证了紧凑流匹配模型在受限硬件上可用且高效的可行性。

Abstract: Text-to-audio (TTA) generation has advanced rapidly in generation quality and instruction following. However, representative systems often require around a billion parameters, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. This paper introduces TinyAudio, a compact flow-matching-based TTA model for low-resource deployment. At its core, TinyAudio uses TA-DiT, a 35M single-stream flow-matching Transformer. TinyAudio also includes TA-CLAP, a 32M audio-aligned text encoder, and TA-VAE, whose 20M decoder reconstructs 44.1 kHz audio from compressed latents. TinyAudio has only 87M parameters in total, over 90% fewer than representative billion-parameter pipelines, and uses 0.48 GB peak GPU memory. TinyAudio achieves competitive generation quality on AudioCaps and TTA-Bench. We further introduce TinyAudio-MF, a MeanFlow-accelerated model that enables real-time generation with a four-core CPU quota. Our results demonstrate a practical quality-footprint trade-off for low-resource TTA deployment.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [390] [Distribution of hitting times for dissipative random dynamical systems on $\mathbb{R}^d$, with application to stochastic gradient descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30274)
*Stéphane Galatolo,Stéphane Chrétien*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文从遍历理论视角研究一类随机优化算法的渐近性质，得到算法首次进入极小值点小邻域的期望时间及其指数分布刻画，期望时间由目标平稳测度的倒数给出，噪声假设涵盖高斯与次指数情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习本质上求解大规模非凸优化问题，随机梯度法虽简单却在多类学习任务上优于更新算法，但这些方法的收敛性质仍是核心未解问题，尤其对其长时间渐近行为缺乏理论理解。

Method: 沿袭梯度类算法长时间行为的研究脉络，并借鉴 Azizian 等人的近期工作，提出一种基于遍历理论的新框架，用于分析一大类随机优化方法的渐近性质；重点研究随机优化算法首达极小值点邻域的期望时间，噪声假设包括高斯与次指数分布。

Result: 证明随机优化算法到达极小值点某小邻域的到达时间在其均值附近呈指数分布，且该均值等于目标平稳测度的倒数。

Conclusion: 该工作以遍历理论统一刻画了一类随机优化算法的到达时间统计特性，为理解深度学习中随机梯度类方法的收敛与长时间行为提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: Machine Learning and more specifically Deep Learning involves solving large scale nonconvex optimization problems. Several algorithms have been proposed in the literature, that seem to achieve satisfactory practical efficiency for difficult instances, the Stochastic Gradient Method being the most rudimentary, while still outperforming more recent algorithms at a number of learning tasks.
  A major open question about the current methods used in deep learning is to understand their convergence properties. Following a line of previous works about the long time behavior of gradient-type algorithms, %and in particular the recent contributions from Azizian et al., we present a new approach for studying the asymptotic properties of a wide family of methods from an ergodic theoretical viewpoint. Our main results include a study of the expected time for a stochastic optimisation algorithm to reach a certain small neighborhood of a minimizer and show that this reaching time distributes exponentially around its average, which is given by the inverse of the stationary measure of the target. The assumptions on the Stochastic Gradient noise include the Gaussian and the Sub-Exponential assumptions.

</details>


### [391] [Adaptive Random Matrices in Gaussian Bandits: Spectral Universality and Selection-Induced Outliers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30321)
*Sudarshan Manikantan,Abhishek Bhattacharjee*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究高斯臂赌博机中自适应臂选择对观测谱分布的影响：只要臂数的对数关于维度是次线性的，经验谱分布就一致收敛到 Marchenko–Pastur 律，且与选择规则无关；从而高斯贝叶斯赌博机的后验均方不确定性、后验协方差平方和信息获取具有策略无关的一阶极限。进一步刻画了线性打分选择的精确条件臂分布、两臂选择的 Wishart Gram 矩阵、固定选择方向下的特征值/特征向量转变，并通过指数级大臂池构造反例说明臂增长条件的阶次紧致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应臂选择会改变观测的分布，直觉上可能改变数据的谱性质。本文旨在厘清：因果性选择规则究竟在多大程度上影响高维极限谱，以及由此决定的后验不确定性与信息获取量是否依赖策略。核心动机是区分“全局谱稳定性”与“方向性效应”，并为高斯贝叶斯赌博机的一阶相合性质提供条件。

Method: 设定维度与观测数成比例增长的高斯赌博机设计。使用定量耦合定理，将任意因果选择规则产生的设计与独立高斯设计进行比较。在臂数对数关于维度次线性的条件下，证明经验谱分布一致收敛到 Marchenko–Pastur 律（对所有选择规则一致）。对线性打分选择推导精确的条件臂分布；对两臂选择证明其 Gram 矩阵精确为 Wishart；对固定选择方向给出由高斯最大值二阶矩控制的显式特征值与特征向量转变；并用指数级大臂池构造不同体相极限的反例。

Result: 若 log(可用臂数) 关于维度次线性，经验谱分布一致收敛到 Marchenko–Pastur 律，且该极限与选择规则无关。由此，高斯贝叶斯赌博机在后验均方不确定性、后验协方差平方与信息获取上均具有策略无关的一阶极限。两臂选择虽条件均值非零，但其 Gram 矩阵在任意维度下精确为 Wishart。固定选择方向时存在显式特征值与特征向量转变，且该转变不由方向与参考信号的重叠决定（给出反例）。指数级大臂池可导致不同的体相极限，说明臂增长条件是阶次紧的。

Conclusion: 自适应臂选择改变观测分布但不改变极限经验谱；在次线性臂增长条件下存在普适的 Marchenko–Pastur 极限与策略无关的一阶后验/信息量极限。同时存在显著的方向性效应（特征值与特征向量转变、臂池规模导致的体相极限变化），说明全局谱稳定性与方向性效应应当区分对待。

Abstract: Adaptive arm selection changes the distribution of the observations collected by a bandit algorithm, but it need not change their limiting empirical spectrum. We study Gaussian bandit designs in which the dimension and the number of observations grow proportionally. A quantitative coupling theorem compares the design generated by any causal selection rule with an independent Gaussian design. If the logarithm of the number of available arms is sublinear in the dimension, the empirical spectral distribution converges to the Marchenko-Pastur law, uniformly over the selection rule. Consequently, Gaussian Bayesian bandits have policy-independent first-order limits for posterior mean-square uncertainty, squared posterior covariance, and information acquisition. For linear-score selection, we obtain the exact conditional arm distribution and show that two-arm selection produces an exactly Wishart Gram matrix in every dimension, despite its nonzero conditional mean. For a fixed selection direction, we identify an explicit eigenvalue and eigenvector transition governed by the second moment of a Gaussian maximum. A counterexample shows that a direction's overlap with a reference signal does not determine this transition. Finally, an exponentially large arm pool permits a different bulk limit, establishing the order-sharpness of the arm-growth condition. These results distinguish global spectral stability from directional effects in adaptive bandit data.

</details>


### [392] [Low-Rank Friction for Memory-Efficient Transformer Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30342)
*Rajit Rajpal,Benedict Leimkuhler*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出R-iKFAD，用秩-1外积分解替代iKFAD的摩擦张量，将每层摩擦内存从O(mn)降至O(m+n)，性能与iKFAD持平，并首次给出秩-1分解优化器在连续时间下的收敛率结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: iKFAD用自适应摩擦替代自适应学习率，性能可媲美Adam，但其摩擦张量ξ∈R^{m×n}每层的显存开销为O(mn)，与Adam的二阶矩缓冲相同，限制了其内存效率。因此作者希望在保持性能的前提下降低摩擦项的内存占用。

Method: 将iKFAD的摩擦张量ξ替换为由行、列动量统计量构成的秩-1外积分解，得到Rank-1 iKFAD（R-iKFAD），使每层摩擦内存由O(mn)降为O(m+n)，约将优化器总状态量减半。同时在连续时间框架下分析两种阻尼情形：线性阻尼（γ>0）与γ=0（实验中偏好的设置）。

Result: 在GPT2-Nano、TinyViT、DistilBERT和GPT2-S上，R-iKFAD性能匹配或超过iKFAD，同时内存占用近乎减半，且对超参数保持相当的鲁棒性。理论方面：γ>0时在强凸条件下证明指数收敛；γ=0时摩擦完全由历史动量生成并随动量消失而关闭，无法证明几何收敛，但证明收敛到极小值点，并给出与能量匹配的上下界——正则化尺度ε_stab=0时为t^{-1}量级，ε_stab>0时为t^{-1/2}量级。

Conclusion: R-iKFAD以秩-1分解显著降低摩擦内存开销而保持性能，是首个给出秩-1分解优化器连续时间收敛率的结果，也是首个不要求正阻尼的此类结果。

Abstract: iKFAD is a recently proposed optimiser that replaces adaptive learning rates with adaptive friction in the momentum dynamics, yet performs as well as Adam. Its limitation is that the full friction tensor $ξ\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ carries the same $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ memory overhead per layer as Adam's second-moment buffer. Here we replace iKFAD's friction tensor $ξ$ with a rank-1 outer-product factorisation built from row and column momentum statistics, resulting in Rank-1 iKFAD (R-iKFAD). This reduces the friction memory footprint from $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ to $\mathcal{O}(m+n)$ per layer, which approximately halves iKFAD's total optimiser state. Despite this reduction, R-iKFAD maintains parity in performance with iKFAD: experiments on GPT2-Nano, TinyViT, DistilBERT and GPT2-S confirm that it matches or exceeds iKFAD while nearly halving the memory footprint and remaining comparably robust to hyperparameters. We analyse the continuous-time dynamics in two damping regimes. For linear damping ($γ>0$) we prove exponential convergence under strong convexity. For $γ=0$, the preferred option in our experiments, the friction is generated entirely from past momentum and switches off as the momentum vanishes, so geometric convergence cannot be shown. We nonetheless prove convergence to the minimiser, together with matching upper and lower bounds on the energy: of order $t^{-1}$ when the regularisation scale $ε_{\mathrm{stab}}$ is zero, and of order $t^{-1/2}$ when it is positive. To our knowledge this is the first convergence rate for a rank-1 factored optimiser in continuous time, and the first such result that does not require positive damping.

</details>


### [393] [Adaptive multi-resolution Gaussian processes: Scalable exact inference with naturally data-sparse covariance matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30348)
*Yanchuang Cao,Jun Liu,Tengchao Yu,Heng Yong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应多分辨率高斯过程框架，通过构造数据稀疏协方差矩阵，实现可扩展且精确的高斯过程回归，训练复杂度为 O(n log² n)，预测复杂度为 O(log^d n)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程是概率机器学习的基石，但扩展到大规模数据集时通常被迫在计算效率与模型保真度之间做出取舍。现有方法往往无法同时兼顾可扩展性与精确推断。

Method: 核心创新是构造具有自适应多分辨率基函数的自然数据稀疏协方差矩阵。基函数直接锚定于样本，无需辅助点；通过缩小多分辨率基的支持域限制矩阵块大小以保证稀疏性；利用稀疏 Cholesky 逆算法精确高效地计算协方差矩阵的逆；并构造增强基函数以进一步改善预测不确定性。

Result: 理论分析与数值实验表明，该模型实现精确推断，训练成本为 O(n log² n)，预测成本为 O(log^d n)。

Conclusion: 该工作为可扩展且高保真的高斯过程回归建立了一个有原则的框架，弥合了计算效率与模型保真度之间的差距。

Abstract: Gaussian processes constitute a cornerstone of probabilistic machine learning, yet scaling them to large datasets typically forces a trade-off between computational efficiency and model fidelity. This work bridges this gap by presenting an adaptive multi-resolution Gaussian process framework that is both scalable and exact. Our key innovation is constructing a naturally data-sparse covariance matrix with adaptive multi-resolution basis functions. These basis functions are directly anchored to samples, eliminating the need for auxiliary points. By shrinking the support domains of multi-resolution basis, the matrix block sizes are limited, guaranteeing sparsity. The inverse of the data-sparse covariance matrix is computed exactly and efficiently via the sparse Cholesky inverse algorithm. To further improve predictive uncertainties, we construct an augmented basis function. Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrate that our model achieves exact inference with $\mathcal{O}(n \log^2 n)$ training cost and $\mathcal{O}(\log^d n)$ prediction cost, establishing a principled framework for scalable and high-fidelity Gaussian process regression.

</details>


### [394] [Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification for fMRI Functional Connectivity via Simulation-Based Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30445)
*Simon Carter,Zeming Kuang,Lilianne R. Mujica-Parodi,Helmut H. Strey*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出基于Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程与序列神经后验估计的贝叶斯框架，为fMRI连接估计提供不确定性量化，并给出扫描时长与空间分辨率的协议优化建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于相关性的fMRI连接分析方法无法量化不确定性，也难以区分扫描仪测量噪声与真实的受试者间神经变异性。缺乏有原则的不确定性边界，研究者无法判断协议时长是否足以可靠估计连接，也无法确定受试者间差异来自生物变异还是噪声。

Method: 将BOLD动力学建模为耦合Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程，利用序列神经后验估计（SNPE）获得连接的后验分布，并在BOLD频谱上考虑频率无关的测量噪声。数据为7T下N=28名健康对照（55次扫描），使用包含65个DMN脑区的功能网络图谱，将不确定性分解为扫描仪噪声、受试者变异与采集时长三个来源。

Result: 空间上，达到渐近精度90%所需的平均ROI大小为46体素/ROI，约为典型区域大小的一半。单被试层面，7T约7分钟达到会话内精度平台，3T约10分钟，扫描时间减少40%。群体层面，3T所需的每被试扫描时间约为7T的37倍才能使合并曲线收敛，证实高场强在各时间尺度上的一致优势。

Conclusion: 该框架为协议优化提供了具体的、与扫描仪场强相关的指导，对降低采集成本、提升基于连接的临床生物标志物可靠性具有直接意义，并提供代码以便研究者从自身数据推导相应边界。

Abstract: Optimizing fMRI scan duration and spatial resolution is critical for experimental design, yet traditional correlation-based approaches cannot quantify uncertainty or disentangle scanner measurement noise from true neural variability across subjects. Without principled uncertainty bounds, researchers cannot know whether a protocol is long enough to reliably estimate connectivity, or whether between-subject differences reflect biological variation or noise. We present a Bayesian framework modeling BOLD dynamics as coupled Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes, using Sequential Neural Posterior Estimation to obtain connectivity posteriors while accounting for frequency-independent measurement noise across the BOLD spectrum. Applied to N = 28 healthy controls (55 scans) at 7T using a functional network atlas (65 DMN regions), the framework quantifies uncertainty across its sources: scanner noise, subject variability, and acquisition length. Spatial analysis identifies a mean of 46 voxels per ROI, roughly half of typical region sizes, as sufficient to achieve 90% of asymptotic precision. At the single-subject level, 7T reaches its within-session precision plateau in approximately 7 minutes versus 10 minutes for 3T, a 40% reduction in required scan time, providing the first direct, model-based quantification of the scan-time advantage conferred by higher field strength.
