At the population level, 3T requires roughly 37 times more per-subject scan time than 7T for the pooled curves to converge, confirming a consistent advantage of higher field strength at every timescale. Together these findings provide concrete, scanner-specific guidance for protocol optimization, with direct implications for reducing acquisition costs and improving the reliability of connectivity-based clinical biomarkers. We provide code enabling researchers to derive these bounds from their own data.

</details>


### [395] [Ordinary Nonconvex SGD under Distance-Dependent Moments: Finite-Horizon Stationarity and Nagaev Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30499)
*Wei Biao Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究单样本随机梯度下降（SGD）在光滑、下界、可能非凸目标下、条件矩随距离增长（$\\sigma^2+b_2\\|x-x_1\\|^2$）情形下的收敛性，证明标准SGD达到该二阶矩类的极小极大随机复杂度，并给出高阶矩的高概率界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典噪声矩假设（均匀有界方差）排除了方差随迭代点增长的随机梯度，但此类"距离相关"噪声在无界区域优化中普遍存在。作者希望在不加有界迭代、裁剪、归一化、动量或增大批量等技巧的前提下，刻画标准SGD在此更宽噪声类中的最优性。

Method: 针对光滑、下界、可能非凸目标，分析单样本SGD。二阶矩情形下采用"下降—位移"（descent–displacement）论证配合依赖步长，得到期望平均平方梯度收敛；对$p>2$，使用可预测局部化（predictable localization）与Hilbert空间Fuk–Nagaev不等式，导出高概率界，从递归本身推导局部化半径。

Result: 仅用二阶矩即获得$T^{-1/3}$的期望平均平方梯度平稳性；显式预言机复杂度推论与已知光滑Blum–Gladyshev（BG-0）下界匹配，包含$Lb_2\\Delta^3\\varepsilon^{-6}$与$L\\Delta\\sigma^2\\varepsilon^{-4}$两项随机项（$\\Delta$为初始目标间隙）。$p>2$时高概率界将"对数方差"与"多项式稀有冲击"贡献分离。此外给出递增置信速率、恢复根号$T$平稳性的目标间隙增长精细化，以及随机$L^p$-Lipschitz示例。

Conclusion: 在距离相关二阶矩类中，未修改的标准SGD即达到极小极大随机复杂度；而均方光滑（mean-square-smooth）类因额外预言机结构允许更快算法，其最优性陈述应与此广义BG-0最优性区分开来。

Abstract: Uniform noise-moment bounds exclude stochastic gradients whose variability increases with the iterate. We study ordinary, single-sample stochastic gradient descent for smooth, lower-bounded, possibly nonconvex objectives under distance-dependent conditional moments. Under second moments alone, a direct descent--displacement argument yields $T^{-1/3}$ expected average squared-gradient stationarity with a horizon-dependent stepsize. An explicit oracle-complexity corollary matches the known smooth Blum--Gladyshev (BG-0) lower bound, including the $Lb_2Δ^3\varepsilon^{-6}$ and $LΔσ^2\varepsilon^{-4}$ stochastic terms, where $Δ$ is the initial objective gap and $σ^2+b_2\|x-x_1\|^2$ bounds the variance. Thus unchanged SGD attains the minimax stochastic complexity in this second-moment class. For $p>2$, predictable localization and a Hilbert-space Fuk--Nagaev inequality yield a high-probability bound separating logarithmic variance and polynomial rare-shock contributions. The localization radius is derived from the recursion: no bounded-iterate assumption, clipping, normalization, momentum, or increasing batch size is needed. We also give increasing-confidence rates, an objective-gap-growth refinement recovering root-$T$ stationarity, and stochastic $L^p$-Lipschitz examples. The broad BG-0 optimality statement is distinguished from the smaller mean-square-smooth class, in which additional oracle structure permits faster algorithms.

</details>


### [396] [MARCEDES: Score-based causal discovery under non-Gaussianity with continuous optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30643)
*Anamitra Chaudhuri,Anirban Bhattacharya,Yang Ni*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对非高斯误差结构方程模型的因果DAG学习问题，提出均值绝对残差风险，并据此构建基于分数的学习方法MARCEDES，在无约束优化框架下实现高效求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从故意误设的全拉普拉斯误差非高斯SEM出发，希望找到一个能区分真实加权因果DAG矩阵与其他矩阵的风险准则，并兼顾高维与有限样本情形。

Method: 引入均值绝对残差风险，理论上证明真实加权因果DAG矩阵风险渐近严格最小；进一步加入行特定稀疏惩罚与软DAG约束，得到实矩阵空间上的连续得分函数；提出MARCEDES——无约束得分最小化方法，用梯度优化求解，并设计处理得分目标非光滑性及在广义贝叶斯框架下行特定稀疏惩罚最优调优的计算算法。

Result: 理论分析表明真实加权因果DAG矩阵的均值绝对残差风险渐近严格小于任意其他矩阵；所提算法可处理非光滑目标并实现行特定稀疏惩罚调优；模拟研究显示方法高效且优于现有方法。

Conclusion: MARCEDES通过无约束得分最小化实现非高斯SEM的DAG学习，规避约束优化困难，兼顾高维与有限样本，并在模拟中验证了效率与性能优势。

Abstract: We consider the problem of learning the underlying causal directed acyclic graph (DAG) structure corresponding to a structural equation model (SEM) with non-Gaussian errors. Motivated by an intentionally misspecified non-Gaussian SEM with all Laplace errors, we first introduce the mean absolute residual risk, defined over the space of all real matrices, and show that, asymptotically, the risk of the true weighted causal DAG matrix is strictly smaller than that of any other matrix. Nevertheless, to enhance generality and account for high-dimensional and finite-sample settings, we further incorporate row-specific sparsity penalties along with a soft DAG constraint to derive a continuous score function over the space of real matrices. Accordingly, we propose a score-based DAG learning method, named MARCEDES, formulated as an unconstrained score minimization problem, which can be efficiently solved using gradient-based optimization techniques, thereby circumventing the challenges associated with constrained optimization. Furthermore, we develop a computational algorithm to handle the non-smoothness of the score objective and to enable optimal tuning of row-specific sparsity penalties under a generalized Bayes framework. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency and improved performance of the proposed method over existing approaches through an extensive simulation study.

</details>


### [397] [Parameter Estimation for Unnormalized Discrete Models via Empirically Localized Deformed Bregman Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30713)
*Takashi Takenouchi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文提出将经验局部化技术与变形Bregman散度相结合，以规避离散变量概率模型中归一化常数的计算困难，并通过选择不同变形赋予估计量效率或抗离群噪声等统计性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散变量概率模型的参数估计中，归一化常数（配分函数）的计算往往很困难，已有大量研究试图绕开该计算。本文旨在进一步解决这一难题。

Method: 将经验局部化（empirical localization）技术与变形Bregman散度（deformed Bregman divergence）相结合。

Result: 经验局部化技术可大幅降低归一化常数计算的计算成本；对Bregman散度进行适当的变形选择，可使所提估计量具备多种有利的统计性质。

Conclusion: 该方法既能降低计算开销，又能通过变形设计灵活获得效率、抗离群噪声鲁棒性等统计性质。

Abstract: Estimation of parameter of probabilistic models is an important task in the field of machine learning.For models of discrete variables, calculation of the normalization constant of model is sometimes difficult and a lot of researches have been done to avoid the calculation of the normalization constant. In this paper, we tackle with the difficulty by combining a technique of empirical localization and a deformed Bregman divergence.The technique of empirical localization makes it possible to drastically reduce computational cost of the calculation of the normalization constant, and in addition, appropriate choice of the deformation for the Bregman divergence can invest the proposed estimator with various kinds of favorable statistical properties, such as efficiency or robustness against outlier noise.

</details>


### [398] [Conformal Prediction under Exponential-Tilt Joint Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30886)
*Seungjin Choi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究分布变化下共形预测的自适应问题，比较了"重加权标定"与"重加权+预测倾斜"两种策略，发现倾斜并非总能改善性能，其收益取决于目标输入是否包含关于响应漂移的信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测在部署后数据分布发生变化时会失去覆盖率。既有工作多用源标签与目标无标签输入进行自适应，但输入分布及其与结果的关系可能同时改变，如何在结构化分布漂移下恢复目标覆盖率并提升效率仍是待解问题。

Method: 采用Exponential Tilt Reweighting Alignment（ExTRA，Maity等2023年提出于分类）估计结构化分布漂移权重。对比两种做法：一是在共形标定中使用估计权重；二是额外对源预测分布进行倾斜。通过共享已学习预测器、估计权重、标定样本与测试观测，隔离倾斜效应；并结合识别性计算与评分-权重估计误差交互分析解释性能差异。

Result: 在假定模型与数据生成过程匹配、且目标输入对漂移具有信息量的合成回归设定中，倾斜使平均集合长度相对仅重加权缩短约30%，两者覆盖率均接近名义水平。但在合成分类中，以及目标输入对响应漂移信息量很少的回归情形中，倾斜会导致显著的覆盖率损失。真实数据实验同样未见一致收益。

Conclusion: 仅靠重加权标定获得良好覆盖率并不能保证加入预测倾斜后覆盖率仍被保持。如何在仅使用源标签与目标输入的情况下判断是否应施加该额外调整，仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Conformal prediction can lose coverage when the data distribution changes after deployment. We study adaptation using labeled source data and unlabeled target inputs, allowing both the input distribution and its relationship with outcomes to change. We use Exponential Tilt Reweighting Alignment (ExTRA), introduced for classification by Maity et al. (2023), to estimate structured distribution shifts. We compare using its estimated weights in conformal calibration with additionally tilting the source predictive distribution. Shared learned predictors, estimated weights, calibration samples, and test observations isolate the effect of tilting. Existing theory gives both procedures target coverage with true weights and a common coverage bound with estimated weights. Identification calculations and an analysis of how scoring interacts with weight estimation error help explain why their performance can nevertheless differ. In a synthetic regression setting where the assumed models match the data-generating process and target inputs are informative about the shift, tilting reduces mean set length by about $30\%$ relative to weighting alone, with both methods attaining coverage near nominal. Tilting can instead cause substantial coverage losses in synthetic classification and in regression when target inputs provide little information about the response shift. Real-data experiments also show no consistent benefit. Good coverage from weighted calibration alone does not ensure that adding predictive tilting will preserve coverage. Deciding when to apply this additional adjustment using only source labels and target inputs remains an open problem.

</details>


### [399] [Geometric Moment Contraction for Stochastic Nesterov Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31303)
*Wei Biao Wu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文研究常参数随机 Nesterov 递推的几何矩收缩（GMC），在均值强单调与随机 L^p Lipschitz 条件下给出显式 Perron 比较判据，并借助幂-Lyapunov 分析给出对任意 β<1 与 p>1 的正步长区间，最后通过 S-过程与端点 Lyapunov 不等式刻画度量的保守性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nesterov 加速方法的随机版本在实践中广泛使用，但其在非二次、重尾甚至无穷方差梯度下的矩收缩与稳定性边界缺乏简洁且可验证的显式判据；尤其小步长区域对动量的限制需要更精细的分析。

Method: 采用显式 Perron 比较证明同步 L^p 收缩，条件为 βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p})；在仅假设有限 p 阶梯度矩时，用幂-Lyapunov 论证建立正步长区间；在 p=2 时给出显式证书 γ<2μ(1-β)^2/[L_2^2(1-β+2β^2)]；进一步提出仅依赖均值的二次 S-过程，并在更强的逐样本扇区信息下利用端点 Lyapunov 不等式。

Result: Perron 判据可覆盖 1<p<2 的无穷方差梯度，但其小步长机制要求 β<μ/(μ+L_p)；幂-Lyapunov 方法对每个固定 β<1 与 p>1 都给出正步长区间，通常远小于前者；p=2 的显式证书在高动量下呈二次缩放，该保守性源于所选度量而非真实稳定性边界；经验证的端点证书可比显式度量保守度低数个数量级。

Conclusion: 该工作为随机 Nesterov 递推提供了可计算的矩收缩与步长证书，区分了度量诱导的保守性与本质稳定性限制，并通过 S-过程与端点 Lyapunov 分析显著降低了保守度。

Abstract: We study geometric moment contraction (GMC) of the constant-parameter stochastic Nesterov recursion \[ Y_k=Θ_k+β(Θ_k-Θ_{k-1}),\qquad Θ_{k+1}=Y_k-γG(Y_k,X_{k+1}). \] Under mean strong monotonicity and stochastic $L^p$ Lipschitz continuity, an explicit Perron comparison proves synchronous $L^p$ contraction when $βγL_p<(1-β)(1-q_{γ,p})$. This direct criterion includes infinite-variance gradients for $1<p<2$, but its small-step regime requires $β<μ/(μ+L_p)$. A complementary power-Lyapunov argument establishes a positive, generally much smaller, step-size interval for every fixed $β<1$ and every $p>1$, using only a finite $p$th gradient moment. At $p=2$, a simpler explicit certificate gives \[ 0<γ<\frac{2μ(1-β)^2}{L_2^2(1-β+2β^2)}. \] Its quadratic high-momentum scaling is a limitation of the chosen metric, not a sharp stability boundary. We quantify this loss, provide a general mean-only quadratic $S$-procedure, and exploit endpoint Lyapunov inequalities under stronger samplewise sector information. Verified endpoint certificates can be orders of magnitude less conservative than the explicit metric.

</details>


### [400] [Equation discovery with Bayesian tree-adjoining grammars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31368)
*Christopher A. Lindley,Nikolaos Dervilis,Keith Worden*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将树邻接语法（TAG）引入贝叶斯框架用于非线性系统辨识，通过结构保持的可逆跳MCMC采样器推断模型结构、参数与预测的联合后验，在仿真与基准数据上验证了不确定性量化与灰箱建模优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于TAG的非线性系统辨识方法依赖进化优化，仅返回模型结构的点估计，无法量化模型结构与参数的不确定性，也难以嵌入物理先验构建灰箱模型。

Method: 在树结构及其参数上定义生成式先验，将整个模型类编码为有限语法规则集、候选模型以树形式组装；采用带结构保持树移动的可逆跳MCMC采样器，推断模型结构、参数与预测的联合后验。考虑两种训练目标：带共轭参数提议的一步预测目标，以及通过无似然推断处理的仿真目标。

Result: 在仿真多项式NARX系统、Silverbox基准以及Christchurch Bay Tower波浪载荷数据上验证；将Morison方程作为固定初始树嵌入可得到灰箱模型，其性能优于物理驱动基线。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯TAG适合对动力系统方程发现中的不确定性进行量化，并可用于拟合物理信息模型。

Abstract: Tree-Adjoining Grammars (TAGs) have recently been introduced to Nonlinear System Identification (NLSI) as a means of encoding an entire model class as a finite set of grammatical rules, from which candidate models are assembled as trees. Existing TAG-based identifiers rely on evolutionary optimisation and return point estimates of the model structure. This paper instead proposes the TAG framework within a Bayesian setting. A generative prior is defined over tree structures and their parameters, and a Reversible-Jump MCMC sampler with structure-preserving tree moves is used to infer the joint posterior over model structure, parameters and predictions. Two training objectives are considered; that is, a one-step-ahead objective with conjugate parameter proposals, and a simulation-based objective handled by likelihood-free inference. The approach is validated on a simulated polynomial NARX system, the Silverbox benchmark, and wave-loading data from the Christchurch Bay Tower, where embedding Morison's equation as a fixed initial tree yields a grey-box model that outperforms the physics-driven baseline. The results demonstrate that Bayesian TAGs are well suited to quantifying uncertainty in equation discovery for dynamical systems and to fitting physics-informed models.

</details>


### [401] [Nonparametric In-Context Learning under Growing Geometric Complexity: Minimax Optimality and Local Geometry-Adaptivity of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31458)
*Jaehee Seo,Jisu Kim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究未知局部几何下的预测问题，将数据建模为随样本量变化的异质流形混合，建立极小极大下界，并构造达到匹配上界的oracle切空间局部多项式估计器，进而联系到一个结构感知两阶段softmax Transformer，证明其以对数深度、多项式规模逼近极小极大最优率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer在上下文学习（ICL）中表现优异，但现有非参数ICL理论多局限于欧氏域或单一流形模型，无法刻画几何异质数据中任务相关结构的利用。作者希望填补这一空白，理解Transformer如何在未知、异质的局部几何下进行学习与预测。

Method: 将预测问题建模为样本量依赖的多流形混合，各分量在维度、光滑度和采样质量上异质；在局部分离与小扰动条件下推导聚合难度的极小极大下界；构造oracle切空间局部多项式估计器并给出匹配上界；将该估计器对应到一个结构感知的两阶段softmax Transformer，含几何预条件器与分图（chartwise）约简局部多项式求解器；最后推导该类近经验风险最小化器的ICL泛化界。

Result: 得到刻画各分量聚合难度的极小极大下界，并证明oracle切空间局部多项式估计器达到匹配上界；该Transformer在几何预条件与分图求解下，以对数深度和多项式规模实现相对极小极大率可忽略的逼近误差，并给出相应的ICL泛化界。

Conclusion: 结果刻画了预测器利用局部几何并达到聚合极小极大率所需的条件，将异质流形混合下的非参数ICL理论与结构感知Transformer架构联系起来，为理解Transformer在几何异质数据上的上下文学习能力提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Transformers have become a central architecture for in-context learning (ICL), particularly through their state-of-the-art performance in large language models. This success motivates understanding how transformers exploit task-relevant structure in geometrically heterogeneous data. However, existing nonparametric ICL theory has largely focused on Euclidean domains or single-manifold models. To address this gap, we study the prediction problem under unknown local geometry, modeled by sample size-dependent mixtures of manifolds with heterogeneous dimensions, smoothness, and sampling masses. Under local separation and small-perturbation conditions, we establish a minimax lower bound capturing the aggregate difficulty of the components and construct an oracle tangent local-polynomial estimator with a matching upper bound. This estimator is connected to a structure-informed, two-stage softmax transformer with a geometric preconditioner and chartwise reduced local-polynomial solvers. The transformer achieves negligible approximation error relative to the minimax rate with logarithmic depth and polynomial size. Finally, we derive an in-context generalization bound for near empirical risk minimizers over this class. Together, these results identify conditions under which the resulting predictor exploits local geometry and attains the aggregate minimax rate.

</details>


### [402] [Beyond Empirical Support: Structured Outlier Generation via Sinkhorn Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31470)
*Haixiang Sun,Andrew L. Liu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 Sinkhorn Boundary Outlier Generation (SBOG) 框架，将 Sinkhorn 最优传输几何与分布鲁棒边界建模结合，用于潜空间离群点生成，在时间序列异常生成和图像离群点合成任务中验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险应用中，机器学习系统的鲁棒性依赖于有限数据集难以捕获的稀有情形，而现有离群点合成方法通常依赖稀疏邻域、低支持潜区域或分类器边界穿越，存在启发式、不稳定、且受特定模态或架构限制的问题。因此需要一种结构化、模态无关的离群点生成方法来支持压力场景生成。

Method: 提出 SBOG 框架：在潜空间中，将 Sinkhorn 最优传输几何与分布鲁棒边界建模相耦合。利用 Sinkhorn 诱导的支持代价（support cost）引导采样器朝向弱支持的边界区域，同时通过语义约束防止样本发生不受控漂移，从而产生对分布内参考测度的可控偏差，而非任意稀疏区域采样。

Result: 在时间序列异常生成与图像离群点合成实验中，该框架能够生成具有信息量且语义可控的离群点，并在多种模态上提升下游鲁棒性评估效果。

Conclusion: SBOG 为超越经验支持的压力场景生成提供了基础，是一种结构化、跨模态的离群点生成方法。

Abstract: Outliers are essential for evaluating and improving the robustness of machine learning systems, especially when future distributions may differ significantly from historical training data. In high-stakes applications, robustness often depends on rare cases that finite datasets fail to capture, making simple resampling or perturbation insufficient for stress scenario generation. Existing outlier synthesis methods typically rely on sparse neighborhoods, low support latent regions, or classifier boundary crossings, which can be heuristic, unstable, and tied to specific modalities or architectures. We therefore propose Sinkhorn Boundary Outlier Generation (SBOG), a structured framework for latent-space outlier generation that couples Sinkhorn optimal transport geometry with distributionally robust boundary modeling. The resulting Sinkhorn-induced support cost guides the sampler toward weakly supported boundary regions, while semantic constraints prevent uncontrolled drift from the intended context, yielding controlled deviations from the in-distribution reference measure rather than arbitrary sparse-region samples. Experiments on time series anomaly generation and image outlier synthesis show that our framework produces informative, semantically controlled outliers and improves downstream robustness evaluation across modalities, providing a foundation for stress scenario generation beyond empirical support.

</details>


### [403] [Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31570)
*Damiano Brigo,Raphaël Huser,Dan Leonte*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出基于模拟推断的粗糙Heston(rHeston)校准框架，学习以IV曲面为条件的参数后验分布，并结合异方差神经代理定价器，为路径依赖奇异期权给出不确定性感知的定价区间；同时提出Hellinger-SHAP可解释性方法，定位影响各参数后验信息增益的期限—价内程度区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习虽显著加速了复杂随机波动率模型的校准，但纯神经点校准无法刻画在观测到隐含波动率(IV)曲面后仍然存在的参数不确定性。这种残余不确定性会传导到路径依赖奇异期权的定价中，而点代入(plug-in)定价可能严重失真，因此需要不确定性量化(UQ)框架。

Method: 1) 将rHeston校准建模为基于模拟的推断(SBI)问题，用神经比率估计(NRE)学习参数在IV曲面条件下的后验分布；2) 将后验样本通过异方差神经代理定价器传播，得到后验预测分布，融合残余参数不确定性与条件代理不确定性；3) 提出Hellinger-SHAP：对度量先验到后验收缩的后验信息泛函施加局部背景Kernel SHAP，将后验信息增益归因到期限—价内程度区域。

Result: 仿真研究中，后验预测区间在远期启动、障碍与已实现方差类合约上达到校准或保守的覆盖率；而点代入价格在某些合约区间可能显著不可靠。Hellinger-SHAP识别出与单个rHeston参数后验信息增益相关的期限—价内程度区域。

Conclusion: UQ与XAI两项分析共同构成一个透明框架，可在给定先验预测模型下实现不确定性感知的神经校准与下游奇异期权定价。

Abstract: Deep learning has substantially accelerated the calibration of complex stochastic-volatility models, but neural point calibration alone does not capture the uncertainty remaining after an implied-volatility (IV) surface has been observed. We develop a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston (rHeston) calibration that learns the posterior distribution of the model parameters conditional on an IV surface. Using neural ratio estimation, we obtain calibrated posterior samples that can be propagated through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers for path-dependent exotic options. The resulting posterior-predictive distributions combine residual parameter uncertainty with conditional surrogate uncertainty and yield uncertainty-aware price intervals.
  We further introduce Hellinger-SHAP, an information-theoretic explainability method for posterior inference. Rather than attributing a single parameter point estimate, it applies local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional measuring contraction from the prior to the posterior. This identifies maturity--moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for individual rHeston parameters. In a simulation study, posterior-predictive intervals provide calibrated or conservative coverage across forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, while point plug-in prices can be materially unreliable for selected contract regimes. Together, the UQ and XAI analyses provide a transparent framework for uncertainty-aware neural calibration and downstream exotic pricing under the specified prior-predictive model.

</details>


### [404] [First-Order Stationarity of Reverse Diffusions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31612)
*Zhifeng Chen,Chenyang Jiang,Yazhen Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将优化与采样的联系推广到扩散模型，建立了基于SDE的反向扩散过程的首阶理论。证明了强凸势能下过阻尼与欠阻尼Langevin反向流的相对Fisher散度以显式指数速率收缩，并给出含离散化的平均一阶平稳性界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有文献揭示了优化与采样之间的紧密联系，但扩散模型尚缺乏对应的首阶理论。作者希望借鉴非凸优化中的"平均梯度范数"保证，为扩散模型采样器建立类似的首阶收敛理论。

Method: 针对过阻尼与欠阻尼Langevin扩散，分析其基于SDE的反向时间流，推导相对Fisher散度的显式指数收缩率；并进一步纳入离散化误差，推导两类扩散模型采样器的平均一阶平稳性界。

Result: 当正向过程（加噪过程）的稳态势能强凸时，SDE反向流的相对Fisher散度以显式指数速率收缩；这是基于SDE的反向扩散相对基于ODE的反向过程所独有的优势。离散化后，两类采样器均获得平均一阶平稳性界。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了扩散模型的首阶采样理论：强凸条件取决于所选的加噪过程而非数据，因而具有普适性；所形成的无凸性依赖证书是局部的，保证分数一致性而非全局模态权重。

Abstract: Recent literature has shown a strong connection between optimization and sampling. We develop the corresponding first-order theory for diffusion models. First, the SDE-based reverse-time flows of overdamped and underdamped Langevin diffusions contract relative Fisher divergences at explicit exponential rates whenever the stationary potential of the forward process is strongly convex---a condition on the noising process one chooses, not on the data. This is a unique advantage of SDE-based reverse diffusion, absent in the reverse process based on ODEs. Second, we incorporate discretization and establish averaged first-order stationarity bounds---the sampling analog of averaged gradient-norm guarantees in nonconvex optimization---for samplers of both overdamped and underdamped diffusion models. As in nonconvex optimization, the convexity-free certificate is local: it guarantees score consistency, not global mode weights.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [405] [WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30436)
*Mingkai Jia,Jiaxin Guo,Zhijian Shu,Jiawei Xu,Mingxiao Li,Jintao Cheng,Ping Tan,Wei Yin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出WALT，通过从冻结的驾驶世界模型向紧凑轨迹隐空间迁移语义知识，缓解视觉世界状态与几何轨迹间的失配，提升轨迹规划性能并降低30.5%算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶世界模型虽能从视觉观测中学习丰富的预测性表征，但准确的视觉预测并不必然带来有效的轨迹规划。作者认为关键瓶颈在于视觉世界状态与原始几何轨迹之间的不匹配，限制了规划器利用世界模型所编码的动作相关语义的能力。

Method: 提出World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT)：在不修改世界模型本身的前提下，借助双分支轨迹自编码器将原始路点映射为紧凑表征，并把冻结的预训练驾驶世界模型中的语义知识迁移到该轨迹隐空间，使学到的动作表征捕获与未来运动和规划相关的场景级线索。此外，系统研究了基于JEPA的隐空间学习与REPA式的特征对齐两种方案，以考察仅用轨迹的表征学习如何影响下游规划。

Result: 在NAVSIM基准上评估：相比原始路点基线，NAVSIMv1的PDMS由89.4提升至89.8，NAVSIMv2的EPDMS由87.3提升至87.9，同时轨迹规划器FLOPs降低30.5%。

Conclusion: 在保留世界表征的同时提取动作相关信息，可为基于世界模型的轨迹规划提供有效接口，且该隐空间对齐方式在提升规划指标的同时显著降低计算开销。

Abstract: Driving world models learn rich predictive representations of the surrounding environment from visual observations, yet accurate visual prediction does not necessarily translate into effective trajectory planning. We argue that a key bottleneck lies in the mismatch between visual world states and raw geometric trajectories, which may limit the planner's ability to exploit action-relevant semantics encoded by the world model. To address this issue, we propose World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories (WALT), which learns a compact generative trajectory latent space by transferring information from a frozen pretrained driving world model without modifying the world model itself. Rather than directly generating raw waypoints, WALT maps them into compact representations through a dual-branch trajectory autoencoder and transfers semantic knowledge from the frozen visual world model into this trajectory space, encouraging the learned action representation to capture scene-level cues relevant to future motion and planning. Beyond our proposed formulation, we systematically study latent learning based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) and feature alignment following Representation Alignment (REPA) to investigate how trajectory-only representation learning affects downstream planning. We evaluate WALT on the NAVSIM benchmarks. Relative to the raw-waypoint baseline, WALT improves PDMS from 89.4 to 89.8 on NAVSIMv1 and EPDMS from 87.3 to 87.9 on NAVSIMv2 while reducing trajectory planner FLOPs by 30.5%. These results suggest that preserving world representations while extracting action-relevant information provides an effective interface for world-model-based trajectory planning.

</details>


### [406] [VkVIO: Cross-platform GPU Acceleration for Visual-Inertial Odometry with Vulkan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30459)
*Ole Hoffmann,Mateo de Mayo,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出VkVIO，首个跨平台GPU加速的视觉惯性里程计方法，基于厂商无关的Vulkan API而非CUDA，在保证实时因果估计精度的同时实现多设备部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人与XR中的感知依赖状态估计，VIO/VI-SLAM是低成本高精度的有效方案。GPU加速可降低延迟，但已有工作局限于CUDA，导致部署受限于单一厂商，缺乏跨平台能力。

Method: 采用最初为3D图形严格性能需求设计的Vulkan API，实现厂商无关的GPU加速VIO，提供满足实时运行所需的因果估计。

Result: 在包括工作站、笔记本和极低成本单板计算机等多样设备上部署VkVIO，在同硬件上性能优于基于CUDA的系统，并达到最先进的精度。

Conclusion: VkVIO为机器人和XR领域实现低延迟、低功耗、低成本的VIO提供了新的可能。

Abstract: Perception in robotics and XR fundamentally relies on good state estimation. Visual-inertial odometry (VIO) and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) are proven ways of achieving this goal in a cost-effective and accurate manner. Efficiency in these systems allows for smaller, cooler, and lighter devices. GPU acceleration is a natural approach for reducing latency, thanks to their wide availability in platforms like embedded computers, mobile phones, and XR headsets. However, previous works in the literature have limited themselves to the use of CUDA for this task, significantly reducing deployment options to a single vendor. We instead leverage the vendor-agnostic Vulkan API, originally designed for the strict performance requirements of 3D graphics applications. In this work, we present VkVIO, the first, to the best of our knowledge, cross-platform GPU-accelerated VIO method. We provide state-of-the-art accuracy with causal estimates required for real-time operation. We deploy VkVIO on a diverse range of devices spanning a workstation, a laptop, and an extremely inexpensive single-board computer, while outperforming CUDA-based systems on the same hardware. VkVIO enables possibilities for low-latency, low-power, and low-cost VIO in robotics and XR.

</details>


### [407] [Enabling a Unified Cross-Domain Representation for Two-Finger Gripper Manipulation via Interaction-Centric Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31207)
*Guanlin Li,Shifeng Bao,Yihan Zhao,Haitao Shen,Haoyang Li,Chen Zhao,Tong Yang,Jie Tang,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以交互为中心的模仿学习框架，通过参数化通用夹爪抽象获得规范夹爪坐标系表示，结合VLM、SAM2.1、混合势场点云特征与Flow-Matching Transformer预测7-DoF动作块，首次实现competitive基准成绩与跨本体/跨视角零样本sim-to-real迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习中的跨本体泛化受限于一个关键表示缺陷：任务语义与硬件特有的视觉几何被纠缠在一起。作者希望解耦二者，使策略能迁移到结构不同、异构的机器人平台上。

Method: 利用两指夹爪的共享结构，设计参数化通用夹爪抽象，得到规范的夹爪坐标系表示。给定语言与RGB-D观测，由VLM推断子任务并定位交互三元组（夹爪、被持物、目标物），并用SAM 2.1跟踪掩码以减少VLM查询。设计简洁混合特征：目标/碰撞人工势场用于全局引导，分割后的夹爪坐标系点云用于局部几何。用Flow-Matching Transformer预测平滑的7-DoF动作块。

Result: 在仿真与真实任务中，该方法同时取得有竞争力的基准分数，并实现极端跨本体、跨视角的零样本sim-to-real迁移，可迁移到完全不同的异构机器人平台，为同类模仿学习方法中首次。

Conclusion: 以交互为中心的规范夹爪坐标系表示与混合特征设计，有效解耦任务语义与硬件几何，使模仿学习策略具备强跨本体与跨视角泛化能力。

Abstract: Achieving robust cross-embodiment generalization in imitation learning demands overcoming a critical representation flaw that inextricably entangles task semantics with hardware-specific visual geometry. We propose an interaction-centric framework that leverages the shared structure of two-finger grippers via a parameterized universal gripper abstraction, yielding a canonical gripper-frame representation. Given language and RGB-D observations, a VLM infers the subtask and grounds an interaction triplet (gripper, held, target), while SAM~2.1 tracks masks to reduce VLM queries. We design concise hybrid features that combine target/collision artificial potential fields for global guidance with segmented gripper-frame point clouds for local geometry, and use a Flow-Matching Transformer to predict smooth 7-DoF action chunks. Experiments in simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that ours is the first imitation learning approach to simultaneously achieve competitive benchmark scores and extreme cross-embodiment/cross-viewpoint zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to completely distinct, heterogeneous robot platforms.

</details>


### [408] [RECAST: From Log Replay to Closed-Loop Driving Simulation with View-Complete Actors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31374)
*Zijun Zhao,Liewen Liao,Kang Shen,Songan Zhang,Ming Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RECAST 是一个基于 3D 高斯溅射的框架，能从驾驶日志中单个分割车辆观测生成视角完整的可控车辆资产，并注册到重建场景中，支持超越原始轨迹的闭环规划器仿真与测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭环驾驶仿真中，自车与周围车辆运动超出记录轨迹时会暴露源日志中不存在的视角。现有数据驱动仿真器从稀疏观测重建动态车辆，在这些视角变化下会产生渲染伪影，无法可靠支撑规划器闭环评估。

Method: 提出 RECAST：基于 3D 高斯溅射，从驾驶日志中单次分割的车辆观测生成视角完整的车辆资产，并将其配准到重建场景中，支持受控自车-车辆交互下的规划器在环渲染。为将图像到 3D 先验适配到真实车辆，构建 RECAR 数据集（约 2 万真实车辆、60 万张无背景 RGBA 图像，覆盖多样车型与颜色），并采用两阶段适配策略改进真实驾驶日志观测下的车辆生成。

Result: 车辆层面：相比未适配的 TRELLIS，RECAST 将 FD_incep 从 9.788 降至 7.992。场景层面：在车辆运动超出记录轨迹时，相比 Street Gaussians，FD_incep 从 129.35 降至 112.10，CLIP_margin（×1000）从 0.14 提升至 3.47。在图像条件规划器 GTRS-Dense 的规划器在环仿真中，相比原生 Street Gaussians 车辆，无碰撞率 NC 从 22.2%（12/54）提升至 63.0%（34/54），平均最小预测碰撞时间 TTC 从 0.798 s 提升至 2.150 s。

Conclusion: RECAST 支持在受控自车-车辆交互下、超越日志回放的闭环规划器评估，验证了其在视角完整车辆生成与闭环仿真中的有效性。

Abstract: Closed-loop driving simulation requires rendered observations to remain reliable as the ego vehicle and surrounding actors move beyond their recorded trajectories, exposing views absent from the source log. Existing data-driven simulators reconstruct dynamic actors from sparse observations, which can result in rendering artifacts under these viewpoint changes. We introduce RECAST (REconstructing Controllable Actors for Simulation and Testing), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that generates a view-complete actor from a single segmented vehicle observation in a driving log and registers the generated actor in the reconstructed scene. RECAST supports planner-in-the-loop rendering under controlled ego-actor interactions. To adapt an image-to-3D prior to real vehicles, we further introduce RECAR, a dataset of approximately 20K real vehicles with 600K background-free RGBA images spanning diverse vehicle colors and types. We use two-stage adaptation to improve vehicle generation from real driving-log observations. At the actor level, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 9.788 to 7.992 relative to unadapted TRELLIS. At the scene level, under actor motion beyond logged trajectories, RECAST reduces $\mathrm{FD}_{\mathrm{incep}}$ from 129.35 to 112.10 and increases $\mathrm{CLIP}_{\mathrm{margin}}$ ($\times1000$) from 0.14 to 3.47 relative to Street Gaussians. We demonstrate planner-in-the-loop simulation with the image-conditioned planner GTRS-Dense. Compared with native Street Gaussians actors, RECAST increases the no-collision (NC) rate from 22.2% (12/54) to 63.0% (34/54) and the mean minimum predicted time-to-collision (TTC) from 0.798 s to 2.150 s. These experiments show that RECAST supports closed-loop planner evaluation under controlled ego-actor interactions beyond log replay. Visit our project page at https://zijunkr.github.io/RECAST/

</details>


### [409] [Guiding End-to-End Driving Models with Endpoint-Constrained Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31383)
*Brayden Zhang,Mahsa Golchoubian,Igor Gilitschenski,Boris Ivanovic,Kashyap Chitta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文发现端到端驾驶策略的开环/闭环差距除协变量偏移与因果混淆外，还源于中间航点物理不一致；提出轻量后处理层 ECO，锚定已执行历史、保留预测端点并重塑中间航点，在多个闭环仿真器中提升多种策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端驾驶策略通常以开环行为克隆训练，但部署时需闭环运行，二者存在根本性错配。已有工作多关注协变量偏移与因果混淆，作者指出一个互补因素：基于航点的监督与位移指标并不能保证中间轨迹物理连贯或易于控制器跟踪，且这种不一致主要集中在中间航点，而预测端点相对可靠。

Method: 提出 Endpoint-Constrained Optimization（ECO），一种轻量后处理层：将轨迹锚定到车辆已执行的历史轨迹，保留策略预测的端点，并重塑中间航点以提升可行性。ECO 无需地图、无需特权仿真状态、无需额外训练，可插入多种输出航点的策略与其控制器之间。

Result: 在两个闭环仿真器中，ECO 提升了全部六个生成式与回归式驾驶策略的聚合闭环得分，且基础规划越频繁违反运动学限制，增益越大。HUGSIM 上 VaVAM 的 HD-Score 从 18.1 提升至 31.0（+71%），获 HUGSIM 闭环驾驶挑战赛第一名；AlpaSim 上 VaVAM 与 DiffusionDrive 的场景得分分别提升 123% 与 22%。

Conclusion: 对于广泛的端到端驾驶模型，在不改变策略预测端点的前提下修复其预测轨迹的中间几何形态，即可显著提升闭环性能，说明中间航点的物理一致性是开环/闭环差距的重要来源。

Abstract: End-to-end driving policies are commonly trained through open-loop behavior cloning, yet they must ultimately operate in closed-loop when deployed on a vehicle, creating a fundamental mismatch between training and execution. Beyond the commonly studied effects of covariate shift and causal confusion, we identify a complementary factor for this open-loop/closed-loop gap: waypoint-based supervision and displacement metrics do not ensure that the intermediate trajectory is physically coherent or easy for the controller to track. We observe that these inconsistencies concentrate primarily at intermediate waypoints, while the predicted endpoint remains comparatively reliable. Based on this observation, we introduce Endpoint-Constrained Optimization (ECO), a lightweight postprocessing layer that anchors the trajectory to the vehicle's executed history, preserves the policy's predicted endpoint, and reshapes the intermediate waypoints to improve feasibility. ECO requires no map, privileged simulator state, or additional training, and can be inserted between a broad range of waypoint-emitting policies and their controllers. Across two closed-loop simulators, it improves the aggregate closed-loop score of all six evaluated generative and regression-based driving policies, and the gains tend to increase with how often the base plans violate motion limits. On HUGSIM, ECO improves VaVAM from 18.1 to 31.0 HD-Score (+71%), achieving 1st place on the HUGSIM Closed-Loop Driving Challenge. Similarly, on AlpaSim, ECO increases the scene scores of VaVAM and DiffusionDrive by 123% and 22%, respectively. These results show that for a broad collection of end-to-end driving models, repairing the intermediate geometry of predicted trajectories without changing the policy's predicted endpoint can substantially improve closed-loop performance.

</details>


### [410] [InternW0-$Δ$: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31394)
*Xingyu Miao,Zizun Li,Baole Fang,Kaiwen Song,Tenghui Wang,Hanxue Zhang,Yating Wang,Xudong Li,Yuping He,Xueyuan Wei,Chao Gao,Xijie Yang,Yingxiang Xu,Kerui Ren,Wenqi Guo,Jianjun Zhou,Xinzhe Wang,Weiguang Zhao,Ni Yang,Zetao Cai,Yufei Xue,Hengjie Li,Zeyu He,Yuanzhen Zhou,Rong Fu,Jianyang Zhang,Siwei Cui,Fuxian Huang,Yunsong Zhou,Xing Gao,Yifei Yao,Qiaojun Yu,Kailin Li,Ming Zhou,Mu Huang,Xinyue Li,Wenze Cui,Bingqi Jiang,Xueyue Zhu,Junting Dong,Haoyu Guo,Tao Lu,Mulin Yu,Bowen Zhou,Bin Zhao,Tianfan Xue,Weinan Zhang,Chunhua Shen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: InternW0-Δ 是一个统一的世界动作模型（WAM），在异构大规模语料上预训练，将视觉动力学、场景语义、4D几何与运动先验及动作生成整合于 Mixture-of-Transformers 框架，在仿真基准与真机平台上取得优于既有方法的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人操作需要同时建模视觉动力学与动作生成，核心难题在于如何把大规模预训练模型所携带的视觉动力学、场景语义、几何与运动等多类先验，统一地整合进机器人动作生成框架中。

Method: 提出 InternW0-Δ：(1) 在 Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）框架内融合预训练视觉动力学、场景级语义、4D 几何与运动先验及动作生成；(2) 预训练视频专家与动作专家在冻结 VLM 的语义引导下交互，预训练 4D 基础模型通过仅训练期蒸馏注入几何与运动先验；(3) 提出 Causal Imprint，利用仅训练期的未来监督学习与未来相关的场景变化，向动作专家提供预测性表征，推理时无需进行未来视频 rollout；(4) 构建异构语料（机器人演示、UMI 数据、第一视角人类演示、Ego2Robot 数据），在统一状态-动作表示下对齐，超 2 万小时处理后训练数据。

Result: 在该语料上预训练后，InternW0-Δ 在多个仿真基准与真机平台上展现出强劲性能，优于先前方法；所构建语料据称是同类中最大的开源语料。作者计划开源训练代码、模型权重、基础设施、数据处理管线及许可允许的处理后数据。

Conclusion: 多源预训练先验（视觉动力学、语义、4D 几何与运动）可在统一 MoT 架构中有效协同，配合仅训练期的因果表征与大规模异构数据联合训练，能显著提升机器人操作的动作生成能力，且推理阶段无需未来视频生成。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model visual dynamics and action generation for generalist robot manipulation. A central challenge is to integrate priors from large-scale pretrained models---including visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry, and motion---into a unified framework for robot action generation. We introduce InternW0-$Δ$, a unified WAM pretrained on a heterogeneous corpus that outperforms prior methods across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms.
  InternW0-$Δ$ combines pretrained visual dynamics, scene-level semantics, 4D geometric and motion priors, and action generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) framework. A pretrained video expert and an action expert interact under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. We further introduce Causal Imprint, which learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision and provides predictive representations directly to the action expert without future-video rollout at inference.
  For large-scale joint training, we construct a heterogeneous corpus of robot demonstrations, UMI data, egocentric human demonstrations, and Ego2Robot data, curated and aligned under a common state-action representation. The resulting corpus contains over 20K hours of processed training data, to our knowledge the largest open-source corpus of its kind. We pretrain InternW0-$Δ$ on this corpus and demonstrate strong performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. We will open source the training code, model weights, infrastructure, data-processing pipeline, and processed data where licenses permit. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/

</details>


### [411] [Vision-Based 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation for Robot Cloth Unfolding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31452)
*Domen Tabernik,Peter Nimac,Jan Jerićević,Danijel Skočaj,Andrej Gams*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CeDiRNet-6DoF，一个联合预测抓取点与完整6-DoF抓取位姿的深度学习框架，用于双臂机器人在空中重抓取策略下展开布料，在ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 布料因可变形、高维特性带来复杂交互动力学，加上褶皱、边缘、抓取点等关键视觉线索常被遮挡，导致感知歧义，使布料操作成为难题。

Method: 采用"空中重抓取"策略：一个机械臂持布，另一个在最优选点抓取以展开布料。提出CeDiRNet-6DoF，将稠密3D抓取回归与分割及正弦-余弦编码的欧拉角相融合，联合预测有效抓取点与完整6-DoF抓取位姿，以最大化展开面积。

Result: 在ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition框架下的双臂机器人平台上广泛评测，达到state-of-the-art性能；消融实验验证了联合分割、背景随机化和图像裁剪等关键设计组件的有效性。

Conclusion: CeDiRNet-6DoF为无结构环境下的可靠机器人布料操作提供了稳健且通用的基础。

Abstract: Cloth manipulation is a challenging task due to the deformable and high-dimensional nature of cloth, which leads to complex interaction dynamics and perceptual ambiguity arising from frequent occlusions of critical visual cues such as folds, edges, and grasp points. In this work, we tackle cloth unfolding using a regrasping-in-the-air strategy, where one manipulator holds the cloth while the other grasps it at an optimally selected point to unfold it. To this end, we propose CeDiRNet-6DoF, a deep learning framework that jointly predicts effective grasp points and the complete 6-DoF grasp pose from the observed cloth configuration. By integrating dense 3D grasp regression with segmentation and sine-cosine-encoded Euler angles, the proposed method reliably estimates the grasp configuration that maximizes the unfolded cloth area. We extensively evaluated CeDiRNet-6DoF on a bimanual robotic setup within the ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance. An ablation study further validates the benefits of key design components, including joint segmentation, background randomization, and image cropping. These results establish CeDiRNet-6DoF as a robust and versatile foundation for reliable robotic cloth manipulation in unstructured environments.

</details>


### [412] [TinyCVIO: A Constellation-Aided Visual-Inertial Odometry System for Nanodrones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30358)
*Derin Ozturk,Kaan Akan,Irwin Wang,Christopher Batten*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TinyCVIO是一种面向资源受限微型无人机的视觉惯性里程计系统，通过传感、视觉处理与估计的协同设计，在双核MCU（520 kB SRAM）上实现实时状态估计，飞行中平均绝对轨迹误差3.5–3.7 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米无人机在传感与算力严重受限的条件下仍需精确、实时的状态估计，现有视觉惯性里程计难以直接部署于低成本微控制器平台。

Method: 采用LED星座提供已知几何（无需预先测量位置或偏航角，假设共面放置）；流式视觉前端以29.2 FPS从毫米级相机追踪LED观测；引入刚性板测量模型保留LED间约束，并用流式QR分解限制估计工作空间，使滤波器状态维度固定。

Result: 在19个手持硬件在环数据集上，刚性板模型相比平面点模型将平均绝对轨迹误差降低27%；完整系统在Crazyflie上完成三种速度共九次飞行，10 m段内平均绝对轨迹误差3.5–3.7 cm、相对位姿误差0.50–0.60%，平均估计延迟15.7–16.3 ms。

Conclusion: TinyCVIO验证了在商用双核微控制器上通过软硬件协同设计实现高精度、低延迟机载视觉惯性里程计的可行性，适用于纳米无人机平台。

Abstract: Nanodrones require accurate, real-time state estimation under severe sensing and computational constraints. We present TinyCVIO, a visual-inertial odometry system that co-designs miniature sensing, visual processing, and estimation for a commodity dual-core microcontroller with 520 kB SRAM. Lightweight LED constellations provide known geometry without surveyed positions or yaw angles, assuming placement on a common level plane. A streaming visual frontend tracks LED observations from a millimeter-scale camera at 29.2 FPS, while a rigid-board measurement model retains inter-LED constraints and streaming QR bounds estimation workspace for a fixed filter-state size. Across 19 hand-held hardware-in-the-loop datasets, the rigid-board model reduces mean absolute trajectory error by 27% relative to planar points. The complete system runs onboard a Crazyflie across nine flights at three speeds, achieving 3.5-3.7 cm mean absolute trajectory error and 0.50-0.60% relative pose error over 10 m segments, with mean estimate latency of 15.7-16.3 ms.

</details>


### [413] [POIL: Point-based One-Shot Imitation Learning with Stable Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30404)
*Sang Min Kim,Jinwoo Seo,Hyeongjun Heo,Junho Lee,Yonghyeon Lee,Young Min Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: POIL 是一个基于点的单样本模仿学习框架，使用对象功能部件上的 3D 点集作为共享表示，联合实现轨迹迁移与闭环执行，从而在物体类别、抓取位姿和场景变化下稳定完成任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单样本模仿学习虽免去大量示教采集，但成功操作不仅需要把示教轨迹迁移到新物体，还需在场景条件、抓取构型和外部扰动变化下稳健执行。现有方法难以同时解决这两方面问题。

Method: POIL 以物体功能部件上的 3D 点集为共享表示：迁移阶段用点对应关系把示教轨迹跨视角、位姿和物体类别进行转移，并借助多模态大语言模型定位功能部件；执行阶段通过多视角跟踪在线观测同一组点，Point-set BCSDM 将逐点速度投影到仅由跟踪点计算出的单一刚体螺旋上，实现闭环驱动，从而将稳定动力系统从 SE(3) 位姿扩展到点集，无需已知 3D 模型或位姿估计器。

Result: 仿真与真机实验表明，POIL 能将单条示教跨物体类别、抓取位姿和目标几何进行迁移，并在执行过程中从外部扰动中恢复。

Conclusion: 理论分析显示，在目标处控制器退化为经典 SO(3) 势函数上的梯度流，因此在刚体假设下继承该势函数的几乎全局收敛性；共享点集表示有效统一了轨迹迁移与鲁棒闭环执行。

Abstract: We present POIL, a point-based one-shot imitation learning framework with stable dynamical systems. While one-shot imitation avoids collecting extensive demonstrations, successful one-shot manipulation requires not only transferring a demonstrated trajectory to a novel object but also executing it robustly under changing scene conditions, grasp configurations, and external disturbances. POIL addresses both problems through a shared representation: a set of 3D points on the object's functional part, used jointly for trajectory transfer and closed-loop execution. The one-shot transfer from the demonstrated trajectory is enabled with point correspondences. POIL grounds the shared functional part with a multi-modal large language model, and transfers the trajectory across viewpoint, pose, and object category changes. During execution, multi-view tracking observes the same points online, and Point-set BCSDM drives them in closed loop by projecting per-point velocities onto a single rigid-body twist computed from the tracked points alone. This extends stable dynamical models from an SE(3) pose to a point set without requiring a known 3D model or pose estimator. We show that at the goal the controller becomes a gradient flow on the classical SO(3) potential, so its terminal phase inherits the almost-global convergence of that potential under a rigid-object assumption. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, POIL transfers a single demonstration across object category, grasp pose, and goal geometry, while recovering from external disturbances during execution. Project page: https://sangminkim-99.github.io/poil

</details>


### [414] [Actively Resolving Contextual Uncertainty for Underspecified Tasks in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30428)
*Zachary Ravichandran,Jonathan Diller,Fernando Cladera,Varun Murali,George J. Pappas,Vijay Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CLUE（闭环语境不确定性消解）框架，使机器人在欠指定自然语言任务与陌生环境中主动消解语境不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言条件策略假设目标明确、任务相关信息已由先验地图提供，难以应对陌生环境中任务欠指定带来的高语境不确定性（需同时推断任务成功标准、相关信息内容及其存在位置）。

Method: CLUE 用 LLM 导出的策略假设任务相关概念与候选规划，并借助在线构建的语言嵌入地图将假设落地为动作；策略通过闭环环境交互依次评估假设，并随新信息的获取不断细化规划。

Result: 在 Boston Dynamics Spot 上于三个真实室内外环境、15 项任务（含物体消歧、功能推断、遮挡推理）验证：成功率与 oracle 策略差距在 7 个百分点以内，较无闭环反馈的 LLM 规划器提升约 4 倍；仅构建并查询语言增强地图的基线成功率约为 CLUE 的 1/3，且消耗超过 10 倍的 VLM token。

Conclusion: 闭环环境交互与在线语言嵌入地图的联合假设-验证机制是消解语境不确定性的关键，仅靠语言增强地图的构建与查询不足以应对复杂语境规划任务。

Abstract: Foundation models provide robots with the ability to interpret natural language and reason about environmental context, yet most language-conditioned policies assume that goals are well-specified and that task-relevant information is provided upfront via a prior map. Operating in unfamiliar environments with underspecified tasks entails high contextual uncertainty: the robot must jointly infer what constitutes task success, what constitutes relevant information, and where (or whether) that information exists. We address these limitations via CLUE (Closed-Loop contextual Uncertainty rEsolution), a framework for actively resolving contextual uncertainty given underspecified tasks in natural language. CLUE uses an LLM-derived policy to hypothesize task-relevant concepts and potential plans. It then uses a language-embedded map, which is constructed online, to ground these hypotheses into actions. The policy sequentially evaluates hypotheses via closed-loop environment interaction and refines its plans as it gathers new information. We deploy CLUE on a Boston Dynamics Spot across three real indoor and outdoor environments spanning 15 tasks that require object disambiguation, functional inference, and occlusion reasoning. CLUE achieves a success rate within 7 percentage points of an oracle policy and outperforms an LLM-enabled planner without closed-loop feedback by a 4x margin. Supporting experiments demonstrate that simply building and then querying a language-enriched map is insufficient to resolve complex contextual planning tasks; these approaches achieve roughly one third the success rate of CLUE while requiring over 10x more VLM tokens. We provide additional information at https://zacravichandran.github.io/CLUE.

</details>


### [415] [Realizability Is Not Enough: Encoding, Liveness, and Auditing of Synthesized Robot Supervisors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30460)
*David C. Conner,Joshua Luzier,William J. Doyle,Emma R. Faith,Aubrie B. Kooiker,Andrew J. Farney,Sebastian Fox,Evangelina Grimes,Ian G. Conner,Kyle Bloom*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一条面向ROS 2 FlexBE监督器的开源流水线，可从能力模型自动生成GR(1)规约、在综合前分析假设、审计策略、在保持行为的前提下约简状态，并输出可执行状态机；在四个案例（含四旋翼硬件）中比较了枚举/独热编码与两种活性公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高层机器人监督器需要根据能力上报的结果决定下一步动作，反应式综合虽能提供形式化保证，但仅证明GR(1)规约可实现并不足以部署：设计者还需编码易失败的能力、选择与重试意图一致的活性假设、审计策略并将其转化为机器人软件。

Method: 构建开源流水线，面向ROS 2 FlexBE监督器：生成基于能力的GR(1)规约；综合前分析假设；审计策略；通过行为保持证明进行状态约简；生成可执行状态机。审计器针对四类结构缺陷（协议违反、死锁、有界失败违反、目标不可达陷阱）具备可靠性与完备性；在四个案例、六组对比中比较枚举编码与独热编码以及两种活性表述。

Result: 在测试后端下，枚举编码通常综合更快，但命题数更少并不稳定地意味着控制器更小或符号代价更低。两者编码在报告的网格中，只有不含pending memory的System-Goal被确认能产生可执行控制器；Fair-Outcome可能允许可实现但非设计者意图完成的循环。约简在能力层面保持行为；审计器不是通用活性验证器。

Conclusion: 对该后端与模型，推荐使用枚举编码配合System-Goal，并审计每一个实现出的策略，因为命题数量和可实现性并不能度量可部署性。该流水线各阶段共同缩小了形式可实现性与通过协议及结构进展检查的控制器之间的差距。

Abstract: High-level robotic supervisors coordinate capabilities whose reported outcomes determine the robot's next action. Reactive synthesis can generate such supervisors with formal guarantees, but deployment requires more than proving a Generalized Reactivity (1) (GR(1)) specification realizable. Designers must encode failure-prone capabilities, choose liveness assumptions that match retry intent, audit strategies, and translate them into robot software. We present an open-source pipeline for Robot Operating System (ROS) 2 Flexible Behavior Engine (FlexBE) supervisors that generates capability-based GR(1) specifications, analyzes assumptions before synthesis, audits strategies, reduces states with a behavior-preservation proof, and emits executable state machines.
  Across four case studies (six comparisons), including hardware on two quadcopter platforms, we compare enumerated and one-hot encodings and two liveness formulations. Under the tested backend, enumerated encoding usually synthesizes faster, although fewer propositions do not reliably predict smaller controllers or lower symbolic cost. System-Goal without pending memory is the only liveness treatment confirmed to yield executable controllers under both encodings across the reported grid; Fair-Outcome can permit realizable cycles without designer-intended completion. For this backend and model, we recommend enumerated encoding with System-Goal and auditing every realized strategy, since proposition count and realizability do not measure deployability.
  The auditor is sound and complete for four structural defect classes (protocol violations, deadlocks, bounded-failure violations, goal-unreachable traps) but is not a general liveness verifier, and the reduction preserves capability-level behavior. Together, these stages narrow the gap between formal realizability and controllers that pass protocol and structural-progress checks.

</details>


### [416] [DGT-Map: Directional Global Traversability Mapping Utilizing Multi-Task Learning for Heterogeneous Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30461)
*Jaskrit Singh,Kashif K. Noori,Jing Xiao,Constantinos Chamzas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DGT-MAP是一种自监督框架，从RGB-D观测与运动信号中学习全局、方向性且车辆条件化的越野可通行代价地图，并通过共享多任务骨干与车辆专用预测头实现跨车辆地形表征共享，在仿真中集成Hybrid A*后取得最高导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全局地图多为各向同性单一代价，忽略了越野可通行性对方向与车辆的依赖性；同时已有学习式估计器通常针对单一车辆独立训练，虽保留车辆特性却阻碍了多车辆间共享通用地形表征。

Method: 提出自监督框架DGT-MAP：以RGB-D观测和运动信号为输入，学习全局、方向性、车辆条件化的可通行代价地图；采用共享多任务骨干网络学习跨训练车辆的通用地形特征，配合车辆专用预测头保留平台相关响应；推理阶段输出按航向索引的代价地图，供方向感知规划器使用。

Result: 在仿真中将DGT-MAP集成到Hybrid A*导航栈，在具有挑战性的地形上评估下游任务成功率，包括仅能下坡不能上坡的斜坡，以及仅部分车辆可通过的山脊障碍；相比几何、二值化及方向无关的学习式基线，DGT-MAP在各项任务上取得最高或并列最高的导航成功率。

Conclusion: DGT-MAP通过方向性与车辆条件化建模，并借助共享骨干加专用预测头的架构，可同时实现跨车辆的地形表征共享与平台特定行为保持，验证了其在复杂越野导航中相对现有基线的优越性。

Abstract: Off-road traversability is direction-dependent and vehicle specific, yet most global maps assign a single isotropic cost to each location. Existing learned estimators are also commonly trained independently for each vehicle; this preserves vehicle-specific behavior but prevents vehicles from sharing common terrain representations. DGT-MAP addresses both limitations through a self-supervised framework that learns global, directional, and vehicle-conditioned traversability costmaps from RGB-D observations and locomotion signals. A shared multi-task backbone learns common terrain features across training vehicles while vehicle-specific prediction heads preserve platform-dependent responses. At inference, DGT-MAP produces a heading-indexed costmap that can be used by a direction-aware planner. We evaluate DGT-MAP in simulation by integrating it into a Hybrid A* navigation stack and measuring downstream task success on challenging terrains, including slopes that are traversable downhill but not uphill and a ridge obstacle that is traversable by some vehicles, but not by others. Across evaluated tasks, DGT-MAP achieves the highest or tied-highest navigation success rate when compared against geometric, binary, and learned direction-agnostic baselines.

</details>


### [417] [Policy-Calibrated DAgger: Offline Calibrated Noise Injection for Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30462)
*Jenny Wang,George Kantor*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Policy-Calibrated DAgger：利用扩散策略自身预测的动作分布，离线估计策略的噪声水平，从而校准 DAgger 的数据采集噪声，避免扫参且无需让机器人处于不安全环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模仿学习策略会随时间累积误差，使机器人漂移出训练分布（协变量偏移）。现有 DAgger 类方法要么让机器人处于不安全状态采集失败数据，要么需要人工选择合适的噪声分布来采集专家示范，噪声水平的选择依赖经验且往往需要大量试错。

Method: 利用近期生成式（扩散）策略的性质，用策略自身预测的动作分布来离线估计其噪声。具体地：测量专家轨迹各观测处扩散策略预测动作的离散程度，并测量其相对录播轨迹的闭环误差。为解决多模态动作空间中误差度量困难的问题，在闭环控制时通过部分去噪（partial denoising）将策略引导向目标轨迹，再利用扩散模型性质把测得的误差反归一化，还原为未加引导时的误差。

Result: 在杂乱狭窄环境中到达发动机拉杆的任务上，于 3D 照片级真实感仿真器和 2D 平面 reacher 环境中实验。结果优于未加噪的数据集聚合（DAgger）训练的策略，并与事后最优噪声水平的性能相当，且无需对噪声水平进行扫描。

Conclusion: 通过生成式策略自身预测分布即可校准噪声水平，Policy-Calibrated DAgger 在无需扫参、无需不安全数据采集的前提下达到事后最优噪声水平的性能，为协变量偏移缓解提供了更实用的方案。

Abstract: Policies trained with imitation learning can accumulate errors over time, causing the robot to drift outside the training distribution. Existing methods mitigate this covariate shift by collecting additional data where the policy fails or is likely to fail. The first places the robot in unsafe conditions and the second requires choosing an appropriate noise distribution to collect new expert demonstrations under that noise. We propose Policy-Calibrated DAgger, a method that makes use of the properties of recent generative policies to estimate the policy's noise offline by using its own predicted action distribution. We measure a diffusion policy's spread of predicted actions at observations along the expert trajectory and measure its closed-loop error relative to a recorded trajectory. To address issues with measuring error in a multimodal action space, we guide the policy towards the trajectory during closed-loop control through partial denoising, and use properties of a diffusion model to unnormalize the measured error as if we did not guide it. We experiment in a scenario where a robot is tasked to reach an engine lever in a cluttered and narrow environment and show results in a 3D photorealistic simulator and a 2D planar reacher environment. We show that our method surpasses policies trained with dataset aggregation without noising and matches the performance of the best noise level in hindsight, without requiring a sweep over noise levels.

</details>


### [418] [Learning-Based Pressure Predictive Control of a Vertebraic Soft Robotic Tail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30479)
*Wenjian Yang,Nan Huang,Yukang Nie,Fang Chen,Wanchao Chi,Jiansheng Dai,Sicong Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于LSTM的压力预测控制(PPC)，用于脊柱式软体机器人尾巴的运动控制及其与四足机器人的协调，兼顾非静态与准静态运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人柔顺、人机交互安全，但连续体结构与非线性材料特性导致运动学建模复杂，尤其非静态运动下建模困难。

Method: PPC由逆运动学(IK)模型、正运动学(FK)模型和压力补偿(P-comp)模型组成，基于LSTM实现；采用预测数据集训练，实现下一时刻动作预测。

Result: 相比仅IK模型，PPC仿真轨迹平均RMSE降低69.8%；协调运动中将计算时间减少60.9%，提升尾巴对四足躯干运动速率的实时响应。

Conclusion: PPC为软体尾巴的非静态与准静态运动控制提供简单有效的建模方法，使软尾四足机器人具备与环境交互的功能。

Abstract: Soft robots have attracted much attention for their safe human-robot interaction and flexibility, but the typical continuum structure and nonlinear material behavior make the kinematics modelling complex, especially in non-static motions. In this work, we proposed an LSTM-based pressure predictive control (PPC) for the motion control of a vertebraic soft robotic tail and the coordination with a quadruped robot. The PPC consists of an inverse kinematics (IK) model, a forward kinematics (FK) model and a pressure compensation (P-comp) model, and achieves non-static and quasi-static motion control of the tail. Compared with the IK-only model, the average RMSE of the PPC's simulation trajectories reduces by 69.8%, when executing target trajectories. In the coordinated motions of the soft tail quadruped, using a prediction data set to train the PPC enables next-moment action prediction and reduces computation time by 60.9%, which enhances the real-time response of the tail to match the quadruped torso's moving rate. The PPC provides a simple and effective method to model the soft tail for both non-static and quasi-static motion control, and grants the soft tail quadruped with the functionality of interacting with the environment.

</details>


### [419] [Memory-Aware Multi-Sensor Perception for Efficient and Safe Navigation in Dynamic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30495)
*Jingshuo Li,Yifan Xue,Yifei Li,Shubhodeep Shiv Aditya,Nadia Figueroa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种记忆感知的多传感器导航框架，融合LiDAR与RGB感知、在线距离场表示学习及阶段自适应MCBF-QP控制器，在复杂室内外环境中提升导航效率与到达率并保持避障能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在未知环境中自主导航需要有效感知、持久的环境表示和避障，同时保持向目标推进。现有基于感知的方法通常依赖先验地图或短时域观测，无法利用先前已观测到的环境结构，导致避障绕行与长期规划能力受限。

Method: 框架整合三部分：(1)LiDAR与RGB多传感器感知；(2)在线距离场表示学习，持久表示静态基础设施并跟踪动态障碍；(3)阶段自适应调制控制障碍函数二次规划（MCBF-QP）控制器，利用先前观测到的几何信息进行绕障，并根据局部情况自适应调整安全约束与引导。

Result: 在复杂室内和室外环境中的实验表明，导航效率和到达目标的表现得到提升，同时在狭窄通道及动态障碍周围的避障能力得以保持。

Conclusion: 记忆感知的多传感器导航框架通过持久的环境表示与阶段自适应MCBF-QP控制，有效弥补了短时域感知的不足，在未知复杂环境中实现了高效且安全的导航。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in previously unseen environments requires effective perception, persistent environmental representation, and collision avoidance while maintaining progress toward a goal. Existing perception-based methods often rely on prior maps or short-horizon observations, limiting their ability to exploit previously observed structure. We propose a memory-aware multi-sensor navigation framework that integrates LiDAR and RGB perception, online distance-field representation learning, and a stage-adaptive Modulated Control Barrier Function Quadratic Program (MCBF-QP). The framework persistently represents static infrastructure while tracking dynamic obstacles, enabling the MCBF-QP controller to exploit previously observed geometry for obstacle circumvention and adapt its safety constraints and guidance to local conditions. Experiments in complex indoor and outdoor environments demonstrate improved navigation efficiency and goal-reaching performance while maintaining collision avoidance in narrow passages and around dynamic obstacles.

</details>


### [420] [Tactile Sensing Array for Multi-Phalanx Sensing in Humanoid Hands](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30506)
*Neel Adwani,Muhaiminul Islam Akash,Rituja Bhattacharya,Cong Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于Velostat与导电胶带的低成本仿人手指全指触觉阵列，覆盖指尖（含2x3矩阵与独立触点）、近节与中节，并通过带间隙与凸起的柔性3D打印接触结构将释放恢复时间降低74%，同时验证了不同接触几何的可区分激活模式与抓握时全指节接触检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿人手需要覆盖整个手指的触觉反馈，而不仅是指尖，才能正确抓取与操作物体；视觉与本体感受在手指自身遮挡相机视野时无法可靠提供接触信息，因此需要低成本、可覆盖多指节的触觉阵列方案。

Method: 采用Velostat与导电胶带制作低成本触觉阵列：指尖布置七个接触点，包括包裹前、左、右面的2x3矩阵及顶端独立触点；近节与中节各布置一条正面接触线。通过重复加载与按压-释放实验测量迟滞与释放恢复时间；并测试一种带间隙与凸起的柔性3D打印接触结构（借鉴已有设计），与平贴接触基线对比。

Result: 带间隙与凸起的柔性3D打印接触结构相较平贴接触基线将恢复时间降低74%；传感器在指尖对平面、边缘、角三种接触几何产生可区分的激活模式；在抓握过程中可检测到三个指节的接触。

Conclusion: 该低成本Velostat触觉阵列可实现全指节接触检测与接触几何区分，但制造方式仍存在迟滞等限制；未来可通过软件补偿更直接地解决残余迟滞问题。

Abstract: Humanoid hands require tactile feedback across the whole finger, not just the fingertip, to grasp and manipulate objects properly. Vision and proprioception alone cannot reliably provide this information, particularly when the hand's own fingers occlude the camera's view of the grasp. We present a low-cost tactile array for a humanoid finger, made from Velostat and conductive tape. The fingertip carries seven contact points including a 2x3 matrix wrapped across its front, left, and right faces, and a separate contact point at the tip. The proximal and middle phalanges each carry a single front-facing contact line. We measure the sensor's hysteresis and recovery time after release, through repeated loading and press-release tests. We also test a compliant, 3D-printed contact structure with a gap and a bump, inspired by similar designs in prior work, and show it cuts recovery time by 74% compared to a flush-contact baseline. We then show the sensor can produce distinct activation patterns for different contact geometries (flat, edge, corner) at the fingertip, and that it registers contact across all three phalanges during a grip. Finally, we discuss the limits of our fabrication changes and point to software-based compensation as a promising way to more directly fix the remaining hysteresis in the future.

</details>


### [421] [Aerial Manipulation in the Wild with Onboard Perception, Policy Learning, and Whole-Body Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30521)
*Yuanzhu Zhan,Yufei Jiang,Zemu Zhang,Junyi Geng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一套真实户外空中操作框架，融合模仿学习（Diffusion Policy）、机载LiDAR-惯性状态估计与全身模型预测控制，实现无需外部动捕的户外操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外空中操作需同时满足可靠状态估计、稳定飞行与外部扰动下的精确操作，三者难以兼顾；现有方法多依赖室内动捕基础设施，难以扩展到真实户外环境。

Method: 框架由三部分组成：(1) 通过操作示教训练Diffusion Policy，从机载观测生成期望末端执行器运动；(2) 由全身模型预测控制（whole-body MPC）联合协调飞行平台与机械臂，跟踪期望末端轨迹；(3) 采用机载LiDAR-惯性里程计进行状态估计，消除对外部运动捕捉系统的依赖。在实体空中操作平台上完成全框架验证。

Result: 在真实空中操作平台上成功执行了户外操作任务，验证了完整框架的可行性。

Conclusion: 示教驱动的操作策略可有效与机载状态估计及基于模型的全身控制相结合，使空中操作突破受控室内环境的限制，拓展至真实户外场景。

Abstract: Aerial manipulation in outdoor environments remains challenging due to the simultaneous requirements of reliable state estimation, stable aerial motion, and precise manipulation under external disturbances. In this work, we present a real-world outdoor aerial manipulation framework that integrates imitation learning, onboard LiDAR-inertial state estimation, and whole-body model predictive control. A Diffusion Policy is trained from manipulation demonstrations to generate desired end-effector motions from onboard observations. These learned commands are executed by a whole-body MPC that jointly coordinates the aerial platform and manipulator to realize the desired end-effector trajectory. To eliminate reliance on external motion-capture infrastructure, the platform employs onboard LiDAR-inertial odometry for state estimation during outdoor operation. We validate the complete framework on a physical aerial manipulator and demonstrate successful execution of outdoor manipulation tasks. The experimental results show that demonstration-driven manipulation policies can be effectively integrated with onboard state estimation and model-based whole-body control to enable aerial manipulation beyond controlled indoor environments.

</details>


### [422] [Containing Behavioral Cascades from Manipulated Claims in LLM-Powered Multi-Robot Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30523)
*Waleed Bin Khalid,Byung-Cheol Min*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种主动验证框架，将LLM驱动多机器人系统遭遇语义操纵后的验证问题视为团队级规划问题，通过“验证-适应-保持”（Verify-Adapt-Hold）结构化方案在操纵得逞后遏制连锁影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的多机器人系统易受语义操纵：一旦接受虚假世界状态声明，可能触发全队行为连锁反应，导致不必要的重规划、路径成本上升、拥堵甚至任务不可行。因此需在操纵成功后遏制其下游传播效应。

Method: 以操纵成功为前提，设计主动验证框架。专用验证模块生成结构化Verify-Adapt-Hold计划：选定机器人检查关键区域，有限子集在必要时临时适应，其余机器人保留可信计划。在多机器人运输环境中，通过注入不同影响程度与团队规模的虚假障碍声明进行评估。

Result: 评估指标包括连锁遏制程度、总成本（Sum-of-Costs）、完工时间（makespan）与覆盖率。结果表明，将受损后验证视为团队级规划问题而非二元信任决策，能有效限制语义操纵造成的物理连锁后果。

Conclusion: 应把妥协后的验证建模为团队级规划问题，通过分级响应（验证、适应、保持）可有效遏制语义操纵的连锁效应，提升多机器人系统的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered multi-robot systems are vulnerable to semantic manipulation: an accepted false world-state claim can trigger a fleet-wide behavioral cascade, causing unnecessary replanning, increased path costs, congestion, or apparent mission infeasibility. Conditioning on a successful manipulation, we propose an active verification framework that contains its downstream effects before they propagate across the fleet. A dedicated verification module generates a structured Verify-Adapt-Hold plan: selected robots inspect consequential regions, a limited subset provisionally adapts when necessary, and the remaining robots retain their trusted plans. We evaluate the framework in a multi-robot transportation environment using injected false obstacle claims across different impacts and team sizes. Evaluation measures cascade containment, Sum-of-Costs, makespan, and coverage ratio. Results show that treating post-compromise verification as a team-level planning problem, rather than a binary trust decision, effectively limits the cascading physical consequences of semantic manipulation.

</details>


### [423] [A Long-Legged, Direct-Drive Monopedal Robot Achieves Exceptional Jump Height](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30530)
*Gihyeok Na,Justin K. Yim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究展示了一种无弹性储能、由直接驱动单腿实现高跳（7.6 m）和快起跳（190 ms支撑时间）的跳跃机器人，重281 g，为迄今电驱动无弹簧系统中跳跃最高者，并验证了户外垂直跳、姿态控制与倾斜起跳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电驱动跳跃机器人多依赖弹性储能或弹簧机构以放大爆发力，这增加了机械复杂度与质量；作者希望在不使用弹性储能的前提下，仅靠单个长腿与直接驱动传动实现高且快的跳跃，并解决长腿结构易屈曲、电机难以全程保持峰值功率以及空中姿态控制等问题。

Method: 采用单条长腿与直接驱动传动，不使用弹性储能；提出新型fabric-wrap（织物缠绕式）传动，实现可变机械增益，使小型电机在整个冲程中接近峰值功率输出，同时对长而轻的腿提供抗屈曲支撑；在腿顶端设置平衡模块，利用小型螺旋桨在陆地和空中控制腿的朝向，长腿为大控制力矩提供长力臂。

Result: 机器人质量281 g，可实现7.6 m的跳跃高度与190 ms的支撑时间，是已报道的电驱动、无弹簧系统中跳跃最高的系统；在户外完成垂直跳跃、地面与飞行中的姿态控制以及倾斜跳跃的验证。

Conclusion: 结果表明，通过可变机械增益传动与顶部螺旋桨平衡模块的协同设计，无需弹性储能即可实现高、快且具姿态可控性的跳跃，为轻量化、电驱动跳跃机器人提供了新思路。

Abstract: We demonstrate a jumping robot that reaches high (7.6 m) and fast (190 ms stance time) jumps from a single long leg driven by a direct-drive transmission, without elastic energy storage. At 281 g, it achieves the highest jump yet reported for an electrically actuated, spring-free system. The leg uses a new fabric-wrap transmission that provides a variable mechanical advantage, keeping a small electric motor near its peak power output through the stroke while bracing the long, lightweight leg against buckling. A balancing module at the top of the leg uses small propellers to control the leg's orientation on the ground and in the air, where the long leg provides a large moment arm for the control torques. The robot is validated outdoors with vertical jumps, attitude control on the ground and in flight, and tilted jumps.

</details>


### [424] [ST-pRRTC: Parallel Space-Time RRT-C with Adaptive Goal-Time Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30533)
*Duo Zhang,Jintong Li,Junshan Huang,Jingjin Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ST-pRRTC，一种面向已知障碍物轨迹、到达时间未指定的GPU并行时空RRT-Connect运动规划器，通过共享前向树与自适应后向目标时间树林解决多到达时间搜索的预算分配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在障碍物轨迹已知但到达时间未指定（unspecified arrival time）的时空规划问题中，搜索多个到达时间可拓宽时间覆盖范围，但会将有限的规划预算分散到更多的后向树中，导致单棵树的搜索效率下降。因此需要在拓宽时间覆盖与控制搜索预算之间取得平衡。

Method: ST-pRRTC构建一棵共享的前向树（shared forward tree）和一个自适应后向目标时间树林（adaptive forest of backward goal-time trees）；其区间根（interval root）形式连续采样目标到达时间；采用根回收（root recycling）策略，在固定数量的后向树上自适应替换较晚的根，同时保留有效的搜索进展；整个规划器在GPU上并行实现。

Result: 在三个动态基准测试上，ST-pRRTC的两种变体在全部对比方法均能求解的问题上，相比ST-RRT*和SI-RRT取得了更低的平均首次解时间（mean first-solution time）和更早的平均最终到达时间（mean final arrival）；进一步实验证明根回收策略在较宽到达时间范围下的优势；真实机器人实验展示了根回收版ST-pRRTC为UR5e机械臂在移动的Crazyflie四旋翼间规划运动。

Conclusion: 区间根形式在给定假设和有界时间域下具备概率完备性（probabilistic completeness）和渐近到达时间最优性（asymptotic arrival-time optimality），而实用的根回收策略不具备上述保证；但根回收变体在实践中表现更优，并在真实机器人场景中验证了可行性。

Abstract: We propose ST-pRRTC, a GPU-parallel space- time RRT-Connect motion planner for problems with known obstacle trajectories and unspecified arrival time. Searching over many arrival times broadens temporal coverage but divides a finite planning budget among more backward trees. To address the challenge, ST-pRRTC builds a shared forward tree and an adaptive forest of backward goal-time trees. Its interval root formulation samples goal arrival times continuously and guarantees probabilistic completeness and asymptotic arrival- time optimality under the stated assumptions in a bounded time domain. The practical root recycling policy has no such guar- antees. It adapts a fixed number of backward trees, replacing later roots while retaining useful search progress. Experiments on three dynamic benchmarks show that both variants achieve lower mean first-solution times and earlier mean final arrivals than ST-RRT* and SI-RRT on problems solved by all compared methods. Further experiments demonstrate the benefit of recy- cling over broad arrival-time ranges. Real-robot demonstrations show root-recycling ST-pRRTC planning motions for a UR5e among moving Crazyflie quadrotors.

</details>


### [425] [GraspTwin: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasp Optimization via a Digital Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30543)
*Daniel J. Evans,Yinlong Dai,Simon Stepputtis,Dylan P. Losey*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 real-to-sim-to-real 框架 GraspTwin：以单张 RGB-D 构建数字孪生，用大基础模型提供任务导向抓取语义先验，再经贝叶斯优化（Thompson 采样）配合域随机化物理仿真并行评估精化抓取，零样本真机迁移仅需数分钟，任务导向抓取成功率提升至 33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人从结构化工厂走向家庭，需操作种类繁多的物体，且许多任务要求抓取方式服务于后续操作（如倒咖啡需握杯柄）。现有方法两极分化：一类追求与任务无关的鲁棒无碰撞抓取（如抓杯口），另一类依赖基础模型给出符合任务语义的抓取位置，但缺乏细粒度物理接地，常出现够到却抓空手柄的问题。

Method: 核心思路是把基础模型的抓取建议视为语义先验，作为局部无梯度优化的种子。流程为：基于单次 RGB-D 观测构建环境数字孪生；查询大型基础模型生成与物体可供性和任务描述一致的抓取建议；采用带 Thompson 采样的贝叶斯优化批量采样邻近位姿，并在域随机化物理 rollout 中并行评估，从而在保持任务语义的同时保证物理可行与鲁棒无碰撞。

Result: 在真实机器人上实现零样本迁移，整个流程仅需数分钟，任务导向抓取成功率相较其他最先进流程最高提升 33%。

Conclusion: 将基础模型输出作为语义先验、用仿真内局部优化进行物理落地的 real-to-sim-to-real 范式，可有效统一任务导向性与物理可行性，实现快速零样本真机抓取。

Abstract: As robots transition from structured factory settings into homes, they are required to interact with an ever-increasing variety of objects. Many tasks require grasping, and often it is not sufficient to just pick up the target object. Consider a task like "pouring coffee" --- to facilitate the subsequent pouring, the robot should grasp the mug by its handle. Existing learning-based approaches for grasping either find robust and collision-free grasps that are largely agnostic to the task (e.g., picking up the mug by its rim), or leverage foundation models to propose task-appropriate grasp locations that lack fine-grained physical grounding (e.g., reaching for and missing the handle). In this work, we bridge these approaches with a real-to-sim-to-real framework. Based on a single RGB-D observation, we construct a digital twin of the environment, query a large foundation model to propose grasps that align with the object's affordances and task description, and then optimize the proposals to ensure robustness and plausibility before executing the result on the real robot. Our key insight is that the grasp proposals of the foundation model should be regarded as semantic priors that serve as seeds for local, gradient-free optimization. We leverage Bayesian optimization with Thompson sampling to draw batches of nearby poses, which are subsequently evaluated in parallel under domain-randomized physics rollouts. The resulting grasp is both task-oriented and physically feasible for execution by the robot arm. Our full zero-shot real-world transfer only takes a few minutes and improves task-oriented grasping success by up to 33% as compared to other state-of-the-art pipelines. Our code is available here: https://github.com/VT-Collab/GraspTwin/

</details>


### [426] [Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search for Robotic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30554)
*Ali Irshayyid,Feng Lin,Chong Li,Jun Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PP-ProPS框架，通过客户端加密策略参数与奖励，在保护隐私的前提下利用LLM进行策略优化，并在多类控制任务中优于ProPS及PPO/SAC/TRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的上下文策略优化需将原始策略参数与奖励历史传输至云端LLM API，导致专有控制策略暴露给第三方服务商，存在隐私泄露风险。此外，原始ProPS还要求已知真实最优回合回报并需向LLM披露，进一步限制了实际部署。

Method: PP-ProPS在每次API请求前，对策略参数与奖励值施加客户端秘密变换进行编码，使LLM仅能看到编码后的策略参数与缩放后的奖励信息，且无需知晓真实最优回合回报。同时改进搜索：向LLM提供各单项奖励分量而非仅总回报，并采用有界历史防止提示无限增长。

Result: 在连续与离散控制任务（MuJoCo运动、经典控制、高速驾驶、机械臂操作）上评估。相较Vanilla ProPS，PP-ProPS在十个任务中的七个取得更优表现；相较PPO、SAC、TRPO等常规RL方法，在六个任务中的五个实现超越。

Conclusion: PP-ProPS在保护策略与环境参数隐私的同时实现了有效的LLM引导策略优化，并通过奖励分量分解与有界历史提升了搜索性能，支持高维策略与开源权重LLM的使用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated promising capabilities as in-context policy optimizers for Reinforcement Learning (RL), enabling policy search driven by both numerical reward signals and natural language reasoning. However, deploying such methods in practice requires transmitting raw policy parameters and rewards history to cloud-based LLM APIs, exposing proprietary control strategies to third-party service providers. To address this issue, this paper introduces Privacy-Preserving Prompted Policy Search (PP-ProPS), a framework that enables LLM-guided policy optimization while keeping policy and environmental parameters confidential. PP-ProPS encodes policy parameters and reward values using secret client-side transformations before they are included in each API request, ensuring that the LLM provider observes only encoded policy parameters and scaled reward information. Furthermore, unlike Vanilla ProPS, the proposed framework does not require the true optimal episodic return to be known or disclosed to the LLM. Beyond protecting the optimization data, PP-ProPS improves the search process in two ways. First, it provides the LLM with individual reward components instead of only a single total return, offering more informative feedback about each candidate policy. Second, it uses a bounded history that prevents the prompt from growing indefinitely, improving search with high-dimensional policies and supporting the use of open-weight LLMs. The proposed PP-ProPS is evaluated on both continuous and discrete control problems spanning Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact (MuJoCo) locomotion, classic control, highway driving, and robotic arm manipulation. Compared to Vanilla ProPS, the proposed PP-ProPS outperforms ProPS in seven of the ten evaluated tasks, and surpasses conventional RL methods including PPO, SAC, and TRPO, in five of the six tasks.

</details>


### [427] [Auditing Latent-Space Monitors for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30557)
*Nikhil Kamalkumar Advani,Vishwajeet Shivaji Hogale,Saurav Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 在LaneSegNet在线矢量化地图生成与VAD端到端规划两个自动驾驶任务上审计“用模型内部表征监测失败”的策略：帧级错误可被预测，但仅用可观测的输入输出即可达到同等甚至更强的失败预测性能，加入隐表征无统计显著增益，说明内部表征的失败预测能力不能证明其具备超出可观测输入输出的增量信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行时失败监测被广泛认为可利用模型内部表征提前预警失败，但既有工作通常只报告内部探针（probe）的AUROC，未与仅使用可观测输入输出（预测结果、自车状态、驾驶指令、预测轨迹等）的基线对比。因此，内部表征是否真正提供了超出可观测量的增量信息尚不明确，本文旨在审计这一问题。

Method: 在两类自动驾驶任务上做审计：(1) LaneSegNet在线矢量化地图生成，以高Chamfer误差为失败端点，训练监督式隐空间探针；(2) VAD端到端规划，以mean-ADE失败为端点，训练规划隐空间监督探针。同时构建仅使用可观测量的基线监测器：LaneSegNet仅用预测输出；VAD仅用自车状态、驾驶指令与规划器预测轨迹。再将隐特征加入基线，检验是否有统计显著的提升，并在一组广泛的规划失败端点上重复该比较（含标签依赖基线不可见几何信息的端点）。

Result: 帧级错误在两任务中均可于推理时预测。LaneSegNet监督隐探针在高Chamfer误差上AUROC为0.780，据作者所知是首个面向在线矢量化地图生成的post-hoc帧级失败监测器；VAD规划隐探针在mean-ADE失败上AUROC为0.868。但仅用LaneSegNet预测输出的监测器达AUROC 0.825；VAD仅用自车状态、驾驶指令与预测轨迹在同一端点达0.924。向任一基线加入隐特征均未获得统计上可分辨的改进，该现象在广泛的规划失败端点上持续存在，包括标签依赖非隐基线不可见几何信息的端点。

Conclusion: 从内部表征预测失败，并不能证明该表征提供了超出可观测输入与输出的有用信息。作者提出了一套用于检验隐空间访问增量价值的评估协议，并公开了逐帧失败端点标签。研究提示失败监测研究应强制报告可观测基线，以避免高估内部表征的价值。

Abstract: Runtime failure monitors can use a model's internal representations to anticipate failures. We audit this monitoring strategy across two autonomous-driving tasks: online vectorized map generation with LaneSegNet and end-to-end planning with VAD. We find that frame-level errors are predictable at inference in both tasks. For LaneSegNet, a supervised latent probe reaches Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) 0.780 for high Chamfer error; to our knowledge, this is the first post-hoc frame-level failure monitor for online vectorized map generation. For VAD, a supervised planning-latent probe reaches AUROC 0.868 for mean-ADE failure.
  Our audit shows that internal access is not necessary for strong failure prediction. A monitor using only LaneSegNet's prediction outputs reaches AUROC 0.825, while for VAD, ego state, driving command, and the planner's predicted trajectory reach 0.924 on the same mean-ADE endpoint. Adding latent features to either baseline yields no statistically resolved improvement. This observation persists across a broad suite of planning failure endpoints, including endpoints whose labels depend on geometry unavailable to the non-latent baseline. Thus, predicting failure from an internal representation does not establish that the representation provides useful information beyond observable inputs and outputs. We propose an evaluation protocol for testing the incremental value of latent access and release our per-frame failure endpoint labels.

</details>


### [428] [SoGuDiff: Socially Guided Diffusion for Steerable, Norm-Grounded Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30560)
*Christian Schaible,Haoran Ji,Yash Vardhan Pant,Stephen L. Smith*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种基于扩散模型的机器人导航框架，其社交行为可在部署时通过连续风格轴进行调控，并用可行性投影层分离社交行为与运动学/避碰约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超越单纯避碰，社交胜任的机器人导航需遵循随语境、文化与部署需求而变化的隐性社会规范；而传统导航策略（固定奖励的强化学习或模仿学习）只学到单一规范行为，运行时无法调整该行为，缺乏可调接口。

Method: 基于扩散的导航框架：在部署时指定期望风格（如靠近行人的距离、让行侧、对群体的退让程度），规划器据此自适应；连续风格轴可独立遵循或组合，覆盖一个行为空间而非离散的基于基元（primitive）的规格；并设置可行性投影层，将学习到的社交行为与运动学可行性和避碰分离。

Result: 单轴扫描展示出一条权衡曲线，严格优于所评估的固定行为基线配置；风格差异在真实世界演示中得到复现。

Conclusion: 社交导航行为可在部署阶段按连续风格轴灵活调优并组合，且与安全性（运动学可行性、避碰）解耦；该方法在性能上优于固定行为基线，并具备真实世界可复现性。

Abstract: Beyond collision avoidance, socially competent robot navigation requires adherence to implicit social conventions that vary across contexts, cultures, and deployment requirements. Many conventional navigation policies learn a single normative behavior, either through reinforcement learning against a fixed reward function or imitation of human demonstrations, exposing no interface for adjusting that conduct at runtime. We present a diffusion-based navigation framework whose social behavior can be tuned at deployment: a desired style is specified, such as how closely the robot passes, which side it yields to, or how much it defers to groups, and the planner adapts accordingly. Continuous style axes can be followed independently or composed, spanning a behavioral space rather than discrete, primitive-based specifications. A feasibility projection layer separates learned social behavior from kinematic feasibility and collision avoidance. A single-axis sweep illustrates a tradeoff curve that strictly dominates the evaluated fixed-behavior baseline configurations, and stylistic differences are replicated in real-world demonstrations.

</details>


### [429] [MOCHA: Multi-Objective Co-Design using Hypernetwork Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30570)
*Varun Madabushi,Neil Janwani,Maegan Tucker*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MOCHA，首个基于强化学习、用单一网络计算机器人设计空间中一族Pareto最优策略的方法，通过超网络（MDH）实现跨设计维度与多目标的策略表示，并结合进化搜索高效生成设计Pareto集及通用设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人设计中，形态（design）与控制器（policy）相互耦合，需要同时优化多个目标（如速度、能耗等），导致搜索空间大且目标间存在权衡。传统方法难以用统一模型高效覆盖从设计到策略的整个Pareto前沿。

Method: 提出MOCHA，利用超网络架构学习“多目标设计超网络”（MDH），该网络根据给定目标与参数化机器人设计生成专门化的策略网络参数；同时提出通过进化搜索已学习策略网络来高效产生Design Pareto集，得到每种目标偏好下的最优设计-策略组合；并给出计算在整个目标集上累计表现最优的通用机器人设计的有效方法。

Result: 在两种不同机器人形态上验证，每种含6个设计维度、2-3个目标；MDH能够表示复杂的、依赖设计的策略族，并成功生成Design Pareto集与通用设计（在全部目标上取得最佳累计表现）。

Conclusion: MOCHA展示了用单一超网络统一建模设计-策略耦合与多目标权衡的可行性，可高效获得Pareto最优设计-策略组合及通用设计，为机器人协同设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: In this work, we present MOCHA, the first, to our knowledge, reinforcement learning based approach to computing a family of Pareto-optimal policies across the design space of a robot using a single network. Specifically, MOCHA leverages the hypernetwork architecture to learn a network that produces specialized network parameters optimized for a given objective and parameterized robot design; we term this a multi-objective design hypernetwork (MDH). We demonstrate the capabilities of MDHs to represent a complex family of design-dependent strategies on two distinct robot morphologies, each with six design dimensions and across 2-3 objectives. Moreover, we propose an approach for efficiently producing a Design Pareto set using evolutionary search of the learned policy network, generating the optimal design-policy combination for each objective prioritization. Lastly, we provide an efficient method for computing generalist robot designs which achieve the best cumulative performance across the entire set of objectives.

</details>


### [430] [HuGo: LLMs as Whole-Body Policy Code Designers for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30594)
*Seoyeon Choi,Shizhao Ye,Nicholas Bui,Aayushi Shrivastava,Kanghyun Ryu,Dhruva Tirumala,Markus Wulfmeier,Negar Mehr*

Main category: cs.RO
